"""Leave module — policies, applications, balance ledger, encashment.

Composes with roster by writing `Shift` rows (LEAVE-category shift type)
on approval. The roster prefill helper preserves those rows so the grid
reflects approved leaves without any extra wiring.

Implementation reference: docs/LEAVE_POLICY_IMPLEMENTATION.md
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.db import models
from django.utils import timezone


class _Auditable(models.Model):
    added_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name="+",
    )
    added_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    updated_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name="+",
    )
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        abstract = True


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Policy
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class LeavePolicy(_Auditable):
    """Rules that apply to a single LEAVE-category ShiftType.

    Managed by HR through the Django admin. One policy per leave type.
    All knobs match SEBPO Leave Policy v2.0 (see
    docs/LEAVE_POLICY_IMPLEMENTATION.md).
    """

    class Gender(models.TextChoices):
        ANY = "ANY", "Any"
        FEMALE = "FEMALE", "Female only"
        MALE = "MALE", "Male only"

    class Cycle(models.TextChoices):
        CALENDAR = "CALENDAR", "Calendar year (Jan–Dec)"
        ANNIVERSARY = "ANNIVERSARY", "From joining anniversary"

    class AccrualMethod(models.TextChoices):
        NONE = "NONE", "No accrual (fixed entitlement)"
        FIXED_ANNUAL = "FIXED_ANNUAL", "Fixed annual grant on Jan 1"
        WORKED_DAY_RATIO = "WORKED_DAY_RATIO", "1 day per N worked days"

    shift_type = models.OneToOneField(
        "roster.ShiftType",
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="leave_policy",
        limit_choices_to={"category": "LEAVE"},
    )

    # --- Entitlement & wage ---
    max_days_per_year = models.PositiveIntegerField(
        default=0,
        help_text="Annual entitlement in days. 0 means uncapped (e.g. LWP, HdL).",
    )
    is_paid = models.BooleanField(
        default=True,
        help_text="Whether days off under this policy are paid. False for LWP.",
    )

    # --- Eligibility gates ---
    applies_to_gender = models.CharField(
        max_length=10, choices=Gender.choices, default=Gender.ANY,
        help_text="FEMALE for Maternity Leave; ANY for the rest.",
    )
    min_service_months = models.PositiveIntegerField(
        default=0,
        help_text="12 for Annual Leave; 6 for Maternity Leave; 0 for the rest.",
    )
    max_surviving_children = models.PositiveIntegerField(
        null=True, blank=True,
        help_text="Maternity: must have <= this many surviving children. 1 for MtL; null = no cap.",
    )

    # --- Pro-rating + cycle ---
    prorate_on_join = models.BooleanField(
        default=True,
        help_text="Pro-rate the entitlement for mid-year joiners. False for AL "
                  "(which has its own 12-month service gate instead).",
    )
    cycle = models.CharField(
        max_length=12, choices=Cycle.choices, default=Cycle.CALENDAR,
        help_text="ANNIVERSARY only for AL accrual eligibility.",
    )

    # --- Accrual ---
    accrual_method = models.CharField(
        max_length=20, choices=AccrualMethod.choices, default=AccrualMethod.NONE,
    )
    accrual_ratio_denominator = models.PositiveIntegerField(
        default=0,
        help_text="N in 1:N (1 day per N worked days). 18 for AL.",
    )

    # --- Sandwich rule ---
    bridges_sandwich = models.BooleanField(
        default=True,
        help_text="Whether holidays/weekends bracketed by this leave count "
                  "(sandwich rule). False for LWP and HdL — they don't sandwich.",
    )

    # --- Carry-forward + encashment ---
    carry_forward_pct = models.DecimalField(
        max_digits=4, decimal_places=2, default=Decimal("0"),
        help_text="Fraction (0–1) of unused entitlement that carries to next year. "
                  "0.50 for AL; 0 for the rest.",
    )
    max_carry_forward_days = models.PositiveIntegerField(
        null=True, blank=True,
        help_text="Cap on accumulated carry-forward. 60 for AL (triggers freeze).",
    )
    freezes_entitlement_at_cap = models.BooleanField(
        default=False,
        help_text="If True and carry_forward reaches max_carry_forward_days, the "
                  "employee's future accrual is frozen (LeaveBalance.entitlement_frozen).",
    )
    encash_carry_forward_excess = models.BooleanField(
        default=False,
        help_text="If True, year-end rollover auto-creates an EncashmentRequest "
                  "for unused balance not carried forward. True for AL.",
    )

    # --- Documentation ---
    cert_required_min_days = models.PositiveIntegerField(
        default=0,
        help_text="0 = never required; >=1 = attachment required when "
                  "application.day_count >= this value. SL=3, MtL=1, others=0.",
    )

    # --- Compensatory leave behaviour ---
    cpl_grant_on_holiday_work = models.BooleanField(
        default=False,
        help_text="If True, a WORK Shift saved on a Holiday-tagged date "
                  "credits +1 day to this policy's balance for that employee. "
                  "True for CpL.",
    )
    cpl_use_within_days = models.PositiveIntegerField(
        null=True, blank=True,
        help_text="Working-day deadline to consume a granted CpL day. 3 for CpL.",
    )

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = "Leave policy"
        verbose_name_plural = "Leave policies"

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"Policy for {self.shift_type}"

    @property
    def tracks_balance(self) -> bool:
        """Whether this policy needs a per-(employee, year) running balance.

        True for entitlement-tracking types:
            - Annual Leave (accrual-based)
            - Casual Leave / Sick Leave / Maternity Leave (fixed annual entitlement)
            - Compensatory Leave (signal-driven grants)

        False for types that have no quota (Festival Leave, Leave Without Pay,
        Half Day Leave) — those don't need a `LeaveBalance` row.
        """
        if not self.is_paid:
            return False  # LWP, HdL — salary deduction, no entitlement
        if self.max_days_per_year > 0:
            return True   # CL, SL, MtL
        if self.accrual_method != self.AccrualMethod.NONE:
            return True   # AL (WORKED_DAY_RATIO)
        if self.cpl_grant_on_holiday_work:
            return True   # CpL — accrued via signal
        return False      # FL — observed dates, no quota


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Application
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class LeaveApplication(_Auditable):
    class Status(models.TextChoices):
        PENDING = "PENDING", "Pending"
        APPROVED = "APPROVED", "Approved"
        DECLINED = "DECLINED", "Declined"
        CANCELLED = "CANCELLED", "Cancelled"

    class HalfDayPeriod(models.TextChoices):
        AM = "AM", "First half (AM)"
        PM = "PM", "Second half (PM)"

    employee = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="leave_applications",
    )
    leave_type = models.ForeignKey(
        "roster.ShiftType",
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        limit_choices_to={"category": "LEAVE", "is_active": True},
        related_name="+",
    )
    start_date = models.DateField()
    end_date = models.DateField()
    note = models.TextField(blank=True)
    attachment = models.FileField(upload_to="leave/", null=True, blank=True)

    # Half-day support — when True, start_date == end_date and the balance
    # debits 0.5 instead of 1.
    is_half_day = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    half_day_period = models.CharField(
        max_length=2, choices=HalfDayPeriod.choices, blank=True, default="",
    )

    # Sandwich-aware billing — populated at approval time by
    # leave/services.py. `working_days` and `sandwich_days` are kept as separate
    # columns for reporting; `effective_days` = working + sandwich and is what
    # gets debited from the balance.
    working_days = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=Decimal("0"))
    sandwich_days = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=Decimal("0"))
    effective_days = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=Decimal("0"))

    status = models.CharField(
        max_length=10, choices=Status.choices, default=Status.PENDING,
    )
    applied_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="+",
    )
    applied_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    processed_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name="+",
    )
    processed_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    process_note = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["-applied_at"]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["employee", "status"]),
            models.Index(fields=["status", "start_date"]),
        ]

    @property
    def day_count(self) -> int:
        """Calendar-day count (start..end inclusive). Use `effective_days` for billing."""
        return (self.end_date - self.start_date).days + 1

    @property
    def is_pending(self) -> bool:
        return self.status == self.Status.PENDING

    @property
    def is_approved(self) -> bool:
        return self.status == self.Status.APPROVED

    def clean(self):
        if self.end_date and self.start_date and self.end_date < self.start_date:
            raise ValidationError({"end_date": "End date must be on or after start date."})
        if self.leave_type_id and self.leave_type.category != "LEAVE":
            raise ValidationError({"leave_type": "Must be a LEAVE-category shift type."})
        if self.is_half_day:
            if self.start_date != self.end_date:
                raise ValidationError(
                    {"end_date": "Half-day leave must start and end on the same date."}
                )
            if not self.half_day_period:
                raise ValidationError(
                    {"half_day_period": "Pick AM or PM for a half-day leave."}
                )

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        self.full_clean()
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.employee} · {self.leave_type} · {self.start_date}–{self.end_date}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Balance ledger
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class LeaveBalance(_Auditable):
    """One row per (employee, leave_policy, year).

    `available` is computed: opening + accrued + carried_forward − used − encashed.

    Mutations always go through `LeaveBalanceTransaction` rows so the ledger
    is auditable. The fields here are running totals for fast reads.
    """

    employee = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="leave_balances",
    )
    leave_policy = models.ForeignKey(
        LeavePolicy, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="balances",
    )
    year = models.PositiveIntegerField()

    opening = models.DecimalField(max_digits=6, decimal_places=2, default=Decimal("0"))
    accrued = models.DecimalField(max_digits=6, decimal_places=2, default=Decimal("0"))
    used = models.DecimalField(max_digits=6, decimal_places=2, default=Decimal("0"))
    encashed = models.DecimalField(max_digits=6, decimal_places=2, default=Decimal("0"))
    carried_forward = models.DecimalField(max_digits=6, decimal_places=2, default=Decimal("0"))

    entitlement_frozen = models.BooleanField(
        default=False,
        help_text="Set when AL carry-forward reaches the 60-day cap. "
                  "Subsequent monthly accrual skips this row.",
    )

    class Meta:
        unique_together = [("employee", "leave_policy", "year")]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["employee", "year"]),
            models.Index(fields=["leave_policy", "year"]),
        ]
        ordering = ["-year", "leave_policy"]

    @property
    def available(self) -> Decimal:
        return (
            self.opening + self.accrued + self.carried_forward
            - self.used - self.encashed
        )

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.employee} · {self.leave_policy.shift_type.name} · {self.year}"


class LeaveBalanceTransaction(models.Model):
    """Append-only ledger of every change to a LeaveBalance.

    Reasons:
      - ACCRUAL: monthly accrual job credit, or initial fixed-annual grant
      - USED: leave application approved → balance debit
      - REVERSED: leave application cancelled → balance credit (undo of USED)
      - CARRIED_FORWARD: year-end rollover credit on next year's row
      - ENCASHED: encashment request paid → balance debit
      - FROZEN: marker that this balance was frozen at the cap (delta=0)
      - ADJUSTMENT: manual HR correction (delta signed)
    """

    class Reason(models.TextChoices):
        ACCRUAL = "ACCRUAL", "Accrual"
        USED = "USED", "Used"
        REVERSED = "REVERSED", "Reversed"
        CARRIED_FORWARD = "CARRIED_FORWARD", "Carried forward"
        ENCASHED = "ENCASHED", "Encashed"
        FROZEN = "FROZEN", "Frozen at cap"
        ADJUSTMENT = "ADJUSTMENT", "Manual adjustment"

    balance = models.ForeignKey(
        LeaveBalance, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="transactions",
    )
    occurred_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    delta = models.DecimalField(
        max_digits=6, decimal_places=2,
        help_text="Signed change. Positive credits the balance; negative debits.",
    )
    reason = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=Reason.choices)
    application = models.ForeignKey(
        LeaveApplication, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name="balance_transactions",
    )
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name="+",
    )
    note = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["-occurred_at"]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["balance", "-occurred_at"]),
            models.Index(fields=["reason"]),
        ]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        sign = "+" if self.delta >= 0 else ""
        return f"{self.balance} · {sign}{self.delta} · {self.get_reason_display()}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Encashment
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class EncashmentRequest(_Auditable):
    """Convert unused leave (typically AL) to a payout.

    Generated automatically by the year-end rollover for AL excess, or
    requested manually by the employee. Approved by HR. The actual money
    movement happens in payroll, outside Orbis.
    """

    class Status(models.TextChoices):
        PENDING = "PENDING", "Pending"
        APPROVED = "APPROVED", "Approved"
        REJECTED = "REJECTED", "Rejected"
        PAID = "PAID", "Paid"

    employee = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="encashment_requests",
    )
    leave_policy = models.ForeignKey(
        LeavePolicy, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="encashment_requests",
    )
    year = models.PositiveIntegerField()
    days_requested = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2)
    days_approved = models.DecimalField(
        max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, null=True, blank=True,
    )

    status = models.CharField(
        max_length=10, choices=Status.choices, default=Status.PENDING,
    )
    requested_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    processed_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name="+",
    )
    processed_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    note = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["-requested_at"]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["employee", "year"]),
            models.Index(fields=["status"]),
        ]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return (
            f"Encashment · {self.employee} · {self.leave_policy.shift_type.name} "
            f"· {self.year} · {self.days_requested}d"
        )


# ==========================================
# FILE: ./leave/reports.py
# ==========================================
"""Leave reporting helpers.

The shift summary intentionally mirrors the old TTMS roster-summary shape while
using Orbis' semantic shift types and leave ledger instead of hardcoded IDs.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from calendar import isleap
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP

from django.db.models import Count, Q

from accounts.models import CustomUser
from leave.models import LeaveBalance, LeavePolicy
from roster.models import Shift, ShiftType


COUNT_ALIASES = {
    "CL": {"CL", "Casual Leave"},
    "SL": {"SL", "Sick Leave"},
    "AL": {"AL", "Annual Leave"},
    "LWP": {"LWP", "Leave Without Pay"},
    "MTL": {"MTL", "Maternity Leave"},
    "CPL": {"CPL", "Compensatory Leave"},
    "GH": {"GH", "FL", "PH", "Festival Leave", "Govt Holiday", "Government Holiday"},
}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ShiftSummaryFilters:
    start_date: date
    end_date: date
    department_id: int | None = None
    employee_id: str | None = None


class CrossYearSummaryError(ValueError):
    pass


def build_shift_summary(filters: ShiftSummaryFilters) -> list[dict]:
    if filters.start_date > filters.end_date:
        raise ValueError("Start date must be on or before end date.")
    if filters.start_date.year != filters.end_date.year:
        raise CrossYearSummaryError("Shift summary must stay within one calendar year.")

    year = filters.start_date.year
    employees = _employee_queryset(filters)
    employee_ids = list(employees.values_list("pk", flat=True))
    counts_by_employee = _shift_counts_by_employee(employee_ids, filters.start_date, filters.end_date)
    policies_by_code = _policies_by_code()
    balances_by_employee = _balances_by_employee(employee_ids, year, policies_by_code)

    rows = []
    for employee in employees:
        counts = counts_by_employee.get(employee.pk, _empty_counts())
        first_working_date = _first_working_date(filters.start_date, employee.joining_date)
        eligible_days = max((filters.end_date - first_working_date).days + 1, 0)

        al_allocated = _al_allocated(employee.pk, balances_by_employee)
        cl_allocated = _prorated_allocation(policies_by_code.get("CL"), eligible_days, year)
        sl_allocated = _prorated_allocation(policies_by_code.get("SL"), eligible_days, year)

        total_leave_allocated = al_allocated + cl_allocated + sl_allocated
        total_leave_taken = (
            counts["CL"] + counts["SL"] + counts["AL"] + counts["LWP"] + counts["MTL"]
        )
        leave_remaining = total_leave_allocated - Decimal(total_leave_taken)

        rows.append({
            "employee_id": employee.employee_id or "",
            "employee_name": employee.display_name,
            "department": employee.department.name if employee.department_id else "",
            "first_working_date": first_working_date,
            "days_worked": counts["days_worked"],
            "OFF": counts["OFF"],
            "CL": counts["CL"],
            "SL": counts["SL"],
            "AL": counts["AL"],
            "LWP": counts["LWP"],
            "MTL": counts["MTL"],
            "GH": counts["GH"],
            "CPL": counts["CPL"],
            "al_allocated": al_allocated,
            "cl_allocated": cl_allocated,
            "sl_allocated": sl_allocated,
            "total_leave_allocated": total_leave_allocated,
            "total_leave_taken": total_leave_taken,
            "leave_remaining": leave_remaining,
        })
    return rows


def _employee_queryset(filters: ShiftSummaryFilters):
    qs = (
        CustomUser.objects
        .filter(is_active=True)
        .filter(Q(last_working_date__isnull=True) | Q(last_working_date__gte=filters.start_date))
        .select_related("department")
        .order_by("employee_id", "first_name", "last_name")
    )
    if filters.department_id:
        qs = qs.filter(department_id=filters.department_id)
    if filters.employee_id:
        qs = qs.filter(pk=filters.employee_id)
    return qs


def _shift_counts_by_employee(employee_ids, start_date: date, end_date: date) -> dict:
    out = {}
    rows = (
        Shift.objects
        .filter(employee_id__in=employee_ids, date__gte=start_date, date__lte=end_date)
        .values("employee_id", "shift_type__name", "shift_type__category")
        .annotate(total=Count("id"))
    )
    for row in rows:
        employee_id = row["employee_id"]
        counts = out.setdefault(employee_id, _empty_counts())
        name = row["shift_type__name"]
        category = row["shift_type__category"]
        total = row["total"]

        if category == ShiftType.Category.WORK:
            counts["days_worked"] += total
        elif category == ShiftType.Category.OFF or name == "OFF":
            counts["OFF"] += total

        for code, aliases in COUNT_ALIASES.items():
            if name in aliases:
                counts[code] += total
                break
    return out


def _empty_counts() -> dict:
    return {
        "days_worked": 0,
        "OFF": 0,
        "CL": 0,
        "SL": 0,
        "AL": 0,
        "LWP": 0,
        "MTL": 0,
        "GH": 0,
        "CPL": 0,
    }


def _policies_by_code() -> dict:
    policies = LeavePolicy.objects.select_related("shift_type")
    out = {}
    for policy in policies:
        name = policy.shift_type.name
        for code, aliases in COUNT_ALIASES.items():
            if name in aliases and code not in out:
                out[code] = policy
                break
    return out


def _balances_by_employee(employee_ids, year: int, policies_by_code: dict) -> dict:
    policy_ids = [
        policy.pk
        for code, policy in policies_by_code.items()
        if code in {"AL", "CL", "SL"} and policy is not None
    ]
    out = {}
    balances = (
        LeaveBalance.objects
        .filter(employee_id__in=employee_ids, year=year, leave_policy_id__in=policy_ids)
        .select_related("leave_policy", "leave_policy__shift_type")
    )
    for balance in balances:
        code = _policy_code(balance.leave_policy)
        if code:
            out.setdefault(balance.employee_id, {})[code] = balance
    return out


def _policy_code(policy: LeavePolicy) -> str:
    name = policy.shift_type.name
    for code, aliases in COUNT_ALIASES.items():
        if name in aliases:
            return code
    return ""


def _al_allocated(employee_id, balances_by_employee: dict) -> Decimal:
    balance = balances_by_employee.get(employee_id, {}).get("AL")
    if not balance:
        return Decimal("0")
    return balance.opening + balance.accrued + balance.carried_forward


def _prorated_allocation(policy: LeavePolicy | None, eligible_days: int, year: int) -> Decimal:
    if not policy or policy.max_days_per_year <= 0 or eligible_days <= 0:
        return Decimal("0")
    days_in_year = Decimal("366" if isleap(year) else "365")
    raw = Decimal(policy.max_days_per_year) * Decimal(eligible_days) / days_in_year
    return raw.quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)


def _first_working_date(start_date: date, joining_date: date | None) -> date:
    if joining_date and joining_date > start_date:
        return joining_date
    return start_date


# ==========================================
# FILE: ./leave/signals.py
# ==========================================
"""Leave signals.

- On Shift save: if the shift is WORK-category on a Holiday-tagged date, the
  employee earns +1 day in the CpL balance. Idempotent.

- On Holiday save / delete: re-evaluate sandwich billing for any APPROVED
  LeaveApplication overlapping the affected date. Necessary because adding
  or removing a Holiday changes whether dates are working / non-working,
  which in turn changes the sandwich classification.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import timedelta
from decimal import Decimal

from django.db import transaction
from django.db.models import F
from django.db.models.signals import post_delete, post_save
from django.dispatch import receiver

from leave.models import (
    LeaveApplication,
    LeaveBalance,
    LeaveBalanceTransaction,
    LeavePolicy,
)


CPL_GRANT_NOTE_FMT = "CpL grant: shift #{shift_pk}"


@receiver(post_save, sender="roster.Shift")
def grant_cpl_on_holiday_work(sender, instance, created, **kwargs):
    """Whenever a WORK-category Shift exists on a Holiday-tagged date, that
    employee earns +1 day on the CpL balance. Idempotent — keyed off shift pk."""
    shift_type = instance.shift_type
    if shift_type is None or shift_type.category != "WORK":
        return

    # Avoid circular imports — pull Holiday lazily.
    from roster.models import Holiday

    is_holiday = Holiday.objects.filter(date=instance.date, is_active=True).exists()
    if not is_holiday:
        return

    cpl_policy = (
        LeavePolicy.objects
        .filter(cpl_grant_on_holiday_work=True)
        .select_related("shift_type")
        .first()
    )
    if cpl_policy is None:
        return

    note = CPL_GRANT_NOTE_FMT.format(shift_pk=instance.pk)
    if LeaveBalanceTransaction.objects.filter(
        balance__employee=instance.employee,
        balance__leave_policy=cpl_policy,
        reason=LeaveBalanceTransaction.Reason.ACCRUAL,
        note=note,
    ).exists():
        return  # already granted

    with transaction.atomic():
        bal, _ = LeaveBalance.objects.get_or_create(
            employee=instance.employee,
            leave_policy=cpl_policy,
            year=instance.date.year,
        )
        LeaveBalanceTransaction.objects.create(
            balance=bal,
            delta=Decimal("1"),
            reason=LeaveBalanceTransaction.Reason.ACCRUAL,
            application=None,
            created_by=instance.updated_by_id and instance.updated_by,
            note=note,
        )
        bal.accrued = F("accrued") + Decimal("1")
        bal.save(update_fields=["accrued", "updated_at"])


@receiver(post_delete, sender="roster.Shift")
def revoke_cpl_on_shift_delete(sender, instance, **kwargs):
    """If a WORK Shift on a Holiday date is deleted, revoke the corresponding
    CpL grant. Defensive — the original grant note pins the link."""
    cpl_policy = LeavePolicy.objects.filter(cpl_grant_on_holiday_work=True).first()
    if cpl_policy is None:
        return

    note = CPL_GRANT_NOTE_FMT.format(shift_pk=instance.pk)
    txn = LeaveBalanceTransaction.objects.filter(
        balance__employee=instance.employee,
        balance__leave_policy=cpl_policy,
        reason=LeaveBalanceTransaction.Reason.ACCRUAL,
        note=note,
    ).first()
    if txn is None:
        return

    with transaction.atomic():
        bal = txn.balance
        # Write a reversing ADJUSTMENT rather than deleting, so the ledger
        # stays append-only and auditable.
        LeaveBalanceTransaction.objects.create(
            balance=bal,
            delta=-txn.delta,
            reason=LeaveBalanceTransaction.Reason.ADJUSTMENT,
            application=None,
            created_by=None,
            note=f"Reverse {note} (Shift removed)",
        )
        bal.accrued = F("accrued") - txn.delta
        bal.save(update_fields=["accrued", "updated_at"])


@receiver(post_save, sender="roster.Holiday")
def recompute_after_holiday_change(sender, instance, **kwargs):
    """A new (or modified) Holiday changes the working-day status of its date,
    which can flip whether other approved leaves' dates count as edge or
    sandwich. Walk every active employee with an approved leave overlapping
    a ±14-day window and let `recompute_sandwich` do the rest."""
    from leave.services import recompute_sandwich

    affected_employee_pks = set(
        LeaveApplication.objects
        .filter(
            status=LeaveApplication.Status.APPROVED,
            start_date__lte=instance.date + timedelta(days=14),
            end_date__gte=instance.date - timedelta(days=14),
        )
        .values_list("employee_id", flat=True)
    )

    if not affected_employee_pks:
        return

    from accounts.models import CustomUser
    employees = CustomUser.objects.filter(pk__in=affected_employee_pks)
    for emp in employees:
        recompute_sandwich(emp, instance.date, request_user=None)


@receiver(post_delete, sender="roster.Holiday")
def recompute_after_holiday_delete(sender, instance, **kwargs):
    """Mirror of recompute_after_holiday_change for deletion."""
    recompute_after_holiday_change(sender, instance, **kwargs)

def _visible_leave_qs(user, request=None):
    """All LeaveApplication rows the user is allowed to see."""
    if can_see_all(user, request):
        return LeaveApplication.objects.all()
    return LeaveApplication.objects.filter(
        employee_id__in=visible_employee_pks(user, request)
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# List (tabbed)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class LeaveListView(LoginRequiredMixin, View):
    template_name = "leave/list.html"

    def get(self, request):
        tab = request.GET.get("tab", "mine")
        base = (
            _visible_leave_qs(request.user, request=request)
            .select_related("employee", "employee__department", "leave_type")
        )

        mine_qs = (
            LeaveApplication.objects
            .filter(employee=request.user)
            .select_related("leave_type")
        )
        pending_qs = base.filter(status=LeaveApplication.Status.PENDING).exclude(employee=request.user)
        user_can_see_all = can_see_all(request.user, request=request)
        all_qs = base if user_can_see_all else base.none()

        show_pending_tab = has_managed_scope(request.user, request=request)
        show_all_tab = user_can_see_all

        if tab == "pending" and show_pending_tab:
            rows = list(pending_qs.order_by("start_date"))
        elif tab == "all" and show_all_tab:
            rows = list(all_qs.order_by("-applied_at")[:200])
        else:
            tab = "mine"
            rows = list(mine_qs.order_by("-applied_at"))

        ctx = {
            "page_title": "Leave",
            "tab": tab,
            "rows": rows,
            "mine_count": mine_qs.count(),
            "pending_count": pending_qs.count(),
            "all_count": all_qs.count() if show_all_tab else 0,
            "show_pending_tab": show_pending_tab,
            "show_all_tab": show_all_tab,
            "current_user_pk": request.user.pk,
            "user_can_see_all": user_can_see_all,
            "user_can_edit_all": can_edit_all(request.user, request=request),
        }
        return render(request, self.template_name, ctx)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Apply
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class LeaveApplyView(LoginRequiredMixin, CreateView):
    model = LeaveApplication
    form_class = LeaveApplicationForm
    template_name = "leave/apply.html"

    def _resolve_employee(self):
        raw = self.request.GET.get("for") or self.request.POST.get("for")
        if not raw:
            return self.request.user
        target = get_object_or_404(CustomUser, pk=raw)
        if target.pk == self.request.user.pk:
            return self.request.user
        if not can_apply_leave_for(self.request.user, target, request=self.request):
            raise PermissionDenied("You can't apply on behalf of that employee.")
        return target

    def get_form_kwargs(self):
        kwargs = super().get_form_kwargs()
        kwargs["employee"] = self._resolve_employee()
        return kwargs

    def get_context_data(self, **kwargs):
        ctx = super().get_context_data(**kwargs)
        ctx["page_title"] = "Apply for leave"
        ctx["target_employee"] = self._resolve_employee()
        ctx["applying_for_other"] = ctx["target_employee"].pk != self.request.user.pk
        return ctx

    def form_valid(self, form):
        target = self._resolve_employee()
        app = form.save(commit=False)
        app.employee = target
        app.applied_by = self.request.user
        app.added_by = self.request.user
        app.updated_by = self.request.user
        app.status = LeaveApplication.Status.PENDING
        app.save()
        messages.success(self.request, f"Leave request submitted for {target.display_name}.")
        return redirect("leave_detail", pk=app.pk)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# AJAX preview — returns billable-day breakdown + available balance
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class LeavePreviewView(LoginRequiredMixin, View):
    """POST a proposed leave (employee/leave_type/start/end/is_half_day) and
    receive `{working, sandwich, total, available, leave_type, is_paid,
    cert_required, cert_required_min_days}` for live form feedback."""

    http_method_names = ["post"]

    def post(self, request):
        for_pk = request.POST.get("for") or request.user.pk
        try:
            target = CustomUser.objects.get(pk=for_pk)
        except CustomUser.DoesNotExist:
            return JsonResponse({"error": "Employee not found"}, status=404)

        if target.pk != request.user.pk:
            if not can_apply_leave_for(request.user, target, request=request):
                return JsonResponse({"error": "Permission denied"}, status=403)

        leave_type_id = request.POST.get("leave_type")
        start = parse_date(request.POST.get("start_date") or "")
        end = parse_date(request.POST.get("end_date") or "")
        is_half_day = request.POST.get("is_half_day") in ("on", "true", "1")

        if not (leave_type_id and start and end):
            return JsonResponse({"error": "Missing fields"}, status=400)
        if end < start:
            return JsonResponse({"error": "End must be on/after start"}, status=400)

        try:
            leave_type = ShiftType.objects.select_related("leave_policy").get(
                pk=leave_type_id, is_active=True, category=ShiftType.Category.LEAVE,
            )
        except ShiftType.DoesNotExist:
            return JsonResponse({"error": "Invalid leave type"}, status=400)

        policy = leave_type.leave_policy
        probe = LeaveApplication(
            employee=target,
            leave_type=leave_type,
            start_date=start,
            end_date=end,
            is_half_day=is_half_day,
            applied_by=target,
        )

        try:
            working, sandwich, total = compute_application_billable_days(probe)
        except Exception as exc:
            return JsonResponse({"error": str(exc)}, status=400)

        bal = get_or_create_balance(target, policy, start.year)
        cert_threshold = policy.cert_required_min_days
        cert_needed = (cert_threshold > 0
                       and (probe.day_count >= cert_threshold))

        return JsonResponse({
            "working": str(working),
            "sandwich": str(sandwich),
            "total": str(total),
            "available": str(bal.available),
            "is_paid": policy.is_paid,
            "cert_required": cert_needed,
            "cert_required_min_days": cert_threshold,
            "leave_type_name": leave_type.name,
            "year": start.year,
        })


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Detail
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class LeaveDetailView(LoginRequiredMixin, DetailView):
    model = LeaveApplication
    template_name = "leave/detail.html"
    context_object_name = "application"

    def get_queryset(self):
        return LeaveApplication.objects.select_related(
            "employee", "leave_type", "applied_by", "processed_by",
        )

    def get_object(self, queryset=None):
        obj = super().get_object(queryset)
        user = self.request.user
        if obj.employee_id == user.pk:
            return obj
        if obj.employee_id in visible_employee_pks(user, request=self.request):
            return obj
        if can_see_all(user, request=self.request):
            return obj
        raise Http404

    def get_context_data(self, **kwargs):
        ctx = super().get_context_data(**kwargs)
        app = ctx["application"]
        ctx["page_title"] = f"Leave · {app.leave_type.name} · {app.start_date}"
        ctx["can_act"] = (
            can_act_on_leave(self.request.user, app, request=self.request)
            and app.is_pending
        )
        ctx["can_cancel"] = (
            can_cancel_leave(self.request.user, app, request=self.request)
            and app.status != LeaveApplication.Status.CANCELLED
        )
        return ctx


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Action views — approve / decline / cancel
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class _ActionBase(LoginRequiredMixin, View):
    http_method_names = ["post"]

    def dispatch(self, request, pk, *args, **kwargs):
        self.application = get_object_or_404(LeaveApplication, pk=pk)
        return super().dispatch(request, pk, *args, **kwargs)

    def _render_row_response(self, request):
        """htmx → updated row partial; non-htmx → redirect to detail."""
        if not getattr(request, "htmx", False):
            return redirect("leave_detail", pk=self.application.pk)
        html = render_to_string(
            "leave/_row.html",
            {
                "row": self.application,
                "current_user_pk": request.user.pk,
                "oob": True,
                "show_actions": False,
            },
            request=request,
        )
        return HttpResponse(html)


class LeaveApproveView(_ActionBase):
    @transaction.atomic
    def post(self, request, pk):
        app = self.application
        if not can_act_on_leave(request.user, app, request=request) or not app.is_pending:
            raise PermissionDenied
        # Re-validate at approve time — state may have changed since the form.
        try:
            validate_application_eligibility(app)
            validate_application_attachment(app)
            validate_application_against_balance(app)
        except ValidationError as exc:
            messages.error(request, "; ".join(exc.messages))
            return redirect("leave_detail", pk=app.pk)

        app.status = LeaveApplication.Status.APPROVED
        app.processed_by = request.user
        app.processed_at = timezone.now()
        app.process_note = request.POST.get("process_note", "").strip()
        app.updated_by = request.user
        app.save()
        # The recompute orchestrator handles materialisation + the ledger
        # for this app and any adjacent approved apps that were affected by
        # the new sandwich anchor.
        recompute_sandwich(app.employee, app.start_date, request_user=request.user)
        messages.success(request, f"Approved: {app}.")
        return self._render_row_response(request)


class LeaveDeclineView(_ActionBase):
    @transaction.atomic
    def post(self, request, pk):
        app = self.application
        if not can_act_on_leave(request.user, app, request=request) or not app.is_pending:
            raise PermissionDenied
        app.status = LeaveApplication.Status.DECLINED
        app.processed_by = request.user
        app.processed_at = timezone.now()
        app.process_note = request.POST.get("process_note", "").strip()
        app.updated_by = request.user
        app.save()
        # Decline didn't write any shifts/balance, nothing to reverse.
        messages.info(request, f"Declined: {app}.")
        return self._render_row_response(request)


class LeaveCancelView(_ActionBase):
    @transaction.atomic
    def post(self, request, pk):
        app = self.application
        if not can_cancel_leave(request.user, app, request=request):
            raise PermissionDenied
        was_approved = app.is_approved
        app.status = LeaveApplication.Status.CANCELLED
        app.processed_by = request.user
        app.processed_at = timezone.now()
        app.process_note = (
            request.POST.get("process_note", "").strip()
            or app.process_note or "Cancelled"
        )
        app.updated_by = request.user
        app.save()
        if was_approved:
            restore_balance(app, request.user)
            reverse_shifts_for_application(app)
            recompute_sandwich(app.employee, app.start_date, request_user=request.user)
        messages.info(request, f"Cancelled: {app}.")
        return self._render_row_response(request)

class LeaveBalanceView(LoginRequiredMixin, View):
    template_name = "leave/balance.html"

    def get(self, request):
        # Allow HR / managers to view another employee via ?for=<pk>.
        for_pk = request.GET.get("for")
        target = request.user
        if for_pk and str(for_pk) != str(request.user.pk):
            target = get_object_or_404(CustomUser, pk=for_pk)
            if not (can_see_all(request.user, request=request)
                    or target.pk in visible_employee_pks(request.user, request=request)):
                raise PermissionDenied("You can't view this employee's balance.")

        year = int(request.GET.get("year") or _date.today().year)

        # Materialise balance rows only for policies that actually track a
        # quota AND that this employee is currently eligible for. FL/LWP/HdL
        # have no quota; MtL is hidden from male / short-tenure employees;
        # AL is hidden until the 12-month service gate clears.
        relevant_policies = []
        for policy in LeavePolicy.objects.select_related("shift_type"):
            if not policy.tracks_balance:
                continue
            ok, _ = is_eligible_for_policy(target, policy)
            if not ok:
                continue
            relevant_policies.append(policy)
            get_or_create_balance(target, policy, year)

        tracking_policy_pks = [p.pk for p in relevant_policies]
        balances = (
            LeaveBalance.objects
            .filter(employee=target, year=year, leave_policy_id__in=tracking_policy_pks)
            .select_related("leave_policy", "leave_policy__shift_type")
            .order_by("leave_policy__shift_type__name")
        )

        rows = []
        for bal in balances:
            policy = bal.leave_policy
            rows.append({
                "policy": policy,
                "name": policy.shift_type.name,
                "is_paid": policy.is_paid,
                "opening": bal.opening,
                "accrued": bal.accrued,
                "carried_forward": bal.carried_forward,
                "used": bal.used,
                "encashed": bal.encashed,
                "available": bal.available,
                "frozen": bal.entitlement_frozen,
                "balance_pk": bal.pk,
            })

        ctx = {
            "page_title": f"Leave balance · {year}",
            "target": target,
            "year": year,
            "rows": rows,
            "is_self": target.pk == request.user.pk,
        }
        return render(request, self.template_name, ctx)


class LeaveBalanceTransactionsView(LoginRequiredMixin, View):
    """JSON list of transactions for a given LeaveBalance — drives the
    history drawer on the balance dashboard."""

    http_method_names = ["get"]

    def get(self, request, pk):
        bal = get_object_or_404(LeaveBalance, pk=pk)
        if (bal.employee_id != request.user.pk
            and bal.employee_id not in visible_employee_pks(request.user, request=request)
            and not can_see_all(request.user, request=request)):
            raise PermissionDenied("You can't view this balance's history.")

        rows = [
            {
                "occurred_at": txn.occurred_at.isoformat(),
                "delta": str(txn.delta),
                "reason": txn.get_reason_display(),
                "application_pk": txn.application_id,
                "note": txn.note,
            }
            for txn in bal.transactions.select_related("application")[:200]
        ]
        return JsonResponse({"results": rows})

class EncashmentListView(LoginRequiredMixin, ListView):
    """Employees see their own requests; HR / User Admins see all."""
    model = EncashmentRequest
    template_name = "leave/encashment_list.html"
    context_object_name = "requests"
    paginate_by = 30

    def get_queryset(self):
        qs = (
            EncashmentRequest.objects
            .select_related("employee", "leave_policy", "leave_policy__shift_type")
            .order_by("-requested_at")
        )
        if can_edit_all(self.request.user, request=self.request):
            return qs
        return qs.filter(employee=self.request.user)

    def get_context_data(self, **kwargs):
        ctx = super().get_context_data(**kwargs)
        ctx["page_title"] = "Encashment"
        ctx["can_decide"] = can_edit_all(self.request.user, request=self.request)
        return ctx


class EncashmentRequestView(LoginRequiredMixin, View):
    """Employee submits a manual encashment request. Year-end auto-creation
    happens in the rollover management command and bypasses this view."""
    template_name = "leave/encashment_request.html"

    def get(self, request):
        ctx = self._get_context()
        return render(request, self.template_name, ctx)

    def post(self, request):
        try:
            policy_pk = int(request.POST.get("leave_policy"))
            days = Decimal(request.POST.get("days_requested"))
            year = int(request.POST.get("year") or _date.today().year)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            messages.error(request, "Invalid encashment request.")
            return redirect("encashment_request")

        policy = get_object_or_404(
            LeavePolicy.objects.select_related("shift_type"),
            pk=policy_pk,
            encash_carry_forward_excess=True,
        )
        bal = get_or_create_balance(request.user, policy, year)
        if days <= 0 or days > bal.available:
            messages.error(
                request,
                f"You can request up to {bal.available} day(s) of "
                f"{policy.shift_type.name} encashment.",
            )
            return redirect("encashment_request")

        EncashmentRequest.objects.create(
            employee=request.user,
            leave_policy=policy,
            year=year,
            days_requested=days,
            note=request.POST.get("note", "").strip(),
            added_by=request.user,
            updated_by=request.user,
        )
        messages.success(request, "Encashment request submitted.")
        return redirect("encashment_list")

    def _get_context(self):
        encashable = LeavePolicy.objects.filter(
            encash_carry_forward_excess=True,
        ).select_related("shift_type")
        year = _date.today().year
        rows = []
        for policy in encashable:
            bal = get_or_create_balance(self.request.user, policy, year)
            rows.append({
                "policy": policy,
                "name": policy.shift_type.name,
                "available": bal.available,
            })
        return {
            "page_title": "Request encashment",
            "rows": rows,
            "year": year,
        }


class MonthlyHRReportView(LoginRequiredMixin, View):
    """HR-only CSV export of leave activity for a month.

    Columns: employee_id, employee_email, name, department, leave_type,
    start_date, end_date, working_days, sandwich_days, effective_days,
    status, applied_at, processed_at, processed_by.
    """

    def get(self, request):
        if not can_edit_all(request.user, request=request):
            raise PermissionDenied("HR / User Admins only.")

        month = request.GET.get("month") or _date.today().strftime("%Y-%m")
        try:
            year, m = month.split("-")
            year = int(year)
            m = int(m)
        except ValueError:
            return HttpResponse("month must be YYYY-MM", status=400)

        from calendar import monthrange
        last = monthrange(year, m)[1]
        start = _date(year, m, 1)
        end = _date(year, m, last)

        rows = (
            LeaveApplication.objects
            .select_related(
                "employee", "employee__department", "leave_type",
                "applied_by", "processed_by",
            )
            .filter(
                applied_at__date__gte=start,
                applied_at__date__lte=end,
            )
            .order_by("applied_at")
        )

        import csv
        from io import StringIO
        buf = StringIO()
        w = csv.writer(buf)
        w.writerow([
            "employee_id", "email", "name", "department",
            "leave_type", "start_date", "end_date",
            "working_days", "sandwich_days", "effective_days",
            "status", "applied_at", "processed_at", "processed_by",
        ])
        for r in rows:
            w.writerow([
                r.employee.employee_id or "",
                r.employee.email,
                r.employee.display_name,
                r.employee.department.name if r.employee.department else "",
                r.leave_type.name,
                r.start_date.isoformat(),
                r.end_date.isoformat(),
                r.working_days,
                r.sandwich_days,
                r.effective_days,
                r.status,
                r.applied_at.isoformat(timespec="minutes"),
                r.processed_at.isoformat(timespec="minutes") if r.processed_at else "",
                r.processed_by.display_name if r.processed_by else "",
            ])

        resp = HttpResponse(buf.getvalue(), content_type="text/csv")
        resp["Content-Disposition"] = f'attachment; filename="leave-report-{month}.csv"'
        return resp


class ShiftSummaryView(LoginRequiredMixin, View):
    template_name = "leave/shift_summary.html"

    def get(self, request):
        if not can_see_all(request.user, request=request):
            raise PermissionDenied("HR / User Admins only.")

        today = _date.today()
        start_date = parse_date(request.GET.get("start_date") or f"{today.year}-01-01")
        end_date = parse_date(request.GET.get("end_date") or today.isoformat())
        department_id = request.GET.get("department") or None
        errors = []
        rows = []

        if not start_date:
            errors.append("Start date must be YYYY-MM-DD.")
        if not end_date:
            errors.append("End date must be YYYY-MM-DD.")

        if start_date and end_date and not errors:
            try:
                rows = build_shift_summary(
                    ShiftSummaryFilters(
                        start_date=start_date,
                        end_date=end_date,
                        department_id=int(department_id) if department_id else None,
                    )
                )
            except CrossYearSummaryError as exc:
                errors.append(str(exc))
            except ValueError as exc:
                errors.append(str(exc))

        departments = Department.objects.filter(is_active=True).order_by("name")
        return render(request, self.template_name, {
            "page_title": "Shift summary",
            "departments": departments,
            "department_id": department_id or "",
            "start_date": start_date,
            "end_date": end_date,
            "rows": rows,
            "errors": errors,
        })


class EmployeeLeaveRegisterView(LoginRequiredMixin, View):
    """Per-employee Form-9 style leave register. HR-readable."""

    template_name = "leave/employee_register.html"

    def get(self, request, pk):
        target = get_object_or_404(CustomUser, pk=pk)
        if not (can_see_all(request.user, request=request)
                or target.pk == request.user.pk
                or target.pk in visible_employee_pks(request.user, request=request)):
            raise PermissionDenied("You can't view this employee's register.")

        year = int(request.GET.get("year") or _date.today().year)

        # All approved applications in `year`.
        approvals = (
            LeaveApplication.objects
            .filter(
                employee=target,
                status=LeaveApplication.Status.APPROVED,
                start_date__year=year,
            )
            .select_related("leave_type")
            .order_by("start_date")
        )

        # Year-summary balances — only entitlement-tracking policies.
        tracking_policy_pks = [
            p.pk for p in LeavePolicy.objects.all() if p.tracks_balance
        ]
        balances = (
            LeaveBalance.objects
            .filter(employee=target, year=year, leave_policy_id__in=tracking_policy_pks)
            .select_related("leave_policy", "leave_policy__shift_type")
            .order_by("leave_policy__shift_type__name")
        )

        ctx = {
            "page_title": f"Leave register · {target.display_name} · {year}",
            "target": target,
            "year": year,
            "approvals": approvals,
            "balances": balances,
        }
        return render(request, self.template_name, ctx)


class EncashmentDecideView(LoginRequiredMixin, View):
    """HR approves / rejects / marks paid."""
    http_method_names = ["post"]

    def post(self, request, pk):
        if not can_edit_all(request.user, request=request):
            raise PermissionDenied("Only HR / User Admins can process encashments.")
        req = get_object_or_404(EncashmentRequest, pk=pk)
        action = request.POST.get("action")
        if action == "approve":
            try:
                days_approved = Decimal(
                    request.POST.get("days_approved") or req.days_requested
                )
            except Exception:
                days_approved = req.days_requested
            req.status = EncashmentRequest.Status.APPROVED
            req.days_approved = days_approved
        elif action == "reject":
            req.status = EncashmentRequest.Status.REJECTED
        elif action == "mark_paid":
            if req.status not in (
                EncashmentRequest.Status.APPROVED,
                EncashmentRequest.Status.PAID,
            ):
                messages.error(request, "Only APPROVED requests can be marked paid.")
                return redirect("encashment_list")
            # Debit the balance for the approved days.
            policy = req.leave_policy
            bal = get_or_create_balance(req.employee, policy, req.year)
            days = req.days_approved or Decimal("0")
            if days > 0 and req.status == EncashmentRequest.Status.APPROVED:
                from leave.models import LeaveBalanceTransaction
                LeaveBalanceTransaction.objects.create(
                    balance=bal,
                    delta=-days,
                    reason=LeaveBalanceTransaction.Reason.ENCASHED,
                    application=None,
                    created_by=request.user,
                    note=f"Encashment #{req.pk}",
                )
                from django.db.models import F
                bal.encashed = F("encashed") + days
                bal.save(update_fields=["encashed", "updated_at"])
            req.status = EncashmentRequest.Status.PAID
        else:
            messages.error(request, "Unknown action.")
            return redirect("encashment_list")

        req.processed_by = request.user
        req.processed_at = timezone.now()
        req.note = request.POST.get("note", req.note)
        req.updated_by = request.user
        req.save()
        messages.success(request, f"Encashment {req.get_status_display().lower()}.")
        return redirect("encashment_list")

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.test import TestCase, override_settings
from django.urls import reverse

from accounts.models import Department
from leave.models import LeaveBalance, LeavePolicy
from leave.reports import (
    CrossYearSummaryError,
    ShiftSummaryFilters,
    build_shift_summary,
)
from roster.models import Shift, ShiftType


User = get_user_model()


def _user(email, **extra):
    return User.objects.create_user(
        email=email,
        username=email,
        password="test-1234!",
        first_name=email.split("@")[0].title(),
        last_name="Test",
        **extra,
    )


class ShiftSummaryReportTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.ops = Department.objects.create(name="Operations")
        self.hr = Department.objects.create(name="HR")

        self.work = ShiftType.objects.create(name="MOR", category=ShiftType.Category.WORK)
        self.off = ShiftType.objects.create(name="OFF", category=ShiftType.Category.OFF)
        self.gh = ShiftType.objects.create(name="GH", category=ShiftType.Category.HOLIDAY)
        self.fl = ShiftType.objects.create(name="FL", category=ShiftType.Category.HOLIDAY)

        self.leave_types = {
            code: ShiftType.objects.create(name=code, category=ShiftType.Category.LEAVE)
            for code in ("AL", "CL", "SL", "LWP", "MTL", "CPL")
        }
        self.policies = {
            "AL": LeavePolicy.objects.create(
                shift_type=self.leave_types["AL"],
                accrual_method=LeavePolicy.AccrualMethod.WORKED_DAY_RATIO,
                accrual_ratio_denominator=18,
                carry_forward_pct=Decimal("0.50"),
                max_carry_forward_days=60,
            ),
            "CL": LeavePolicy.objects.create(
                shift_type=self.leave_types["CL"],
                max_days_per_year=10,
                accrual_method=LeavePolicy.AccrualMethod.FIXED_ANNUAL,
            ),
            "SL": LeavePolicy.objects.create(
                shift_type=self.leave_types["SL"],
                max_days_per_year=14,
                accrual_method=LeavePolicy.AccrualMethod.FIXED_ANNUAL,
            ),
        }

        self.alice = _user(
            "alice@example.com",
            employee_id="001",
            department=self.ops,
            joining_date=date(2026, 1, 15),
        )
        self.bob = _user(
            "bob@example.com",
            employee_id="002",
            department=self.ops,
            joining_date=date(2025, 1, 1),
        )
        self.carol = _user(
            "carol@example.com",
            employee_id="003",
            department=self.hr,
            joining_date=date(2026, 1, 1),
        )
        self.terminated = _user(
            "term@example.com",
            employee_id="004",
            department=self.ops,
            joining_date=date(2025, 1, 1),
            last_working_date=date(2025, 12, 31),
        )

    def _row(self, rows, employee_id):
        return next(row for row in rows if row["employee_id"] == employee_id)

    def test_counts_shifts_and_includes_active_employees_without_shifts(self):
        for day in (1, 2, 3):
            Shift.objects.create(
                employee=self.alice,
                date=date(2026, 2, day),
                shift_type=self.work,
            )
        for shift_type, day in (
            (self.off, 4),
            (self.leave_types["CL"], 5),
            (self.leave_types["SL"], 6),
            (self.leave_types["AL"], 7),
            (self.leave_types["LWP"], 8),
            (self.leave_types["MTL"], 9),
            (self.leave_types["CPL"], 10),
            (self.gh, 11),
            (self.fl, 12),
        ):
            Shift.objects.create(
                employee=self.alice,
                date=date(2026, 2, day),
                shift_type=shift_type,
            )

        rows = build_shift_summary(
            ShiftSummaryFilters(date(2026, 1, 1), date(2026, 3, 31), self.ops.pk)
        )

        self.assertEqual([row["employee_id"] for row in rows], ["001", "002"])
        alice = self._row(rows, "001")
        self.assertEqual(alice["days_worked"], 3)
        self.assertEqual(alice["OFF"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(alice["CL"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(alice["SL"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(alice["AL"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(alice["LWP"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(alice["MTL"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(alice["CPL"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(alice["GH"], 2)

        bob = self._row(rows, "002")
        self.assertEqual(bob["days_worked"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(bob["total_leave_taken"], 0)

    def test_allocation_uses_inclusive_prorated_cl_sl_and_al_ledger(self):
        LeaveBalance.objects.create(
            employee=self.alice,
            leave_policy=self.policies["AL"],
            year=2026,
            opening=Decimal("1.00"),
            accrued=Decimal("2.00"),
            carried_forward=Decimal("3.00"),
        )
        LeaveBalance.objects.create(
            employee=self.alice,
            leave_policy=self.policies["CL"],
            year=2026,
            opening=Decimal("10.00"),
            accrued=Decimal("0.00"),
            carried_forward=Decimal("99.00"),
        )

        rows = build_shift_summary(
            ShiftSummaryFilters(date(2026, 1, 1), date(2026, 3, 31), self.ops.pk)
        )
        alice = self._row(rows, "001")

        self.assertEqual(alice["first_working_date"], date(2026, 1, 15))
        self.assertEqual(alice["al_allocated"], Decimal("6.00"))
        self.assertEqual(alice["cl_allocated"], Decimal("2"))
        self.assertEqual(alice["sl_allocated"], Decimal("3"))
        self.assertEqual(alice["total_leave_allocated"], Decimal("11.00"))

    def test_cross_year_ranges_are_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(CrossYearSummaryError):
            build_shift_summary(
                ShiftSummaryFilters(date(2025, 12, 31), date(2026, 1, 1))
            )

    @override_settings(STORAGES={
        "default": {"BACKEND": "django.core.files.storage.FileSystemStorage"},
        "staticfiles": {"BACKEND": "django.contrib.staticfiles.storage.StaticFilesStorage"},
    })
    def test_shift_summary_view_renders_for_superuser(self):
        admin = _user("admin@example.com", is_staff=True, is_superuser=True)
        self.client.force_login(admin)

        response = self.client.get(reverse("leave_shift_summary"))

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertContains(response, "Shift summary")

# FILE: ./leave/forms.py
# ==========================================
from __future__ import annotations

from django import forms
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError

from core.forms import StyledMixin
from leave.models import LeaveApplication
from leave.services import (
    eligible_leave_policies,
    validate_application_against_balance,
    validate_application_attachment,
    validate_application_eligibility,
)
from roster.models import ShiftType


class LeaveApplicationForm(forms.ModelForm, StyledMixin):
    class Meta:
        model = LeaveApplication
        fields = (
            "leave_type", "start_date", "end_date",
            "is_half_day", "half_day_period",
            "note", "attachment",
        )

    def __init__(self, *args, employee=None, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.employee = employee

        # Filter the leave-type dropdown to policies this employee is eligible
        # for (gender / service / surviving children gates).
        if employee is not None:
            eligible_policies = eligible_leave_policies(employee)
            eligible_st_pks = list(eligible_policies.values_list("shift_type_id", flat=True))
            self.fields["leave_type"].queryset = (
                ShiftType.objects
                .filter(
                    pk__in=eligible_st_pks,
                    is_active=True,
                    category=ShiftType.Category.LEAVE,
                )
                .order_by("name")
            )
        else:
            self.fields["leave_type"].queryset = (
                ShiftType.objects
                .filter(is_active=True, category=ShiftType.Category.LEAVE)
                .order_by("name")
            )

        for date_field in ("start_date", "end_date"):
            self.fields[date_field].widget = forms.DateInput(
                attrs={
                    "type": "text",
                    "placeholder": "YYYY-MM-DD",
                    "data-flatpickr": "",
                    "autocomplete": "off",
                    "pattern": r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}",
                },
                format="%Y-%m-%d",
            )
            self.fields[date_field].input_formats = ["%Y-%m-%d"]
        self.fields["note"].widget.attrs["rows"] = 3
        self.fields["half_day_period"].required = False
        self.style_widgets()

    def clean(self):
        cleaned = super().clean()
        start = cleaned.get("start_date")
        end = cleaned.get("end_date")
        leave_type = cleaned.get("leave_type")
        is_half_day = cleaned.get("is_half_day")
        half_day_period = cleaned.get("half_day_period")

        if start and end and end < start:
            self.add_error("end_date", "End date must be on or after start date.")
            return cleaned

        if is_half_day:
            if start and end and start != end:
                self.add_error("end_date", "Half-day leave must start and end on the same date.")
            if not half_day_period:
                self.add_error("half_day_period", "Pick AM or PM for a half-day leave.")

        # Overlap check — block apps that collide with another pending/approved
        # leave on the same employee.
        if self.employee and start and end:
            overlap = LeaveApplication.objects.filter(
                employee=self.employee,
                status__in=[
                    LeaveApplication.Status.PENDING,
                    LeaveApplication.Status.APPROVED,
                ],
                start_date__lte=end,
                end_date__gte=start,
            )
            if self.instance.pk:
                overlap = overlap.exclude(pk=self.instance.pk)
            if overlap.exists():
                raise ValidationError(
                    "You already have a pending or approved leave request "
                    "covering one or more of these dates."
                )

        # Build a transient application for the policy validators.
        if self.employee and leave_type and start and end and not self.errors:
            probe = LeaveApplication(
                employee=self.employee,
                leave_type=leave_type,
                start_date=start,
                end_date=end,
                is_half_day=bool(is_half_day),
                half_day_period=half_day_period or "",
                attachment=cleaned.get("attachment"),
                applied_by=self.employee,
            )
            try:
                validate_application_eligibility(probe)
            except ValidationError as e:
                self._merge(e)
            try:
                validate_application_attachment(probe)
            except ValidationError as e:
                self._merge(e)
            try:
                validate_application_against_balance(probe)
            except ValidationError as e:
                self._merge(e)

        return cleaned

    def _merge(self, exc: ValidationError) -> None:
        """Merge a ValidationError raised by a service-layer validator into
        the form's errors, attaching messages to the right fields where the
        exception used a dict, and to non-field otherwise."""
        if hasattr(exc, "error_dict"):
            for field, errs in exc.error_dict.items():
                for err in errs:
                    self.add_error(field if field in self.fields else None, err)
        else:
            for err in exc.error_list:
                self.add_error(None, err)

# ==========================================
# FILE: ./leave/management/commands/apply_monthly_accrual.py
# ==========================================
"""Monthly accrual job for AL (or any policy with accrual_method=WORKED_DAY_RATIO).

For each (active employee, policy) pair:
- Count last month's WORK Shifts for the employee.
- Divide by `policy.accrual_ratio_denominator` (e.g., 18 for AL → 1 day per
  18 worked days). Round to 0.5 days.
- Add to `LeaveBalance.accrued`. Write an ACCRUAL transaction.
- Skip when `LeaveBalance.entitlement_frozen` is True (60-day cap reached).

Suggested cron: 1st of each month at 02:00 server time.

Usage:
    python manage.py apply_monthly_accrual           # process previous month
    python manage.py apply_monthly_accrual --month 2026-04
    python manage.py apply_monthly_accrual --dry-run
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from calendar import monthrange
from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal

from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand
from django.db import transaction
from django.db.models import F

from accounts.models import CustomUser
from leave.models import LeaveBalance, LeaveBalanceTransaction, LeavePolicy
from leave.services import is_eligible_for_policy
from roster.models import Shift, ShiftType


def _previous_month_today(today: date) -> tuple[date, date]:
    """Return (first_day, last_day) of the calendar month before `today`."""
    if today.month == 1:
        y, m = today.year - 1, 12
    else:
        y, m = today.year, today.month - 1
    last = monthrange(y, m)[1]
    return date(y, m, 1), date(y, m, last)


def _round_half(value: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    """Round to nearest 0.5 (banker's-rounding-ish — half goes up)."""
    return (value * Decimal("2")).quantize(Decimal("1")) / Decimal("2")


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = "Apply monthly accrual to LeaveBalance rows for WORKED_DAY_RATIO policies."

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument(
            "--month",
            type=str,
            default=None,
            help="Target month as YYYY-MM. Defaults to the calendar month before today.",
        )
        parser.add_argument(
            "--dry-run",
            action="store_true",
            help="Print what would happen without writing.",
        )

    def handle(self, *args, **opts):
        month_arg = opts.get("month")
        dry = bool(opts.get("dry_run"))

        if month_arg:
            try:
                y, m = month_arg.split("-")
                target_year, target_month = int(y), int(m)
            except ValueError:
                self.stderr.write(self.style.ERROR("--month must be YYYY-MM"))
                return
            last = monthrange(target_year, target_month)[1]
            month_start = date(target_year, target_month, 1)
            month_end = date(target_year, target_month, last)
        else:
            month_start, month_end = _previous_month_today(date.today())

        accrual_year = month_end.year
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Accrual window: {month_start} → {month_end} (year={accrual_year})"
        )
        if dry:
            self.stdout.write(self.style.WARNING("DRY RUN — no writes"))

        policies = list(
            LeavePolicy.objects
            .filter(accrual_method=LeavePolicy.AccrualMethod.WORKED_DAY_RATIO)
            .select_related("shift_type")
        )
        if not policies:
            self.stdout.write("No accrual-driven policies. Nothing to do.")
            return

        users = CustomUser.objects.filter(is_active=True)
        total_accrued = Decimal("0")
        affected = 0

        for user in users:
            worked = (
                Shift.objects.filter(
                    employee=user,
                    date__gte=month_start,
                    date__lte=month_end,
                    shift_type__category=ShiftType.Category.WORK,
                ).count()
            )
            if worked == 0:
                continue

            for policy in policies:
                # Don't accrue for ineligible employees (e.g., AL for someone
                # who hasn't cleared the 12-month service gate yet).
                eligible, reason = is_eligible_for_policy(user, policy)
                if not eligible:
                    continue

                denom = policy.accrual_ratio_denominator
                if denom <= 0:
                    continue
                raw = Decimal(worked) / Decimal(denom)
                accrual = _round_half(raw)
                if accrual <= 0:
                    continue

                bal, _ = LeaveBalance.objects.get_or_create(
                    employee=user,
                    leave_policy=policy,
                    year=accrual_year,
                )
                if bal.entitlement_frozen:
                    self.stdout.write(
                        f"  {user.email} · {policy.shift_type.name} · "
                        f"FROZEN — skipping ({worked} worked days)"
                    )
                    continue

                self.stdout.write(
                    f"  {user.email} · {policy.shift_type.name} · "
                    f"+{accrual} (worked {worked} / {denom})"
                )
                if dry:
                    continue

                with transaction.atomic():
                    LeaveBalanceTransaction.objects.create(
                        balance=bal,
                        delta=accrual,
                        reason=LeaveBalanceTransaction.Reason.ACCRUAL,
                        application=None,
                        created_by=None,
                        note=f"Monthly accrual {month_start:%Y-%m}",
                    )
                    bal.accrued = F("accrued") + accrual
                    bal.save(update_fields=["accrued", "updated_at"])
                total_accrued += accrual
                affected += 1

        self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS(
            f"Done. {affected} balance row(s) updated; total +{total_accrued} day(s)."
        ))

"""(Re)seed LeavePolicy rows linked to existing LEAVE-category ShiftTypes.

The original migration ``0004_seed_policy_v2_data`` created policies via
``ShiftType.objects.get_or_create(name="Casual Leave")`` — works fine on
dev where ShiftTypes are named with the long form, but on production the
ShiftTypes use short codes (``CL``, ``AL``, ``SL``…). The migration ended
up creating *phantom* "Casual Leave" / "Sick Leave" rows separate from the
real "CL" / "SL" rows; when the phantoms were later cleaned up, every
``LeavePolicy`` cascade-deleted with them and the leave-application
dropdown went silent.

This command resolves the parent ShiftType by trying each alias in turn
(short code first, long form second) so it works across environments. It
``update_or_create``-s keyed on ``shift_type`` — re-running is a no-op
when nothing has changed.

Usage::

    manage.py seed_leave_policies --dry-run     # report only

Doesn't touch ABS / FL / GH / OFF / working ShiftTypes — those don't
have policies (Festival days run from Holiday rows, ABS was retired).
"""
