# FILE: ./accounts/management/commands/preprovision_sso_user.py
# ==========================================
"""Pre-provision a CustomUser row so they can sign in via Company SSO.

The default Orbis policy is `OIDC_CREATE_USER=False` — admin pre-creates
users; the OIDC backend just links to the existing row by email. This
command is the friendly way to do that one-liner, instead of dropping
into `manage.py shell` and writing ORM code by hand.

Profile fields (name, employee_id, jobTitle, department, manager, etc.)
are left blank intentionally — they get populated automatically from
Microsoft Graph the first time the user signs in. You only need to
provide the email.

Usage:
    manage.py preprovision_sso_user alice@sebpo.com
    manage.py preprovision_sso_user alice@sebpo.com --name "Alice Rahman"
    manage.py preprovision_sso_user alice@sebpo.com --employee-id E1234
    manage.py preprovision_sso_user --from-file emails.txt   # one email per line
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError

from accounts.models import CustomUser


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = "Pre-create a CustomUser row by email so they can sign in via SSO."

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument(
            "email",
            nargs="?",
            help="Email / UPN of the user to provision (e.g. alice@sebpo.com).",
        )
        parser.add_argument(
            "--name",
            help='Optional display name; will be split on first space into '
                 'first/last (e.g. "Alice Rahman").',
        )
        parser.add_argument(
            "--employee-id",
            help="Optional employee_id to set up-front; "
                 "otherwise pulled from Graph on first SSO login.",
        )
        parser.add_argument(
            "--from-file",
            help="Path to a text file with one email per line (lines starting "
                 "with # are ignored). Use this for bulk onboarding.",
        )

    def handle(self, *args, **opts):
        emails: list[str] = []
        name = (opts.get("name") or "").strip()
        employee_id = (opts.get("employee_id") or "").strip()

        if opts.get("from_file"):
            path = Path(opts["from_file"])
            if not path.is_file():
                raise CommandError(f"File not found: {path}")
            for raw in path.read_text().splitlines():
                line = raw.strip()
                if line and not line.startswith("#"):
                    emails.append(line)
            if not emails:
                raise CommandError(f"{path} contained no emails.")
            if name or employee_id:
                self.stdout.write(self.style.WARNING(
                    "--name / --employee-id ignored when using --from-file."
                ))
                name, employee_id = "", ""
        elif opts.get("email"):
            emails = [opts["email"].strip()]
        else:
            raise CommandError(
                "Provide either an email argument or --from-file."
            )

        first_name = last_name = ""
        if name:
            first_name, _, last_name = name.partition(" ")

        created_count = existed_count = 0
        for email in emails:
            email_norm = email.lower()
            user, created = CustomUser.objects.get_or_create(
                email__iexact=email_norm,
                defaults={
                    "email": email_norm,
                    "username": email_norm[:150],
                    "first_name": first_name,
                    "last_name": last_name,
                    "employee_id": employee_id or None,
                    "is_active": True,
                },
            )
            if created:
                user.set_unusable_password()
                user.save(update_fields=["password"])
                created_count += 1
                self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS(
                    f"  created  {email_norm}  (pk={user.pk})"
                ))
            else:
                existed_count += 1
                self.stdout.write(
                    f"  exists   {email_norm}  (pk={user.pk})"
                )

        self.stdout.write("")
        self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS(
            f"Done. {created_count} created, {existed_count} already existed."
        ))
        if created_count:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Provisioned users can now sign in via 'Sign in with Company SSO'. "
                "Their profile (name, employee_id, jobTitle, department, manager, "
                "etc.) will be populated from Microsoft Graph on first login."
            )

<div id="preview">
	<style>
		#preview iframe {
			width: 840px;
			height: 500px;
		}
	</style>

	<h2>Document preview (based on send HTML and CSS)</h2>
</div>

<script>
	exportPdfUtils.initManualTest();

	var editor = CKEDITOR.replace( 'editor', exportPdfUtils.getDefaultConfig( 'manual', {
		width: 840,
		height: 400
	} ) );

	editor.on( 'exportPdf', function( evt ) {
		var oldIframe = document.querySelector( '#preview iframe' ),
			html;

		if ( oldIframe && oldIframe.parentNode ) {
			oldIframe.parentNode.removeChild( oldIframe );
		}

		// Align iframe HTML with the one on the endpoint side by adding explicit encoding and DOCTYPE.
		html = '<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><style>' + evt.data.css + '</style><meta charset="UTF-8"></head><body>' + evt.data.html + '</body></html>';

		var iframe = document.createElement( 'iframe' );
		document.querySelector( '#preview' ).appendChild( iframe );
		iframe.contentWindow.document.open();
		iframe.contentWindow.document.write( html );
		iframe.contentWindow.document.close();
	}, null, null, 16 );
</script>

		width: 840,
		height: 400
	} ) );

	editor.on( 'exportPdf', function( evt ) {
		var oldIframe = document.querySelector( '#preview iframe' ),
			html;

		if ( oldIframe && oldIframe.parentNode ) {
			oldIframe.parentNode.removeChild( oldIframe );
		}

		// Align iframe HTML with the one on the endpoint side by adding explicit encoding and DOCTYPE.
		html = '<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><style>' + evt.data.css + '</style><meta charset="UTF-8"></head><body>' + evt.data.html + '</body></html>';

		var iframe = document.createElement( 'iframe' );
		document.querySelector( '#preview' ).appendChild( iframe );
		iframe.contentWindow.document.open();
		iframe.contentWindow.document.write( html );
		iframe.contentWindow.document.close();
	}, null, null, 16 );
</script>

<!DOCTYPE HTML PUBLIC "-//W3C//DTD HTML 4.01//EN" "http://www.w3.org/TR/html4/strict.dtd">

For licensing, see LICENSE.html or http://ckeditor.com/license

<html>
<head>
	<title></title>
	<meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=utf-8">
	<script type="text/javascript">

function gup( name )
{
	name = name.replace( /[\[]/, '\\\[' ).replace( /[\]]/, '\\\]' ) ;
	var regexS = '[\\?&]' + name + '=([^&#]*)' ;
	var regex = new RegExp( regexS ) ;
	var results = regex.exec( window.location.href ) ;

	if ( results )
		return results[ 1 ] ;
	else
		return '' ;
}

var interval;

function sendData2Master()
{
	var destination = window.parent.parent ;
	try
	{
		if ( destination.XDTMaster )
		{
			var t = destination.XDTMaster.read( [ gup( 'cmd' ), gup( 'data' ) ] ) ;
			window.clearInterval( interval ) ;
		}
	}
	catch (e) {}
}

function OnMessage (event) {
	        var message = event.data;
	        var destination = window.parent.parent;
	        destination.XDTMaster.read( [ 'end', message, 'fpm' ] ) ;
}

function listenPostMessage() {
    if (window.addEventListener) { // all browsers except IE before version 9
            window.addEventListener ("message", OnMessage, false);
    }else {
            if (window.attachEvent) { // IE before version 9
                        window.attachEvent("onmessage", OnMessage);
                }
        }
}

function onLoad()
{
	interval = window.setInterval( sendData2Master, 100 );
	listenPostMessage();
}

</script>
</head>
<body onload="onLoad()"><p></p></body>
</html>

function doLoadScript( url )
{
	if ( !url || typeof url !== 'string' )
		return false ;

	var s = document.createElement( "script" ) ;
	s.type = "text/javascript" ;
	s.src = url ;
	document.getElementsByTagName( "head" )[ 0 ].appendChild( s ) ;

	return true ;
}

var opener;
function tryLoad()
{
	opener = window.parent;

	// get access to global parameters
	var oParams = window.opener.oldFramesetPageParams;

	// make frameset rows string prepare
	var sFramesetRows = ( parseInt( oParams.firstframeh, 10 ) || '30') + ",*," + ( parseInt( oParams.thirdframeh, 10 ) || '150' ) + ',0' ;
	document.getElementById( 'itFrameset' ).rows = sFramesetRows ;

	// dynamic including init frames and crossdomain transport code
	// from config sproxy_js_frameset url
	var addScriptUrl = oParams.sproxy_js_frameset ;
	doLoadScript( addScriptUrl ) ;
}

	</script>
</head>

from employees.models import (
    Address,
    City,
    Client,

    Country,
    Division,
    Dose,

    Email,
    FamilyInfo,

    Relation,
    Religion,
    State,
    Vaccination,
    Vaccine,
)


# --- Taxonomy -------------------------------------------------------------

@admin.register(Country)
class CountryAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ("name", "iso_code", "is_active")
    list_filter = ("is_active",)
    search_fields = ("name", "iso_code")


@admin.register(Division)
class DivisionAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ("name", "country", "is_active")
    list_filter = ("is_active", "country")
    search_fields = ("name",)


@admin.register(State)
class StateAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ("name", "division", "country", "is_active")
    list_filter = ("is_active", "country", "division")
    search_fields = ("name",)


@admin.register(City)
class CityAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ("name", "state", "is_active")
    list_filter = ("is_active", "state")
    search_fields = ("name",)


class _SimpleTaxonomyAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ("name", "is_active")
    list_filter = ("is_active",)
    search_fields = ("name",)


@admin.register(Religion)
class ReligionAdmin(_SimpleTaxonomyAdmin):
    pass


@admin.register(Relation)
class RelationAdmin(_SimpleTaxonomyAdmin):
    pass


@admin.register(Vaccine)
class VaccineAdmin(_SimpleTaxonomyAdmin):
    pass


@admin.register(Dose)
class DoseAdmin(_SimpleTaxonomyAdmin):
    pass


@admin.register(Client)
class ClientAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ("name", "code", "is_active")
    list_filter = ("is_active",)
    search_fields = ("name", "code")


# --- Profile --------------------------------------------------------------

class _EmployeeAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ("employee", "updated_at")
    search_fields = ("employee__email", "employee__first_name", "employee__last_name")
    autocomplete_fields = ("employee",)
    readonly_fields = ("added_by", "added_at", "updated_by", "updated_at")

    def save_model(self, request, obj, form, change):
        if not change:
            obj.added_by = request.user
        obj.updated_by = request.user
        super().save_model(request, obj, form, change)


@admin.register(JobInfo)
class JobInfoAdmin(_EmployeeAdmin):
    list_display = ("employee", "resource_status", "billing_status", "reports_to")
    list_filter = ("resource_status", "billing_status")
    autocomplete_fields = ("employee", "reports_to")

# ==========================================
# FILE: ./employees/models.py
# ==========================================
"""HR profile + taxonomy models for Orbis.

All profile models FK to `accounts.CustomUser` via a field named `employee`.
Singletons use OneToOneField, repeating sections use ForeignKey.

Typos from ttms fixed on the way in per docs/PLAN.md:
- `ProfessionalCertification` (was `ProfessionalCertificatiion`)
- `height_in_inch` (was `hight_in_inch`)
- `resource_status` (was `resouce_status`)
"""

from datetime import date

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.db import models
from django.utils import timezone


def year_validator(value: int) -> None:
    current = date.today().year
    if value < 1900 or value > current:
        raise ValidationError(f"Year must be between 1900 and {current}.")


class _Auditable(models.Model):
    added_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name="+",
    )
    added_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    updated_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name="+",
    )
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        abstract = True


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Taxonomy
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Country(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=150, unique=True)
    iso_code = models.CharField(max_length=3, blank=True)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["name"]
        verbose_name_plural = "Countries"

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.name


class Division(models.Model):
    country = models.ForeignKey(Country, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="divisions")
    name = models.CharField(max_length=150)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["country__name", "name"]
        unique_together = [("country", "name")]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.name


class State(models.Model):
    country = models.ForeignKey(Country, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="states")
    division = models.ForeignKey(
        Division, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name="states"
    )
    name = models.CharField(max_length=150)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["country__name", "name"]
        unique_together = [("country", "name")]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.name


class City(models.Model):
    state = models.ForeignKey(State, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="cities")
    name = models.CharField(max_length=150)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["state__name", "name"]
        unique_together = [("state", "name")]
        verbose_name_plural = "Cities"

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.name


class Religion(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=150, unique=True)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["name"]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.name


class Relation(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=150, unique=True)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["name"]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.name


class Vaccine(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=150, unique=True)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["name"]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.name


class Dose(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=150, unique=True)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["name"]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.name


class Client(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=200, unique=True)
    code = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["name"]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.name


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Profile — singletons (OneToOne CustomUser)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class JobInfo(_Auditable):
    class ResourceStatus(models.TextChoices):
        BENCH = "BENCH", "Bench"
        LIVE = "LIVE", "Live"

    class BillingStatus(models.TextChoices):
        BILLABLE = "BILLABLE", "Billable"
        NON_BILLABLE = "NON_BILLABLE", "Non-Billable"

    employee = models.OneToOneField(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="job_info",
    )
    reports_to = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name="direct_reports",
    )
    resource_status = models.CharField(
        max_length=20, choices=ResourceStatus.choices, blank=True,
    )
    billing_status = models.CharField(
        max_length=20, choices=BillingStatus.choices, blank=True,
    )
    surviving_children_count = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField(
        default=0,
        help_text="Used by the Maternity Leave eligibility rule (must be < 2).",
    )
    note = models.TextField(blank=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = "Job info"
        verbose_name_plural = "Job info"

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.employee} — job info"


class PersonalInfo(_Auditable):
    class Gender(models.TextChoices):
        MALE = "M", "Male"
        FEMALE = "F", "Female"

    class BloodGroup(models.TextChoices):
        A_POS = "A+", "A+"
        A_NEG = "A-", "A-"
        B_POS = "B+", "B+"
        B_NEG = "B-", "B-"
        AB_POS = "AB+", "AB+"
        AB_NEG = "AB-", "AB-"
        O_POS = "O+", "O+"
        O_NEG = "O-", "O-"

    employee = models.OneToOneField(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="personal_info",
    )
    date_of_birth = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    gender = models.CharField(max_length=1, choices=Gender.choices, blank=True)
    religion = models.ForeignKey(
        Religion, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name="+",
    )
    height_in_inch = models.PositiveIntegerField(null=True, blank=True)
    weight_in_kg = models.PositiveIntegerField(null=True, blank=True)
    blood_group = models.CharField(max_length=3, choices=BloodGroup.choices, blank=True)
    identification_mark = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True)
    nationality = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, default="Bangladeshi")
    father_name = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True)
    mother_name = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True)
    note = models.TextField(blank=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = "Personal info"
        verbose_name_plural = "Personal info"

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.employee} — personal info"


class FamilyInfo(_Auditable):
    class MaritalStatus(models.TextChoices):
        MARRIED = "MARRIED", "Married"
        UNMARRIED = "UNMARRIED", "Unmarried"
        DIVORCED = "DIVORCED", "Divorced"
        WIDOW = "WIDOW", "Widow"
        WIDOWER = "WIDOWER", "Widower"

    employee = models.OneToOneField(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="family_info",
    )
    marital_status = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=MaritalStatus.choices, blank=True)
    spouse_name = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True)
    marriage_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    total_number_of_children = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField(default=0)
    note = models.TextField(blank=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = "Family info"
        verbose_name_plural = "Family info"

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.employee} — family info"


class LegalIssue(_Auditable):
    employee = models.OneToOneField(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="legal_issue",
    )
    has_history_of_drug_use = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    is_convicted = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    case_document = models.ImageField(upload_to="legal/", null=True, blank=True)
    note = models.TextField(blank=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = "Legal issue"
        verbose_name_plural = "Legal issues"

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.employee} — legal"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Profile — repeating (FK CustomUser)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Address(_Auditable):
    class AddressType(models.TextChoices):
        PERMANENT = "PERMANENT", "Permanent"
        PRESENT = "PRESENT", "Present"

    employee = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="addresses",
    )

"""Section registry — the single source of truth for CRUD-able profile sections.

URL dispatch, form selection, detail-page layout, and partial template lookup
all read from here. Add a section = 1 entry here + 1 form + 1 partial.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Type

from django.db import models as dj_models
from django.forms import ModelForm

from employees import forms as employee_forms
from employees import models as employee_models


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SectionSpec:
    slug: str
    model: Type[dj_models.Model]
    form: Type[ModelForm]
    is_singleton: bool
    icon: str              # lucide icon name
    label: str
    order: int
    partial: str           # filename within templates/employees/sections/

    @property
    def dom_id(self) -> str:
        """Card id on the detail page: replace with hx-swap-oob target."""
        return f"section-card-{self.slug}"


SECTIONS: dict[str, SectionSpec] = {
    spec.slug: spec for spec in [
        SectionSpec("jobinfo",       employee_models.JobInfo,                 employee_forms.JobInfoForm,                 True,  "briefcase",       "Job info",              10,  "_jobinfo.html"),
        SectionSpec("personal",      employee_models.PersonalInfo,            employee_forms.PersonalInfoForm,            True,  "user",            "Personal info",         20,  "_personal.html"),
        SectionSpec("family",        employee_models.FamilyInfo,              employee_forms.FamilyInfoForm,              True,  "heart",           "Family info",           30,  "_family.html"),
        SectionSpec("address",       employee_models.Address,                 employee_forms.AddressForm,                 False, "map-pin",         "Addresses",             40,  "_address.html"),
        SectionSpec("education",     employee_models.Education,               employee_forms.EducationForm,               False, "graduation-cap",  "Education",             50,  "_education.html"),
        SectionSpec("contact",       employee_models.Contact,                 employee_forms.ContactForm,                 False, "phone",           "Contacts",              60,  "_contact.html"),
        SectionSpec("nominee",       employee_models.Nominee,                 employee_forms.NomineeForm,                 False, "users",           "Nominees",              70,  "_nominee.html"),
        SectionSpec("email",         employee_models.Email,                   employee_forms.EmailForm,                   False, "mail",            "Emails",                80,  "_email.html"),
        SectionSpec("id-number",     employee_models.IdentificationNumber,    employee_forms.IdentificationNumberForm,    False, "badge-check",     "ID numbers",            90,  "_id_number.html"),
        SectionSpec("reference",     employee_models.Reference,               employee_forms.ReferenceForm,               False, "bookmark",        "References",            100, "_reference.html"),
        SectionSpec("certification", employee_models.ProfessionalCertification, employee_forms.ProfessionalCertificationForm, False, "award",    "Certifications",        110, "_certification.html"),
        SectionSpec("vaccination",   employee_models.Vaccination,             employee_forms.VaccinationForm,             False, "syringe",         "Vaccinations",          120, "_vaccination.html"),
        SectionSpec("legal",         employee_models.LegalIssue,              employee_forms.LegalIssueForm,              True,  "scale",           "Legal",                 130, "_legal.html"),
        SectionSpec("image",         employee_models.Image,                   employee_forms.ImageForm,                   False, "image",           "Photos & documents",    140, "_image.html"),
    ]
}


def ordered_sections() -> list[SectionSpec]:
    return sorted(SECTIONS.values(), key=lambda s: s.order)

from django.contrib import messages
from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
from django.contrib.auth.mixins import LoginRequiredMixin
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from django.db.models import Q
from django.http import Http404, HttpResponse, JsonResponse
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404, redirect, render
from django.template.loader import render_to_string
from django.urls import reverse
from django.views import View
from django.views.decorators.http import require_GET
from django.views.generic import DetailView, ListView

from accounts.models import CustomUser, Team
from accounts.permissions import (
    can_edit_employee_profile,
    can_edit_roster_pattern,
    can_view_employee,
    editable_section_slugs,
    visible_employees,
)
from employees.models import City, State
from employees.sections import SECTIONS, SectionSpec, ordered_sections


# Map section slug → related-attribute name on CustomUser
_SINGLETON_ATTR = {
    "jobinfo": "job_info",
    "personal": "personal_info",
    "family": "family_info",
    "legal": "legal_issue",
}
_REPEATING_ATTR = {
    "address": "addresses",
    "education": "educations",
    "contact": "contacts",
    "nominee": "nominees",
    "email": "extra_emails",
    "id-number": "id_numbers",
    "reference": "references",
    "certification": "certifications",
    "vaccination": "vaccinations",
    "image": "images",
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# List + detail
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class EmployeeListView(LoginRequiredMixin, ListView):
    model = CustomUser
    template_name = "employees/employee_list.html"
    context_object_name = "employees"
    paginate_by = 24
    extra_context = {"page_title": "Employees"}

    def get_queryset(self):
        qs = (
            visible_employees(self.request.user, request=self.request)
            .select_related(
                "department", "designation", "team", "subteam",
                "job_location", "work_location",
            )
        )
        q = self.request.GET.get("q", "").strip()
        if q:
            qs = qs.filter(
                Q(email__icontains=q)
                | Q(first_name__icontains=q)
                | Q(last_name__icontains=q)
                | Q(employee_id__icontains=q)
            )
        return qs.order_by("first_name", "last_name")


class EmployeeDetailView(LoginRequiredMixin, DetailView):
    model = CustomUser
    template_name = "employees/employee_detail.html"
    context_object_name = "employee"

    def get_queryset(self):
        return (
            CustomUser.objects
            .select_related(
                "department", "designation", "team", "subteam",
                "job_location", "work_location", "access_level",
            )
            .prefetch_related(
                "addresses__city", "addresses__state", "addresses__country",
                "educations",
                "contacts__relation_with_emergency_contact",
                "nominees__relation_with_nominee",
                "extra_emails", "id_numbers",
                "references__relation_with_reference",
                "certifications",
                "vaccinations__vaccine", "vaccinations__dose",
                "images",
            )
        )

    def get_object(self, queryset=None):
        obj = super().get_object(queryset)
        if not can_view_employee(self.request.user, obj, request=self.request):
            raise PermissionDenied("You can't view this employee.")
        return obj

    def get_context_data(self, **kwargs):
        from roster.models import Roster as RosterModel  # avoid circular import
        from leave.models import LeaveApplication

        ctx = super().get_context_data(**kwargs)
        employee = ctx["employee"]
        user = self.request.user

        sections = ordered_sections()
        ctx["sections"] = [_section_context(employee, spec) for spec in sections]

        # Per-section edit gating, computed once. Templates use
        # `{% if spec.slug in editable_section_slugs %}` for O(1) lookups
        # instead of calling can_edit_employee_profile per section.
        ctx["editable_section_slugs"] = editable_section_slugs(
            user, employee, sections, request=self.request,
        )

        weekday_labels = {
            0: "Monday", 1: "Tuesday", 2: "Wednesday", 3: "Thursday",
            4: "Friday", 5: "Saturday", 6: "Sunday",
        }
        pattern_rows_by_wd = {
            r.weekday: r for r in
            RosterModel.objects.filter(employee=employee).select_related("shift_type", "shift_attribute")
        }
        ctx["pattern_rows"] = [
            {
                "weekday": wd,
                "label": weekday_labels[wd],
                "shift_type": pattern_rows_by_wd[wd].shift_type if wd in pattern_rows_by_wd else None,
                "shift_attribute": pattern_rows_by_wd[wd].shift_attribute if wd in pattern_rows_by_wd else None,
            }
            for wd in range(7)
        ]
        ctx["can_edit_pattern"] = can_edit_roster_pattern(
            user, employee, request=self.request,
        )

        # Leave history — last 5 applications, visible to the applicant
        # themselves and anyone with view scope on this employee (already
        # enforced via can_view_employee, so always show when we got here).
        ctx["can_view_leaves"] = True
        ctx["recent_leaves"] = list(
            LeaveApplication.objects
            .filter(employee=employee)
            .select_related("leave_type")
            .order_by("-applied_at")[:5]
        )

        # Separation card (view-only; offboarding-owned). Returns {} when the
        # employee has no resignation and no LWD → template renders nothing.
        from offboarding.services import build_separation_card_context
        ctx["separation_card"] = build_separation_card_context(
            employee, request=self.request,
        )

        ctx["page_title"] = employee.display_name
        return ctx


def _section_context(employee, spec: SectionSpec) -> dict:
    if spec.is_singleton:
        obj = getattr(employee, _SINGLETON_ATTR[spec.slug], None)
        return {"spec": spec, "object": obj, "rows": []}
    rows = list(getattr(employee, _REPEATING_ATTR[spec.slug]).all())
    return {"spec": spec, "object": None, "rows": rows}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Section CRUD (htmx-aware + full-page fallback)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _get_spec(slug: str) -> SectionSpec:
    try:
        return SECTIONS[slug]
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise Http404(f"Unknown section: {slug}") from exc


def _render_section_card(request, employee, spec: SectionSpec) -> str:
    ctx = _section_context(employee, spec)
    ctx["employee"] = employee
    ctx["oob"] = True
    # Without this, the OOB-swapped card loses the per-section edit-button
    # gating that the parent template provided.
    ctx["editable_section_slugs"] = editable_section_slugs(
        request.user, employee, [spec], request=request,
    )
    return render_to_string("employees/_section_card.html", ctx, request=request)


def _drawer_title(spec: SectionSpec, employee, row=None) -> str:
    if spec.is_singleton:
        return spec.label
    verb = "Edit" if row else "Add"
    return f"{verb} {spec.label.rstrip('s').lower()}"


class SectionEditView(LoginRequiredMixin, View):
    """Handles singleton-edit, repeating-add, and repeating-edit-row.

    Permission: any authenticated user can hit the URL; the section is
    saveable only if `can_edit_employee_profile(user, target, section=...)`
    is True. Self-edit is allowed for personal-data sections; JobInfo is
    HR/manager-only.
    """

    http_method_names = ["get", "post"]

    def dispatch(self, request, pk, section, row_pk=None, *args, **kwargs):
        self.employee = get_object_or_404(CustomUser, pk=pk)
        self.spec = _get_spec(section)
        self.row_pk = row_pk
        if self.spec.is_singleton and row_pk is not None:
            raise Http404("Singleton section doesn't take a row_pk.")
        if not can_edit_employee_profile(
            request.user, self.employee,
            section=self.spec.model.__name__, request=request,
        ):
            raise PermissionDenied("You can't edit this section.")
        return super().dispatch(request, *args, **kwargs)

    def _get_instance(self):
        if self.spec.is_singleton:
            obj, _ = self.spec.model.objects.get_or_create(employee=self.employee)
            return obj
        if self.row_pk is not None:
            return get_object_or_404(self.spec.model, pk=self.row_pk, employee=self.employee)
        return None

    def _action_url(self):
        if self.spec.is_singleton:
            return reverse("section_edit", args=[self.employee.pk, self.spec.slug])
        if self.row_pk is not None:
            return reverse("section_edit_row", args=[self.employee.pk, self.spec.slug, self.row_pk])
        return reverse("section_add", args=[self.employee.pk, self.spec.slug])

    def get(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        instance = self._get_instance()
        form = self.spec.form(instance=instance)
        row = instance if (not self.spec.is_singleton and self.row_pk) else None
        title = _drawer_title(self.spec, self.employee, row)
        return self._render(request, form, title)

    def post(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        instance = self._get_instance()
        form = self.spec.form(request.POST, request.FILES, instance=instance)
        if form.is_valid():
            obj = form.save(commit=False)
            obj.employee = self.employee
            if hasattr(obj, "updated_by"):
                obj.updated_by = request.user
                if not obj.pk:
                    obj.added_by = request.user
            obj.save()
            form.save_m2m()
            return self._success(request)
        row = instance if (not self.spec.is_singleton and self.row_pk) else None
        title = _drawer_title(self.spec, self.employee, row)
        return self._render(request, form, title)

    def _render(self, request, form, title):
        ctx = {
            "form": form, "spec": self.spec, "employee": self.employee,
            "action_url": self._action_url(),
            "drawer_title": title, "page_title": f"{title} — {self.employee.display_name}",
        }
        template = "employees/_drawer.html" if request.htmx else "employees/section_form_page.html"
        return render(request, template, ctx)

    def _success(self, request):
        if request.htmx:
            card_html = _render_section_card(request, self.employee, self.spec)
            response = HttpResponse(card_html)
            response["HX-Trigger"] = "orbis:drawer-close"
            return response
        messages.success(request, f"{self.spec.label} saved.")
        return redirect("employee_detail", pk=self.employee.pk)


class SectionDeleteView(LoginRequiredMixin, View):
    http_method_names = ["get", "post"]

    def dispatch(self, request, pk, section, row_pk, *args, **kwargs):
        self.employee = get_object_or_404(CustomUser, pk=pk)
        self.spec = _get_spec(section)
        if self.spec.is_singleton:
            raise Http404("Singleton sections are not deletable.")
        self.row = get_object_or_404(self.spec.model, pk=row_pk, employee=self.employee)
        if not can_edit_employee_profile(
            request.user, self.employee,
            section=self.spec.model.__name__, request=request,
        ):
            raise PermissionDenied("You can't delete this row.")
        return super().dispatch(request, *args, **kwargs)

    def get(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        ctx = {
            "spec": self.spec, "employee": self.employee, "row": self.row,
            "action_url": reverse("section_delete_row",
                                   args=[self.employee.pk, self.spec.slug, self.row.pk]),
            "drawer_title": f"Delete {self.spec.label.rstrip('s').lower()}",
            "page_title": f"Delete {self.spec.label.rstrip('s').lower()} — {self.employee.display_name}",
        }
        template = ("employees/_drawer_confirm_delete.html" if request.htmx
                    else "employees/section_confirm_delete.html")
        return render(request, template, ctx)

    def post(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        self.row.delete()
        if request.htmx:
            card_html = _render_section_card(request, self.employee, self.spec)
            response = HttpResponse(card_html)
            response["HX-Trigger"] = "orbis:drawer-close"
            return response
        messages.success(request, f"{self.spec.label} row deleted.")
        return redirect("employee_detail", pk=self.employee.pk)

@login_required
@require_GET
def load_states(request):
    country_id = request.GET.get("country")
    rows = State.objects.filter(country_id=country_id, is_active=True).order_by("name")
    return JsonResponse({"results": [{"id": r.pk, "label": r.name} for r in rows]})


@login_required
@require_GET
def load_cities(request):
    state_id = request.GET.get("state")
    rows = City.objects.filter(state_id=state_id, is_active=True).order_by("name")
    return JsonResponse({"results": [{"id": r.pk, "label": r.name} for r in rows]})


@login_required
@require_GET
def load_teams(request):
    dept_id = request.GET.get("department")
    rows = Team.objects.filter(department_id=dept_id, is_active=True).order_by("name")
    return JsonResponse({"results": [{"id": r.pk, "label": r.name} for r in rows]})


@login_required
@require_GET
def load_employees(request):
    q = request.GET.get("q", "").strip()
    qs = CustomUser.objects.filter(is_active=True)
    if q:
        qs = qs.filter(
            Q(email__icontains=q)
            | Q(first_name__icontains=q)
            | Q(last_name__icontains=q)
            | Q(employee_id__icontains=q)
        )
    qs = qs.order_by("first_name", "last_name")[:25]
    return JsonResponse({
        "results": [
            {"id": str(u.pk), "label": u.display_name, "email": u.email}
            for u in qs
        ]
    })


# ==========================================
# FILE: ./employees/forms.py
# ==========================================
"""ModelForms for every editable section. `employee` is excluded — views inject it."""

from django import forms

from core.forms import StyledMixin
from employees.models import (
    Address,
    Contact,
    Education,
    Email,
    FamilyInfo,
    IdentificationNumber,
    Image,
    JobInfo,
    LegalIssue,
    Nominee,
    PersonalInfo,
    ProfessionalCertification,
    Reference,
    Vaccination,
)


class _Base(forms.ModelForm, StyledMixin):
    """Every section form excludes `employee` + applies the theme styling."""

    _date_fields: tuple[str, ...] = ()

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        for name in self._date_fields:
            if name in self.fields:
                self.fields[name].widget = forms.DateInput(
                    attrs={
                        "type": "text",
                        "placeholder": "YYYY-MM-DD",
                        "data-flatpickr": "",
                        "autocomplete": "off",
                        "pattern": r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}",
                    },
                    format="%Y-%m-%d",
                )
                self.fields[name].input_formats = ["%Y-%m-%d"]
        self.style_widgets()


# --- singletons ----------------------------------------------------------

class JobInfoForm(_Base):
    class Meta:
        model = JobInfo
        fields = ("reports_to", "resource_status", "billing_status", "note")


class PersonalInfoForm(_Base):
    _date_fields = ("date_of_birth",)

    class Meta:
        model = PersonalInfo
        fields = (
            "date_of_birth", "gender", "religion",
            "height_in_inch", "weight_in_kg", "blood_group",
            "nationality", "identification_mark",
            "father_name", "mother_name", "note",
        )


class FamilyInfoForm(_Base):
    _date_fields = ("marriage_date",)

    class Meta:
        model = FamilyInfo
        fields = (
            "marital_status", "spouse_name", "marriage_date",
            "total_number_of_children", "note",
        )


class LegalIssueForm(_Base):
    class Meta:
        model = LegalIssue
        fields = ("has_history_of_drug_use", "is_convicted", "case_document", "note")


# --- repeating ----------------------------------------------------------

class AddressForm(_Base):
    class Meta:
        model = Address
        fields = (
            "address_type", "flat_no", "holding_no",
            "village_area", "post_office", "union_name", "post_code",
            "country", "state", "city",
        )


class EducationForm(_Base):
    class Meta:
        model = Education
        fields = (
            "degree_level", "degree_name", "major",
            "result", "result_details", "passing_year",
            "academic_institution", "institution_category", "note",
        )


class ContactForm(_Base):
    class Meta:
        model = Contact
        fields = (
            "contact_type", "contact_number",
            "emergency_contact_name", "relation_with_emergency_contact",
            "emergency_contact_address", "note",
        )


class NomineeForm(_Base):
    class Meta:
        model = Nominee
        fields = (
            "nominee_name", "relation_with_nominee",
            "nominee_occupation", "nominee_contact_number", "note",
        )


class EmailForm(_Base):
    class Meta:
        model = Email
        fields = ("email_type", "email_address")


class IdentificationNumberForm(_Base):
    class Meta:
        model = IdentificationNumber
        fields = ("id_type", "id_number")


class ReferenceForm(_Base):
    class Meta:
        model = Reference
        fields = (
            "reference_type", "reference_name", "reference_contact_number",
            "relation_with_reference",
            "reference_organization", "reference_designation",
            "reference_email_address",
        )


class ProfessionalCertificationForm(_Base):
    class Meta:
        model = ProfessionalCertification
        fields = ("certificate_name", "certificate_institution", "certificate_year")


class VaccinationForm(_Base):
    _date_fields = ("taken_date",)

    class Meta:
        model = Vaccination
        fields = ("vaccine", "dose", "taken_date")


class ImageForm(_Base):
    class Meta:
        model = Image
        fields = ("image", "caption")

from django.urls import path

from employees import views

urlpatterns = [
    path("", views.EmployeeListView.as_view(), name="employee_list"),
    path("<uuid:pk>/", views.EmployeeDetailView.as_view(), name="employee_detail"),

    # Singleton edit (no row_pk) + repeating edit (with row_pk)
    path("<uuid:pk>/edit/<slug:section>/",
         views.SectionEditView.as_view(), name="section_edit"),
    path("<uuid:pk>/edit/<slug:section>/<int:row_pk>/",
         views.SectionEditView.as_view(), name="section_edit_row"),
    path("<uuid:pk>/add/<slug:section>/",
         views.SectionEditView.as_view(), name="section_add"),
    path("<uuid:pk>/delete/<slug:section>/<int:row_pk>/",
         views.SectionDeleteView.as_view(), name="section_delete_row"),

    # AJAX
    path("ajax/states/",    views.load_states,    name="ajax_load_states"),
    path("ajax/cities/",    views.load_cities,    name="ajax_load_cities"),
    path("ajax/teams/",     views.load_teams,     name="ajax_load_teams"),
    path("ajax/employees/", views.load_employees, name="ajax_load_employees"),
]

<script>
    (function () {
        var sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');

        // Attach CSRF token to every htmx request. Reads from the cookie
        // so it works even on pages without a server-rendered form.
        function csrfCookie() {
            var m = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)csrftoken=([^;]+)/);
            return m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : '';
        }
        document.body.addEventListener('htmx:configRequest', function (evt) {
            evt.detail.headers['X-CSRFToken'] = csrfCookie();
        });

        // Re-render lucide icons + re-init Flatpickr after htmx swaps.
        document.body.addEventListener('htmx:afterSettle', function (evt) {
            if (window.lucide) window.lucide.createIcons();
            wireFlatpickr(evt.target || document);
        });

        // Attach Flatpickr to every [data-flatpickr] input. ISO format only.
        // Click anywhere on the input to open the calendar.
        function wireFlatpickr(root) {
            if (!window.flatpickr) return;
            var inputs = (root || document).querySelectorAll('input[data-flatpickr]');
            inputs.forEach(function (el) {
                if (el._flatpickr) return;
                flatpickr(el, {
                    dateFormat: "Y-m-d",
                    allowInput: true,
                });
            });
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            if (window.lucide) window.lucide.createIcons();
            wireFlatpickr(document);

            var themeBtn = document.getElementById('theme-toggle');
            if (themeBtn) {
                themeBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    var root = document.documentElement;
                    root.classList.toggle('dark');
                    localStorage.setItem('orbis-theme', root.classList.contains('dark') ? 'dark' : 'light');
                    if (window.lucide) window.lucide.createIcons();
                });
            }

            // Sidebar hover flyouts. Sidebar is always narrow (4rem) so every
            // icon has a flyout that pops out on hover/focus. position:fixed
            // (set by JS) escapes the parent aside's overflow-hidden. A
            // 120ms hide-debounce bridges the 4px gap between icon + panel.
            (function initSidebarFlyouts() {
                if (!sidebar) return;
                sidebar.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-group').forEach(function (group) {
                    var trigger = group.querySelector('.nav-item');
                    var flyout = group.querySelector('.sidebar-flyout');
                    if (!trigger || !flyout) return;

                    var hideTimer = null;
                    function show() {
                        clearTimeout(hideTimer);
                        var rect = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
                        flyout.style.position = 'fixed';
                        flyout.style.top = rect.top + 'px';
                        flyout.style.left = (rect.right + 4) + 'px';
                        flyout.style.display = 'block';
                    }
                    function scheduleHide() {
                        clearTimeout(hideTimer);
                        hideTimer = setTimeout(function () {
                            flyout.style.display = '';
                            flyout.style.position = '';
                            flyout.style.top = '';
                            flyout.style.left = '';
                        }, 120);
                    }
                    function cancelHide() { clearTimeout(hideTimer); }

                    group.addEventListener('mouseenter', show);
                    group.addEventListener('mouseleave', scheduleHide);
                    flyout.addEventListener('mouseenter', cancelHide);
                    flyout.addEventListener('mouseleave', scheduleHide);
                    group.addEventListener('focusin', show);
                    group.addEventListener('focusout', scheduleHide);
                });
            })();
        });
    })();
</script>

    <div class="lg:col-span-1">
        <div class="card sticky top-4">
            <h2 class="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-text-mute mb-3">Preview</h2>
            <div id="leave-preview" class="text-sm space-y-3">
                <p class="text-text-mute italic">Pick a leave type and dates to see the cost breakdown.</p>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
    const form = document.getElementById("leave-apply-form");
    if (!form) return;
    const previewUrl = form.dataset.previewUrl;
    const target = form.querySelector('[name="leave_type"]');
    const start = form.querySelector('[name="start_date"]');
    const end = form.querySelector('[name="end_date"]');
    const halfDay = form.querySelector('[name="is_half_day"]');
    const halfWrap = document.getElementById("half-day-period-wrap");
    const out = document.getElementById("leave-preview");

    function fmt(n) {
        const v = parseFloat(n || "0");
        return Number.isInteger(v) ? v.toFixed(0) : v.toFixed(2);
    }

    function refresh() {
        if (halfDay) {
            halfWrap.classList.toggle("hidden", !halfDay.checked);
        }
        if (!target.value || !start.value || !end.value) {
            out.innerHTML = '<p class="text-text-mute italic">Pick a leave type and dates to see the cost breakdown.</p>';
            return;
        }
        const fd = new FormData();
        fd.append("leave_type", target.value);
        fd.append("start_date", start.value);
        fd.append("end_date", end.value);
        if (halfDay && halfDay.checked) fd.append("is_half_day", "true");
        const forPk = form.dataset.for;
        if (forPk) fd.append("for", forPk);
        const csrf = form.querySelector('[name=csrfmiddlewaretoken]').value;
        fetch(previewUrl, {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "X-CSRFToken": csrf },
            body: fd,
        }).then(r => r.json()).then(data => {
            if (data.error) {
                out.innerHTML = '<p class="text-red-600 dark:text-red-300 text-sm">' + data.error + '</p>';
                return;
            }
            const certNotice = data.cert_required
                ? `<div class="mt-3 text-xs px-2 py-1.5 rounded bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-200 dark:border-amber-500/30">Attachment (e.g., doctor's note) required for ${data.leave_type_name} of ${data.cert_required_min_days}+ days.</div>`
                : "";
            const balanceNotice = data.is_paid
                ? `<div class="mt-3 text-xs text-text-mute">Available balance: <strong>${fmt(data.available)}</strong> day(s) (${data.year}).</div>`
                : `<div class="mt-3 text-xs text-text-mute">Unpaid leave — no balance impact.</div>`;
            out.innerHTML = `
                <dl class="space-y-2">
                    <div class="flex justify-between"><dt class="text-text-mute">Working days</dt><dd>${fmt(data.working)}</dd></div>
                    <div class="flex justify-between"><dt class="text-text-mute">Sandwich days</dt><dd>${fmt(data.sandwich)}</dd></div>
                    <div class="flex justify-between border-t border-bg-soft dark:border-white/10 pt-2 font-semibold">
                        <dt>Billed</dt><dd>${fmt(data.total)}</dd>
                    </div>
                </dl>
                ${certNotice}
                ${balanceNotice}
            `;
        }).catch(() => {
            out.innerHTML = '<p class="text-text-mute italic">Could not compute preview.</p>';
        });
    }

    [target, start, end, halfDay].forEach(el => {
        if (!el) return;
        el.addEventListener("change", refresh);
        el.addEventListener("input", refresh);
    });
    refresh();
})();
</script>
{% endblock %}

# ==========================================
# FILE: ./templates/leave/_row.html
# ==========================================
{% comment %}
    Context:
      row                 LeaveApplication
      current_user_pk     UUID — to decide whether to show self-cancel vs approve
      oob                 True on out-of-band replace after htmx action
      show_actions        whether to render the inline approve/decline form
      user_can_edit_all   True if viewer is HR / User Admins / superuser —
                          when True, inline approve appears even on the viewer's own rows.
                          Senior Leadership has see-all but NOT edit-all and is intentionally
                          excluded.
{% endcomment %}
<tr id="leave-row-{{ row.pk }}"
    {% if oob %}hx-swap-oob="true"{% endif %}>
    <td>
        <a href="{% url 'leave_detail' row.pk %}" class="font-medium text-brand hover:underline dark:text-brand-accent">

# ==========================================
# FILE: ./templates/roster/_cell.html
# ==========================================
{% load roster_tags %}
{% comment %}
    Context:
      employee      CustomUser
      date          date
      shift         Shift instance or None
      holiday       Holiday instance or None
      shift_types   list of active ShiftType (with .attributes prefetched)
      filter_qs     querystring appended to hx-post URL
      oob           True on OOB replacement

    Option value scheme (single select, dispatched server-side):
      shift_ref:
        ""               → clear the cell
        "type:<pk>"      → shift_type alone (ShiftType.has_attribute == False)
        "attr:<pk>"      → specific attribute (ShiftType.has_attribute == True)
      location_ref:
        ""               → use employee default (no per-day override)
        "MHK"/"MBD"/"RAOWA"/"WFH" → set per-day office/mode
{% endcomment %}
<td id="cell-{{ employee.pk }}-{{ date|date:'Ymd' }}"
    {% if oob %}hx-swap-oob="true"{% endif %}
    class="p-0 align-top">
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-1">
        <form>
            {% csrf_token %}
            <select name="shift_ref"
                    hx-post="{% url 'roster_cell_update' employee.pk date|date:'Y-m-d' %}{% if filter_qs %}?{{ filter_qs }}{% endif %}"
                    hx-trigger="change"
                    hx-target="#cell-{{ employee.pk }}-{{ date|date:'Ymd' }}"
                    hx-swap="outerHTML"
                    class="form-input text-xs py-1.5 rounded-none border-0 w-full bg-transparent focus:bg-bg-soft dark:focus:bg-white/5">
                <option value="">—</option>
                {% regroup shift_types by get_category_display as grouped %}
                {% for group in grouped %}
                    <optgroup label="{{ group.grouper }}">
                        {% for st in group.list %}
                            {% if st.has_attribute %}
                                {% for attr in st.attributes.all %}
                                    <option value="attr:{{ attr.pk }}"
                                            {% if shift.shift_attribute_id == attr.pk %}selected{% endif %}>
                                        {{ attr.name }}
                                    </option>
                                {% endfor %}
                            {% else %}
                                <option value="type:{{ st.pk }}"
                                        {% if shift and shift.shift_type_id == st.pk and not shift.shift_attribute_id %}selected{% endif %}>
                                    {{ st.name }}{% if st.shift_start_time %} ({{ st.shift_start_time|date:"H:i" }}–{{ st.shift_end_time|date:"H:i" }}){% endif %}
                                </option>
                            {% endif %}
                        {% endfor %}
                    </optgroup>
                {% endfor %}
            </select>
        </form>
        {% if shift %}
            {% resolved_location_choice shift employee as cell_loc %}
            <form>
                {% csrf_token %}
                <select name="location_ref"
                        hx-post="{% url 'roster_cell_update' employee.pk date|date:'Y-m-d' %}{% if filter_qs %}?{{ filter_qs }}{% endif %}"
                        hx-trigger="change"
                        hx-target="#cell-{{ employee.pk }}-{{ date|date:'Ymd' }}"
                        hx-swap="outerHTML"
                        class="form-input text-xs py-1.5 rounded-none border-0 w-full bg-transparent focus:bg-bg-soft dark:focus:bg-white/5
                               {% if cell_loc == 'WFH' %}text-brand-blue
                               {% elif cell_loc %}text-brand-accent
                               {% else %}text-text-mute
                               {% endif %}">
                    <option value="MHK"   {% if cell_loc == 'MHK' %}selected{% endif %}>MHK</option>
                    <option value="MBD"   {% if cell_loc == 'MBD' %}selected{% endif %}>MBD</option>
                    <option value="RAOWA" {% if cell_loc == 'RAOWA' %}selected{% endif %}>RAOWA</option>
                    <option value="WFH"   {% if cell_loc == 'WFH' %}selected{% endif %}>WFH</option>
                </select>
            </form>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
    {% if not shift and holiday %}
        <div class="text-[10px] text-brand-blue px-2 pb-1 truncate" title="{{ holiday.name }}">
            Holiday: {{ holiday.name }}
        </div>
    {% endif %}
</td>

# ==========================================
# FILE: ./templates/employees/employee_detail.html
# ==========================================
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}{{ employee.display_name }} · Employees · Orbis{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div x-data="{
        drawer: false,
        drawerTitle: '',
        open(title) { this.drawerTitle = title || ''; this.drawer = true; },
        close() {
            this.drawer = false;
            this.drawerTitle = '';
            // Blank the drawer body so the next 'Add'/'Edit' click can never
            // momentarily show stale form contents from the previous open
            // while htmx is still fetching the new form. Without this the
            // previously-submitted form persists in the DOM (hidden by
            // x-show) and reappears the instant the drawer is reopened.
            const body = document.getElementById('drawer-body');
            if (body) body.innerHTML = '';
        },
     }"
     x-on:orbis:drawer-close.window="close()"
     x-on:keydown.escape.window="close()">

    {# --- Hero --- #}
    <div class="card mb-6 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center gap-4">
        <div class="w-20 h-20 rounded-full bg-brand-accent/20 flex items-center justify-center text-brand font-semibold text-2xl shrink-0">
            {% if employee.profile_picture %}
                <img src="{{ employee.profile_picture.url }}" alt="" class="w-20 h-20 rounded-full object-cover">
            {% else %}
                {{ employee.first_name|default:employee.email|slice:":1"|upper }}{{ employee.last_name|slice:":1"|upper }}
            {% endif %}
        </div>
        <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <h1 class="text-2xl font-semibold text-text-main dark:text-white truncate">{{ employee.display_name }}</h1>
            <div class="text-sm text-text-soft dark:text-white/60 mt-1">
                {{ employee.designation|default:"—" }}{% if employee.department %} · {{ employee.department }}{% endif %}
            </div>
            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3 mt-3 text-xs text-text-soft dark:text-white/60">
                {% if employee.employee_id %}<span class="badge badge-info"><i data-lucide="hash" class="w-3 h-3"></i>{{ employee.employee_id }}</span>{% endif %}
                <span class="badge badge-muted"><i data-lucide="mail" class="w-3 h-3"></i>{{ employee.email }}</span>
                {% if employee.contact_number %}<span class="badge badge-muted"><i data-lucide="phone" class="w-3 h-3"></i>{{ employee.contact_number }}</span>{% endif %}
                {% if employee.job_location %}<span class="badge badge-muted"><i data-lucide="map-pin" class="w-3 h-3"></i>{{ employee.job_location }}</span>{% endif %}
                {% if employee.is_active %}
                    <span class="badge badge-success"><i data-lucide="check" class="w-3 h-3"></i>Active</span>
                {% else %}
                    <span class="badge badge-muted"><i data-lucide="x" class="w-3 h-3"></i>Disabled</span>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="flex gap-2 shrink-0">
            {% if request.user.is_staff %}
                <a href="{% url 'user_update' employee.pk %}" class="btn-secondary">
                    <i data-lucide="pencil" class="w-4 h-4"></i><span>Edit basic info</span>
                </a>
            {% endif %}
            <a href="{% url 'employee_list' %}" class="btn-secondary">
                <i data-lucide="arrow-left" class="w-4 h-4"></i><span>Back</span>
            </a>
        </div>
    </div>

    {# --- Sections --- #}
    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 2xl:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {% include "offboarding/sections/_separation.html" with employee=employee data=separation_card %}
        {% for section in sections %}
            {% include "employees/_section_card.html" with spec=section.spec object=section.object rows=section.rows employee=employee oob=False %}
        {% endfor %}
        {% include "employees/sections/_roster_pattern.html" %}
        {% include "employees/sections/_leave_history.html" %}
    </div>

    {# --- Drawer shell --- #}
    <template x-teleport="body">
        <div x-show="drawer" x-cloak>
            <div class="drawer-backdrop"
                 x-show="drawer"
                 x-transition.opacity
                 @click="close()"></div>
            <div class="drawer-panel"
                 x-show="drawer"
                 x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-200"
                 x-transition:enter-start="translate-x-full"
                 x-transition:enter-end="translate-x-0"
                 x-transition:leave="transition ease-in duration-150"
                 x-transition:leave-start="translate-x-0"
                 x-transition:leave-end="translate-x-full">
                <div class="drawer-header">
                    <h2 class="text-base font-semibold text-text-main dark:text-white truncate" x-text="drawerTitle">&nbsp;</h2>
                    <button type="button" @click="close()"
                            class="p-1.5 rounded hover:bg-bg-soft dark:hover:bg-white/5 text-text-soft dark:text-white/60">
                        <i data-lucide="x" class="w-4 h-4"></i>
                    </button>
                </div>
                <div id="drawer-body" class="contents"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </template>
</div>
{% endblock %}

# FILE: ./templates/employees/_section_card.html
# ==========================================
{% comment %}
    spec                       SectionSpec
    object                     singleton instance (or None)
    rows                       list of repeating rows (empty for singleton)
    employee                   CustomUser
    oob                        Legacy flag — was used to mark the post-save card
                               as an htmx out-of-band fragment. Now ignored: the
                               form in _drawer.html already targets this card by
                               id with `hx-target="#section-card-X" hx-swap="outerHTML"`,
                               so a regular swap is enough. Marking the response as
                               OOB caused the new Add button NOT to be wired up
                               for the second click — HTMX processes regular-
                               swapped content reliably, OOB-only responses less so
                               on this version.
    editable_section_slugs     set of section slugs the viewer is allowed to edit;
                               provided by EmployeeDetailView. Falls back to empty
                               set on the post-save re-render path.
{% endcomment %}

     id="section-card-{{ spec.slug }}">

            <h3 class="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-text-mute">{{ spec.label }}</h3>
        </div>
        {% if spec.slug in editable_section_slugs %}
            {% if spec.is_singleton %}
                <button type="button"
                        class="text-xs text-brand hover:underline dark:text-brand-accent inline-flex items-center gap-1"
                        hx-get="{% url 'section_edit' employee.pk spec.slug %}"
                        hx-target="#drawer-body"
                        hx-swap="innerHTML"
                        @click="open('{{ spec.label|escapejs }}')">
                    <i data-lucide="pencil" class="w-3.5 h-3.5"></i>Edit
                </button>
            {% else %}
                <button type="button"
                        class="text-xs text-brand hover:underline dark:text-brand-accent inline-flex items-center gap-1"
                        hx-get="{% url 'section_add' employee.pk spec.slug %}"
                        hx-target="#drawer-body"
                        hx-swap="innerHTML"
                        @click="open('Add {{ spec.label|cut:'s'|lower|escapejs }}')">
                    <i data-lucide="plus" class="w-3.5 h-3.5"></i>Add
                </button>
            {% endif %}
        {% endif %}
    </div>

    {% include "employees/sections/"|add:spec.partial %}
</div>

# ==========================================
# FILE: ./templates/documents/_drawer_request.html
# ==========================================
{% comment %}
Drawer body for a new request. Posts via htmx; success returns 204 with
`HX-Trigger: orbis:drawer-close` + `HX-Redirect: <request_detail>`, so the
employee lands straight on the new request's page.
{% endcomment %}
<form method="post" action="{{ action_url }}"
      hx-post="{{ action_url }}"
      class="flex flex-col h-full">
  {% csrf_token %}

  <div class="drawer-body space-y-4">
    {% if form.non_field_errors %}
      <div class="rounded border border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-700 px-3 py-2 text-sm">
        {{ form.non_field_errors|striptags }}
      </div>
    {% endif %}
    {% for field in form %}
      <div>
        <label class="text-sm font-medium text-text-main dark:text-white block mb-1">{{ field.label }}</label>
        {{ field }}
        {% if field.help_text %}
          <p class="text-xs text-text-soft dark:text-white/60 mt-1">{{ field.help_text }}</p>
        {% endif %}
        {% if field.errors %}
          <p class="text-xs text-red-600 mt-1">{{ field.errors|join:" " }}</p>
        {% endif %}
      </div>
    {% endfor %}
  </div>

  <div class="drawer-footer justify-end">
    <button type="button" class="btn-secondary" @click="close()">Cancel</button>
    <button type="submit" class="btn-primary">
      <i data-lucide="send" class="w-4 h-4"></i><span>Submit</span>
    </button>
  </div>
</form>

# ==========================================
# FILE: ./templates/offboarding/_drawer_form_body.html
# ==========================================
{% comment %}
Shared drawer body shape used by resignation_submit, resignation_decide,
resignation_hr_edit, clearance_step, asset_return, note_add — anything
that's just a stack of form fields + cancel/submit footer.

Extra slot tag `{{ extra_top|safe }}` is optional context for views that
want to inject (e.g.) a static "employee summary" block above the form.
{% endcomment %}
<form method="post" action="{{ action_url }}"
      hx-post="{{ action_url }}"
      enctype="multipart/form-data"
      class="flex flex-col h-full">
  {% csrf_token %}

  <div class="drawer-body space-y-4">
    {% if extra_top %}<div class="text-sm">{{ extra_top|safe }}</div>{% endif %}

    {% if form.non_field_errors %}
      <div class="rounded border border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-700 px-3 py-2 text-sm">
        {{ form.non_field_errors|striptags }}
      </div>
    {% endif %}

    {% for field in form %}
      <div>
        <label class="text-sm font-medium block mb-1">{{ field.label }}</label>
        {{ field }}
        {% if field.help_text %}
          <p class="text-xs text-text-soft dark:text-white/60 mt-1">{{ field.help_text }}</p>
        {% endif %}
        {% if field.errors %}
          <p class="text-xs text-red-600 mt-1">{{ field.errors|join:" " }}</p>
        {% endif %}
      </div>
    {% endfor %}
  </div>

  <div class="drawer-footer justify-end">
    <button type="button" class="btn-secondary" @click="close()">Cancel</button>
    <button type="submit" class="btn-primary">
      <i data-lucide="check" class="w-4 h-4"></i><span>{{ submit_label|default:"Save" }}</span>
    </button>
  </div>
</form>

"""Django admin for the documents app.

CompanyBranding is locked to a single row. TemplateDesign / MessageTemplate
admins surface bleach sanitisation warnings via ``messages.warning(...)``.

    CompanyBranding,

@admin.register(CompanyBranding)
class CompanyBrandingAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ("company_name", "footer_company", "website", "updated_at")
    fields = (
        "company_name", "footer_company", "logo",
        "head_office_address", "branch_office_address", "jashore_office_address",
        "website", "default_signatory", "default_ref_no_prefix",
    )
    autocomplete_fields = ["default_signatory"]

    def has_add_permission(self, request):
        return not CompanyBranding.objects.exists()

    def has_delete_permission(self, request, obj=None):
        return False

    def save_model(self, request, obj, form, change):
        obj.updated_by = request.user
        super().save_model(request, obj, form, change)

class TemplateRevisionInline(admin.TabularInline):
    model = TemplateRevision
    fields = ("version", "changed_at", "changed_by", "change_note")
    readonly_fields = fields
    extra = 0
    can_delete = False
    max_num = 0
    show_change_link = True


def _surface_template_warnings(request, obj):
    for w in getattr(obj, "_template_warnings", []):
        messages.warning(request, w)


@admin.register(TemplateDesign)
class TemplateDesignAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ("name", "key", "version", "is_active", "updated_by", "updated_at")
    list_filter = ("is_active",)
    search_fields = ("name", "key")
    readonly_fields = ("version", "added_at", "added_by", "updated_at")
    inlines = [TemplateRevisionInline]

    def save_model(self, request, obj, form, change):
        if not obj.pk:
            obj.added_by = request.user
        obj.updated_by = request.user
        super().save_model(request, obj, form, change)
        _surface_template_warnings(request, obj)


@admin.register(MessageTemplate)
class MessageTemplateAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ("name", "key", "version", "is_active", "updated_by", "updated_at")
    list_filter = ("is_active",)
    search_fields = ("name", "key")
    readonly_fields = ("version", "added_at", "added_by", "updated_at")
    inlines = [TemplateRevisionInline]

    def save_model(self, request, obj, form, change):
        if not obj.pk:
            obj.added_by = request.user
        obj.updated_by = request.user
        super().save_model(request, obj, form, change)
        _surface_template_warnings(request, obj)

    list_filter = ("template_design", "message_template", "changed_at")
    search_fields = ("change_note",)
    readonly_fields = ("template_design", "message_template", "version",
                       "html_snapshot", "changed_by", "changed_at", "change_note")
    ordering = ("-changed_at",)

    def has_add_permission(self, request):
        return False

    def has_delete_permission(self, request, obj=None):
        return False

    @admin.display(description="Template")
    def _target(self, obj):
        return obj.template_design or obj.message_template


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DocumentType
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@admin.register(DocumentType)
class DocumentTypeAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = (
        "display_name", "code", "name", "is_active",
        "requires_approval", "auto_approve",
        "template_design", "message_template",
        "_reviewer_count", "_signatory_count",
    )
    list_filter = ("is_active", "requires_approval", "auto_approve")
    search_fields = ("code", "name", "display_name")
    autocomplete_fields = ("template_design", "message_template")
    inlines = [ReviewConfigInline, SignatoryConfigInline, ExtraFieldTypeInline]
    actions = ["test_render_pdf"]

    fieldsets = (
        (None, {
            "fields": ("code", "name", "display_name", "description"),
        }),
        ("Rendering", {
            "fields": ("template_design", "message_template"),
        }),
        ("Workflow", {
            "fields": ("requires_approval", "auto_approve", "auto_approve_reason", "is_active"),
        }),
    )

    def save_model(self, request, obj, form, change):
        if not obj.pk:
            obj.added_by = request.user
        obj.updated_by = request.user
        super().save_model(request, obj, form, change)

    @admin.display(description="Reviewers")
    def _reviewer_count(self, obj):
        return obj.review_configs.count()

    @admin.display(description="Signatories")
    def _signatory_count(self, obj):
        return obj.signatory_configs.count()

    @admin.action(description="Test render PDF (sample data)")
    def test_render_pdf(self, request, queryset):
        from documents.pdf import test_render_pdf
        if queryset.count() != 1:
            self.message_user(
                request, "Select exactly one document type to test-render.",
                level=messages.WARNING,
            )
            return
        doc_type = queryset.first()
        try:
            pdf_bytes = test_render_pdf(doc_type, employee=request.user)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.message_user(request, f"Render failed: {exc}", level=messages.ERROR)
            return
        response = HttpResponse(pdf_bytes, content_type="application/pdf")
        response["Content-Disposition"] = (
            f'inline; filename="test_{doc_type.code}.pdf"'
        )
        return response

            '<span style="padding:2px 8px; border-radius:8px; background:{}; '
            'color:#111; font-size:0.8em">{}</span>',
            color, obj.get_status_display(),
        )
