# FILE: ./documents/services.py
# ==========================================
"""Permission + visibility helpers for the documents app.

Mirror the leave module's pattern: thin wrappers around
``accounts.permissions`` so the access policy lives in one place.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from django.db.models import Q
from django.urls import reverse

from accounts.permissions import (
    _in_managed_scope,
    can_edit_all,
    can_see_all,
    visible_employee_pks,
)


def absolute_url(path: str) -> str:
    """Build an absolute URL using settings.PUBLIC_BASE_URL. Used in email
    bodies where the request object isn't available."""
    from django.conf import settings
    base = getattr(settings, "PUBLIC_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8000").rstrip("/")
    return f"{base}{path}"


def request_download_url(doc_request) -> str:
    return absolute_url(reverse("documents:download_pdf", args=[doc_request.id]))


def request_verify_url(doc_request) -> str:
    return absolute_url(reverse("documents_public:verify_document", args=[doc_request.id]))


def can_act_on_document_request(user, doc_request, request=None) -> bool:
    """Mirror of ``leave.services.can_act_on_leave``: admins act on anyone
    except themselves; managers act on downline; self can cancel-while-pending
    only (handled separately).
    """
    if not user or not user.is_authenticated or not doc_request:
        return False
    if can_edit_all(user, request):
        return True
    if doc_request.employee_id == user.pk:
        return False
    return _in_managed_scope(user, doc_request.employee_id, request)


def can_review_step(user, review) -> bool:
    if not user or not user.is_authenticated:
        return False
    if review.request.employee_id == user.pk:
        return False  # self-review forbidden even if you're in the group
    return user.groups.filter(pk=review.reviewer_group_id).exists()


def can_approve_step(user, approval) -> bool:
    if not user or not user.is_authenticated:
        return False
    if approval.request.employee_id == user.pk:
        return False
    return user.groups.filter(pk=approval.approver_group_id).exists()


def can_cancel_request(user, doc_request) -> bool:
    """Applicants cancel while still pending; admins always can."""
    from documents.models import DocumentRequest
    if not user or not user.is_authenticated:
        return False
    if can_edit_all(user):
        return True
    return (
        doc_request.employee_id == user.pk
        and doc_request.status in (
            DocumentRequest.Status.IN_REVIEW,
            DocumentRequest.Status.PENDING,
        )
    )


def visible_document_requests(user, request=None):
    """All DocumentRequest rows ``user`` is allowed to see."""
    from documents.models import DocumentRequest

    qs = DocumentRequest.objects.select_related("employee", "document_type")
    if can_see_all(user, request):
        return qs
    return qs.filter(
        Q(employee=user)
        | Q(employee_id__in=visible_employee_pks(user, request))
        | Q(reviews__reviewer_group__in=user.groups.all())
        | Q(approvals__approver_group__in=user.groups.all())
    ).distinct()


# ==========================================
# FILE: ./documents/models.py
# ==========================================
"""Documents app — DocumentType, request workflow, PDF generation.

Single source of truth for HR-issued letters (NOC, salary certificate,
experience certificate, employment verification, etc.). The model shape
ports veridoc's design with several improvements:

* ``rejection_history`` JSONField replaces a single overwritten reason
* ``DocumentType.code`` stable SlugField for cross-app references
* ``auto_approve`` paired with ``auto_approve_reason`` for audit clarity
* ``CompanyBranding`` singleton replaces hardcoded paths in pdf_generator.py
* ``TemplateRevision`` audit log for HR-edited templates
* Approval shape mirrors ``leave.LeaveApplication`` so Orbis admins see a
  consistent ``applied_by`` / ``processed_by`` / ``process_note`` shape

The action-workflow models (clearance steps, exit interview, asset return)
live in the ``offboarding`` app — not here. ``DocumentRequest.offboarding_case``
is added by a follow-up migration once that app exists.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid

from ckeditor.fields import RichTextField
from django.conf import settings
from django.contrib.auth.models import Group
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.db import models
from django.utils import timezone
from django.utils.translation import gettext_lazy as _


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Local abstract (mirrors leave/models.py::_Auditable)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class _Auditable(models.Model):
    added_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name="+",
    )
    added_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    updated_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name="+",
    )
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        abstract = True


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CompanyBranding (singleton, pk=1)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class CompanyBranding(models.Model):
    """One row. Holds the logo, addresses, default signatory used by the PDF
    pipeline. Replaces every hardcoded constant in veridoc's pdf_generator.py.
    """

    id = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField(primary_key=True, default=1, editable=False)
    company_name = models.CharField(max_length=200, default="SEBPO")
    footer_company = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True, default="ServicEngine Ltd.")
    logo = models.ImageField(upload_to="documents/branding/", blank=True, null=True)

    head_office_address = models.TextField(blank=True)
    branch_office_address = models.TextField(blank=True)
    jashore_office_address = models.TextField(blank=True)
    website = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True, default="sebpo.com")

    default_signatory = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name="+",
        help_text=_("Used on letters that don't have a signed approval row yet."),
    )
    default_ref_no_prefix = models.CharField(
        max_length=50, blank=True, default="SE/HRD",
        help_text=_("Prepended to letter reference numbers when not overridden in input_data."),
    )

    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)
    updated_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name="+",
    )

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = _("Company branding")
        verbose_name_plural = _("Company branding")

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        self.id = 1  # enforce singleton
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def delete(self, *args, **kwargs):  # pragma: no cover — defensive
        raise ValidationError("CompanyBranding is a singleton; it cannot be deleted.")

    @classmethod
    def load(cls) -> "CompanyBranding":
        obj, _created = cls.objects.get_or_create(pk=1)
        return obj

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.company_name


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Template machinery (DB-stored RichText with sanitisation + revisions)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class _VersionedRichTemplate(_Auditable):
    """Shared shape for TemplateDesign + MessageTemplate.

    Subclasses define the RichText field name via ``_HTML_FIELD``. Save flow:
    1. bleach-clean the HTML in place
    2. validate ``{{ var }}`` tokens against ``PDF_CONTEXT_SCHEMA`` (warnings,
       not errors — HR may use dynamic input_data keys we can't predict)
    3. detect change vs DB; bump ``version`` and queue a TemplateRevision row
    4. super().save()
    5. on commit, write the TemplateRevision

    Warnings collected during save land on ``self._template_warnings`` for the
    admin to surface via ``messages.warning(...)``.
    """

    _HTML_FIELD: str = ""  # subclass override
    _SANITIZE: bool = True  # subclass may set False (TemplateDesign needs full <html>/<style>)

    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    key = models.SlugField(max_length=120, unique=True)
    name = models.CharField(max_length=150)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    version = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=1)
    # `added_at`/`added_by` from _Auditable serve as the create timestamp;
    # `updated_at`/`updated_by` track the last edit. No extra fields needed.

    class Meta:
        abstract = True
        ordering = ["name"]

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        # Snapshot the original HTML so save() can detect changes.
        self._original_html = getattr(self, self._HTML_FIELD, "") or ""
        self._template_warnings: list[str] = []
        self._pending_revision: bool = False

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.name} (v{self.version})"

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        from documents.sanitize import clean_template_html
        from documents.pdf import (
            PDF_CONTEXT_SCHEMA,
            validate_template_against_context,
        )

        html = getattr(self, self._HTML_FIELD, "") or ""
        if self._SANITIZE:
            cleaned, was_modified = clean_template_html(html)
            if was_modified:
                self._template_warnings.append(
                    "Some HTML was removed during sanitisation (disallowed tags, "
                    "scripts, or unsafe CSS). The cleaned version was saved."
                )
                setattr(self, self._HTML_FIELD, cleaned)
                html = cleaned

        self._template_warnings.extend(
            validate_template_against_context(html, PDF_CONTEXT_SCHEMA)
        )

        # Detect change: bump version + queue a revision row.
        # Use _state.adding (not `not self.pk`) — UUID-pk models have pk
        # assigned in __init__ via default=uuid.uuid4 long before save().
        if self._state.adding:
            self.version = 1
            self._pending_revision = True
        elif html != (self._original_html or ""):
            self.version = (self.version or 1) + 1
            self._pending_revision = True

        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

        if self._pending_revision:
            TemplateRevision.objects.create(
                **self._revision_kwargs(),
                version=self.version,
                html_snapshot=html,
                changed_by=self.updated_by or self.added_by,
            )
            self._pending_revision = False
            self._original_html = html

    def _revision_kwargs(self) -> dict:  # subclass override
        raise NotImplementedError


class TemplateDesign(_VersionedRichTemplate):
    """Outer page layout / letterhead wrapper.

    HTML must include ``{{ body_html|safe }}`` somewhere — that's where the
    selected MessageTemplate body is injected at render time.

    Sanitisation is OFF: designs need <html>/<head>/<style>/<body> and are
    only editable by User Admins. The output is fed to WeasyPrint server-side,
    so XSS doesn't apply. (Variable validation still runs.)
    """

    _HTML_FIELD = "html"
    _SANITIZE = False

    html = RichTextField(
        blank=True,
        help_text=_("Full HTML layout. Must contain {{ body_html|safe }}."),
    )

    class Meta(_VersionedRichTemplate.Meta):
        verbose_name = _("Template design")
        verbose_name_plural = _("Template designs")

    def _revision_kwargs(self) -> dict:
        return {"template_design": self}


class MessageTemplate(_VersionedRichTemplate):
    """Inner body content (the actual letter wording).

    Rendered with the per-request context built by ``documents.pdf``.
    """

    _HTML_FIELD = "body_html"

    body_html = RichTextField(
        blank=True,
        help_text=_("Letter body. Django template syntax — {{ employee.get_full_name }} etc."),
    )

    class Meta(_VersionedRichTemplate.Meta):
        verbose_name = _("Message template")
        verbose_name_plural = _("Message templates")

    def _revision_kwargs(self) -> dict:
        return {"message_template": self}


class TemplateRevision(models.Model):
    """Append-only audit log. One row per save of a template that changed
    the HTML. Visibility only — no rollback in MVP.
    """

    template_design = models.ForeignKey(
        TemplateDesign, on_delete=models.CASCADE, null=True, blank=True,
        related_name="revisions",
    )
    message_template = models.ForeignKey(
        MessageTemplate, on_delete=models.CASCADE, null=True, blank=True,
        related_name="revisions",
    )
    version = models.PositiveIntegerField()
    html_snapshot = models.TextField()
    changed_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name="+",
    )
    changed_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    change_note = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["-changed_at"]
        constraints = [
            models.CheckConstraint(
                check=(
                    models.Q(template_design__isnull=False)
                    | models.Q(message_template__isnull=False)
                ),
                name="documents_revision_targets_one_template",
            ),
        ]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["template_design", "-version"]),
            models.Index(fields=["message_template", "-version"]),
        ]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        target = self.template_design or self.message_template
        return f"{target} → v{self.version}"

class DocumentType(_Auditable):
    """Catalogue of letters HR can issue.

    Each row binds a renderable template (design + body) to a review +
    approval chain configured via ``DocumentReviewConfig`` and
    ``DocumentSignatoryConfig`` inlines. Dynamic per-type form fields live
    in ``DocumentExtraFieldType``.
    """

    code = models.SlugField(
        max_length=64, unique=True,
        help_text=_("Stable machine key, e.g. 'NOC', 'EXP_LETTER'. Used for "
                    "cross-app references (offboarding looks up letters by code)."),
    )
    name = models.CharField(
        max_length=100, unique=True,
        help_text=_("Internal label, e.g. 'noc_visa'."),
    )
    display_name = models.CharField(max_length=150)
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)

    template_design = models.ForeignKey(
        TemplateDesign, on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name="document_types",
    )
    message_template = models.ForeignKey(
        MessageTemplate, on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name="document_types",
    )

    requires_approval = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    auto_approve = models.BooleanField(
        default=False,
        help_text=_("Skip review + approval entirely. Requires "
                    "requires_approval=False AND auto_approve_reason."),
    )
    auto_approve_reason = models.CharField(
        max_length=255, blank=True,
        help_text=_("Audit trail for why no human review is needed."),
    )

    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    # `added_at`/`updated_at` come from _Auditable.

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["display_name"]
        verbose_name = _("Document type")
        verbose_name_plural = _("Document types")

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.display_name

    def clean(self):
        if self.auto_approve and not self.auto_approve_reason:
            raise ValidationError({
                "auto_approve_reason": _("Required when auto-approve is enabled."),
            })
        if self.auto_approve and self.requires_approval:
            raise ValidationError(
                _("Auto-approve only makes sense when requires_approval is False."),
            )


class DocumentSignatoryConfig(models.Model):
    """One row per (DocumentType, Group) — the groups that must sign.
    Ordering controls who signs first."""

    document_type = models.ForeignKey(

    )
    signatory_group = models.ForeignKey(Group, on_delete=models.PROTECT)
    signature_order = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField(default=1)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["document_type", "signature_order"]
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["document_type", "signatory_group"],
                name="documents_unique_group_per_doc_signatory",
            ),
        ]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.document_type} · {self.signatory_group} (order {self.signature_order})"


class DocumentReviewConfig(models.Model):
    """One row per (DocumentType, Group) — the groups that must review
    before approval. Ordering controls who reviews first."""

    document_type = models.ForeignKey(
        DocumentType, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="review_configs",

    reviewer_group = models.ForeignKey(Group, on_delete=models.PROTECT)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["document_type", "review_order"]
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["document_type", "reviewer_group"],
                name="documents_unique_group_per_doc_review",
            ),
        ]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.document_type} · {self.reviewer_group} (order {self.review_order})"


class DocumentExtraFieldType(models.Model):
    """Per-DocumentType dynamic form field definition.

    The request form generates these on the fly; values land in
    ``DocumentExtraFieldValue``.
    """

    class FieldKind(models.TextChoices):
        TEXT = "TEXT", _("Single-line text")
        TEXTAREA = "TEXTAREA", _("Multi-line text")
        NUMBER = "NUMBER", _("Number")
        DATE = "DATE", _("Date")
        BOOLEAN = "BOOLEAN", _("Yes / No")
        CHOICE = "CHOICE", _("Dropdown choice")

    document_type = models.ForeignKey(
        DocumentType, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="extra_field_types",
    )
    field_key = models.SlugField(
        max_length=120,
        help_text=_("Template variable name, e.g. 'destination_country'."),
    )
    field_name = models.CharField(max_length=150)
    kind = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=FieldKind.choices, default=FieldKind.TEXT)
    is_required = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    choices = models.JSONField(
        default=list, blank=True,
        help_text=_("For CHOICE kind: list of strings."),
    )
    help_text = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True)
    sort_order = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField(default=1)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["sort_order"]
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["document_type", "field_key"],
                name="documents_unique_extra_field_key_per_doc",
            ),
        ]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.document_type} · {self.field_name}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DocumentRequest + Review + Approval (the workflow rows)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _generated_upload_to(instance, filename):
    return f"documents/generated/{instance.document_type.code}_{instance.id}.pdf"


class DocumentRequest(_Auditable):
    """An employee's request for a letter.

    Lifecycle:
      created → IN_REVIEW (if any DocumentReviewConfig) → PENDING (after all
      reviews pass) → APPROVED + PDF attached.
    Or:
      created → APPROVED if requires_approval=False AND auto_approve=True.
    Or:
      created → REJECTED at any review/approval step.

    Approval shape mirrors ``leave.LeaveApplication`` so the admin / queue
    UI is consistent across modules.
    """

    class Status(models.TextChoices):
        IN_REVIEW = "REVIEW", _("In review")
        PENDING = "PENDING", _("Pending approval")
        PARTIALLY_APPROVED = "PARTIAL", _("Partially approved")
        APPROVED = "APPROVED", _("Approved & generated")
        REJECTED = "REJECTED", _("Rejected")
        CANCELLED = "CANCELLED", _("Cancelled by applicant")

    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    employee = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="document_requests",
    )
    document_type = models.ForeignKey(DocumentType, on_delete=models.PROTECT)
    status = models.CharField(
        max_length=10, choices=Status.choices, default=Status.PENDING,
    )

    input_data = models.JSONField(
        default=dict, blank=True,
        help_text=_("Raw form data — both standard fields (reason, letter_date) "
                    "and dynamic ones merged in. Flattened into the PDF context."),
    )
    generated_file = models.FileField(
        upload_to=_generated_upload_to, null=True, blank=True,
    )

    rejection_history = models.JSONField(
        default=list, blank=True,
        help_text=_("Append-only list of {at, by, by_pk, stage, step_order, "
                    "reason} dicts. Replaces veridoc's overwritten field."),
    )

    # Cross-app link to offboarding. Populated by ``auto_issue_letters`` when
    # a clearance case completes; null for all other requests. String FK
    # avoids a circular import between documents and offboarding.
    offboarding_case = models.ForeignKey(
        "offboarding.OffboardingCase", on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name="letters",
    )

    # Leave-style approval shape — usually applied_by == employee, but HR may
    # apply on someone's behalf (e.g. for a departing employee).
    applied_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+",
    )
    applied_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    processed_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name="+",
    )
    processed_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    process_note = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["-applied_at"]
        verbose_name = _("Document request")
        verbose_name_plural = _("Document requests")
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["employee", "status"], name="docreq_emp_status_idx"),
            models.Index(fields=["status"], name="docreq_status_idx"),
            models.Index(fields=["document_type", "status"], name="docreq_dt_status_idx"),
        ]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.employee} · {self.document_type} ({self.get_status_display()})"

    # ----- convenience accessors used by templates + admin -----

    @property
    def is_in_review(self) -> bool:
        return self.status == self.Status.IN_REVIEW

    @property
    def is_pending(self) -> bool:
        return self.status == self.Status.PENDING

    @property
    def is_approved(self) -> bool:
        return self.status == self.Status.APPROVED

    @property
    def is_rejected(self) -> bool:
        return self.status == self.Status.REJECTED

    @property
    def is_cancelled(self) -> bool:
        return self.status == self.Status.CANCELLED

    @property
    def is_fully_approved(self) -> bool:
        return not self.approvals.exclude(status=RequestApproval.Status.APPROVED).exists()

    @property
    def is_fully_reviewed(self) -> bool:
        return not self.reviews.exclude(status=RequestReview.Status.REVIEWED).exists()

    @property
    def current_review_step(self):
        return self.reviews.filter(status=RequestReview.Status.PENDING).order_by("order").first()

    @property
    def current_approval_step(self):
        return self.approvals.filter(status=RequestApproval.Status.PENDING).order_by("order").first()

    @property
    def latest_rejection(self):
        return self.rejection_history[-1] if self.rejection_history else None

    def append_rejection(self, *, stage: str, step_order: int, reason: str, by) -> None:
        """Append to rejection_history and save in one go."""
        entry = {
            "at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
            "stage": stage,
            "step_order": step_order,
            "reason": reason or "",
            "by_pk": str(by.pk) if by else None,
            "by_email": getattr(by, "email", "") if by else "",
        }
        history = list(self.rejection_history or [])
        history.append(entry)
        self.rejection_history = history
        self.save(update_fields=["rejection_history", "updated_at"])


class RequestReview(models.Model):
    """One row per review step on a DocumentRequest. Generated by the
    ``create_review_chain`` signal from ``DocumentReviewConfig``."""

    class Status(models.TextChoices):
        PENDING = "PENDING", _("Pending")
        REVIEWED = "REVIEWED", _("Reviewed")
        REJECTED = "REJECTED", _("Rejected")

    request = models.ForeignKey(
        DocumentRequest, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="reviews",
    )
    reviewer_group = models.ForeignKey(Group, on_delete=models.PROTECT)
    reviewer = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name="+",
    )
    status = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=Status.choices, default=Status.PENDING)
    remarks = models.TextField(blank=True)
    order = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField(default=1)
    reviewed_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["order", "reviewed_at"]
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["request", "reviewer_group"],
                name="documents_unique_review_group_per_request",
            ),
        ]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        actor = self.reviewer or self.reviewer_group
        return f"Review step {self.order}: {actor} ({self.get_status_display()})"

    def mark_reviewed(self, user, remarks: str = "") -> None:
        self.reviewer = user
        self.status = self.Status.REVIEWED
        self.remarks = remarks or ""
        self.reviewed_at = timezone.now()
        self.save()


class RequestApproval(models.Model):
    """One row per approval / signing step. Generated when the review chain
    completes (or immediately if there's no review chain)."""

    class Status(models.TextChoices):
        PENDING = "PENDING", _("Pending")
        APPROVED = "APPROVED", _("Approved")
        REJECTED = "REJECTED", _("Rejected")

    request = models.ForeignKey(
        DocumentRequest, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="approvals",
    )
    approver_group = models.ForeignKey(Group, on_delete=models.PROTECT)
    signatory = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name="+",
    )
    status = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=Status.choices, default=Status.PENDING)
    remarks = models.TextField(blank=True)
    order = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField(default=1)
    signed_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["order", "signed_at"]
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["request", "approver_group"],
                name="documents_unique_approval_group_per_request",
            ),
        ]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        actor = self.signatory or self.approver_group
        return f"Approval step {self.order}: {actor} ({self.get_status_display()})"


class DocumentExtraFieldValue(models.Model):
    """A submitted value for a ``DocumentExtraFieldType``. One row per
    (request, field_type). All values stored as strings; the request form
    handles type coercion when reading back."""

    request = models.ForeignKey(
        DocumentRequest, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="extra_field_values",
    )
    field_type = models.ForeignKey(
        DocumentExtraFieldType, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="values",
    )
    value = models.TextField(blank=True)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    submitted_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        null=True, blank=True, related_name="+",
    )
    submitted_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["submitted_at"]
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["request", "field_type"],
                name="documents_unique_extra_value_per_request_field",
            ),
        ]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.field_type.field_name}: {self.value[:50]}"

    def clean(self):
        if self.field_type and self.request \
                and self.field_type.document_type_id != self.request.document_type_id:
            raise ValidationError(
                _("Field type does not belong to this request's document type."),
            )


# ==========================================
# FILE: ./documents/signals.py
# ==========================================
"""Signal handlers driving the document-request workflow.

Six handlers ported from veridoc with two changes:

* rejection is appended to ``rejection_history`` (not overwritten)
* every notification is wrapped in ``transaction.on_commit`` so a rolled-back
  transaction never fires a phantom email

Order of fire on a brand-new APPROVED-on-create request (auto-approve):
  pre_save (stash prev=None) → create row → post_save:
    create_review_chain (no configs, requires_approval=False, auto_approve=True
                         → marks APPROVED + saves note)
    → second post_save (created=False from the inner .save) →
    generate_pdf_when_approved → on_commit(generate + email)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging

from django.db import transaction
from django.db.models.signals import post_save, pre_save
from django.dispatch import receiver

from documents.models import (
    DocumentRequest,
    DocumentReviewConfig,
    DocumentSignatoryConfig,
    RequestApproval,
    RequestReview,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Internal helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _create_approval_chain(req: DocumentRequest) -> bool:
    """Idempotent: create RequestApproval rows from DocumentSignatoryConfig.
    Returns True if any row was created (False if all already existed)."""
    configs = DocumentSignatoryConfig.objects.filter(
        document_type=req.document_type,
    ).order_by("signature_order")
    any_created = False
    for cfg in configs:
        _, made = RequestApproval.objects.get_or_create(
            request=req,
            approver_group=cfg.signatory_group,
            defaults={"order": cfg.signature_order},
        )
        any_created = any_created or made
    return any_created


def _notify_first_pending_reviewer(req: DocumentRequest) -> None:
    review = req.reviews.filter(status=RequestReview.Status.PENDING).order_by("order").first()
    if not review:
        return
    from core.notifications import notify_group
    notify_group(
        review.reviewer_group,
        subject_template_path="documents/notifications/review_assigned_subject.txt",
        body_template_path="documents/notifications/review_assigned_body.txt",
        context={"request_obj": req, "review": review},
    )


def _notify_first_pending_approver(req: DocumentRequest) -> None:
    approval = req.approvals.filter(
        status=RequestApproval.Status.PENDING,
    ).order_by("order").first()
    if not approval:
        return
    from core.notifications import notify_group
    notify_group(
        approval.approver_group,
        subject_template_path="documents/notifications/approval_assigned_subject.txt",
        body_template_path="documents/notifications/approval_assigned_body.txt",
        context={"request_obj": req, "approval": approval},
    )


def _notify_request_rejected(req: DocumentRequest) -> None:
    from core.notifications import notify_user
    notify_user(
        req.employee,
        subject_template_path="documents/notifications/request_rejected_subject.txt",
        body_template_path="documents/notifications/request_rejected_body.txt",
        context={"request_obj": req, "latest_rejection": req.latest_rejection},
    )


def _notify_request_approved(req: DocumentRequest) -> None:
    from core.notifications import notify_user
    from documents.services import request_download_url, request_verify_url
    notify_user(
        req.employee,
        subject_template_path="documents/notifications/request_approved_subject.txt",
        body_template_path="documents/notifications/request_approved_body.txt",
        context={
            "request_obj": req,
            "download_url": request_download_url(req),
            "verify_url": request_verify_url(req),
        },
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Signal 1 — create the review/approval chain (or auto-approve) on create
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@receiver(post_save, sender=DocumentRequest, dispatch_uid="documents.create_review_chain")
def create_review_chain(sender, instance: DocumentRequest, created: bool, **kwargs):
    if not created:
        return

    review_configs = list(DocumentReviewConfig.objects.filter(
        document_type=instance.document_type,
    ).order_by("review_order"))

    if review_configs:
        RequestReview.objects.bulk_create([
            RequestReview(
                request=instance,
                reviewer_group=cfg.reviewer_group,
                order=cfg.review_order,
            )
            for cfg in review_configs
        ])
        DocumentRequest.objects.filter(pk=instance.pk).update(
            status=DocumentRequest.Status.IN_REVIEW,
        )
        instance.status = DocumentRequest.Status.IN_REVIEW  # keep instance in sync
        transaction.on_commit(lambda: _notify_first_pending_reviewer(instance))
        return

    if instance.document_type.requires_approval:
        _create_approval_chain(instance)
        DocumentRequest.objects.filter(pk=instance.pk).update(
            status=DocumentRequest.Status.PENDING,
        )
        instance.status = DocumentRequest.Status.PENDING
        transaction.on_commit(lambda: _notify_first_pending_approver(instance))
        return

    # No reviews, no approvals: auto-approve only when explicitly enabled.
    if instance.document_type.auto_approve:
        note = f"Auto-approved: {instance.document_type.auto_approve_reason}"
        DocumentRequest.objects.filter(pk=instance.pk).update(
            status=DocumentRequest.Status.APPROVED,
            process_note=note,
        )
        instance.status = DocumentRequest.Status.APPROVED
        instance.process_note = note
        # Touching the row again via .save() would re-fire post_save handlers;
        # we instead emit a synthetic save signal so generate_pdf_when_approved
        # picks it up. Cheapest path: re-fetch & .save() with an explicit guard.
        from django.utils import timezone
        DocumentRequest.objects.filter(pk=instance.pk).update(processed_at=timezone.now())
        # Trigger the PDF flow by manually invoking the post-approval handler.
        transaction.on_commit(lambda: _post_approval(instance.pk))
        return

    logger.warning(
        "DocumentType %r has no review/approval config and is not auto_approve; "
        "request %s is stuck.", instance.document_type.code, instance.pk,
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Signal 2 — review state machine
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@receiver(post_save, sender=RequestReview, dispatch_uid="documents.update_status_from_reviews")
def update_request_status_from_reviews(sender, instance: RequestReview, **kwargs):
    req = instance.request
    if instance.status == RequestReview.Status.REJECTED:
        req.append_rejection(
            stage="review",
            step_order=instance.order,
            reason=instance.remarks,
            by=instance.reviewer,
        )
        DocumentRequest.objects.filter(pk=req.pk).update(
            status=DocumentRequest.Status.REJECTED,
            processed_by=instance.reviewer,
            processed_at=instance.reviewed_at,
            process_note=f"Rejected at review step {instance.order}",
        )
        req.refresh_from_db(fields=["status"])
        transaction.on_commit(lambda: _notify_request_rejected(req))
        return

    if instance.status != RequestReview.Status.REVIEWED:
        return

    # Are there more pending reviews?
    if req.reviews.exclude(status=RequestReview.Status.REVIEWED).exists():
        # Still IN_REVIEW; notify the next reviewer group.
        transaction.on_commit(lambda: _notify_first_pending_reviewer(req))
        return

    # All reviews done — proceed to approval (or auto-approve).
    if req.document_type.requires_approval:
        _create_approval_chain(req)
        DocumentRequest.objects.filter(pk=req.pk).update(
            status=DocumentRequest.Status.PENDING,
        )
        req.refresh_from_db(fields=["status"])
        transaction.on_commit(lambda: _notify_first_pending_approver(req))
    else:
        # Reviews-only flow: complete.
        DocumentRequest.objects.filter(pk=req.pk).update(
            status=DocumentRequest.Status.APPROVED,
            process_note="Approved after final review",
        )
        req.refresh_from_db(fields=["status", "process_note"])
        transaction.on_commit(lambda: _post_approval(req.pk))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Signal 3 — approval state machine
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@receiver(post_save, sender=RequestApproval, dispatch_uid="documents.update_status_from_approvals")
def update_request_status_from_approvals(sender, instance: RequestApproval, **kwargs):
    req = instance.request
    if instance.status == RequestApproval.Status.REJECTED:
        req.append_rejection(
            stage="approval",
            step_order=instance.order,
            reason=instance.remarks,
            by=instance.signatory,
        )
        DocumentRequest.objects.filter(pk=req.pk).update(
            status=DocumentRequest.Status.REJECTED,
            processed_by=instance.signatory,
            processed_at=instance.signed_at,
            process_note=f"Rejected at approval step {instance.order}",
        )
        req.refresh_from_db(fields=["status"])
        transaction.on_commit(lambda: _notify_request_rejected(req))
        return

    if instance.status != RequestApproval.Status.APPROVED:
        return

    pending = req.approvals.filter(status=RequestApproval.Status.PENDING)
    if pending.exists():
        DocumentRequest.objects.filter(pk=req.pk).update(
            status=DocumentRequest.Status.PARTIALLY_APPROVED,
        )
        req.refresh_from_db(fields=["status"])
        transaction.on_commit(lambda: _notify_first_pending_approver(req))
        return

    # All approved → final approval.
    from django.utils import timezone
    DocumentRequest.objects.filter(pk=req.pk).update(
        status=DocumentRequest.Status.APPROVED,
        processed_by=instance.signatory,
        processed_at=instance.signed_at or timezone.now(),
    )
    req.refresh_from_db(fields=["status", "processed_by", "processed_at"])
    transaction.on_commit(lambda: _post_approval(req.pk))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Signal 4 — track previous status on the instance (for transition detection)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@receiver(pre_save, sender=DocumentRequest, dispatch_uid="documents.stash_prev_status")
def stash_prev_status(sender, instance: DocumentRequest, **kwargs):
    if not instance.pk:
        instance._prev_status = None
        return
    try:
        instance._prev_status = sender.objects.only("status").get(pk=instance.pk).status
    except sender.DoesNotExist:
        instance._prev_status = None


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Post-approval action (PDF + notification). Idempotent.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _post_approval(request_pk) -> None:
    """Generate the PDF and email the employee. Safe to call multiple times —
    PDF generation is idempotent (overwrites the same path)."""
    from documents.pdf import generate_and_attach_pdf
    try:
        generate_and_attach_pdf(request_pk)
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("PDF generation failed for DocumentRequest %s", request_pk)
        req = DocumentRequest.objects.filter(pk=request_pk).first()
        if req is not None:
            req.append_rejection(
                stage="pdf",
                step_order=0,
                reason="PDF generation failed; see server logs.",
                by=None,
            )
        return

    req = DocumentRequest.objects.filter(pk=request_pk).first()
    if req is not None:
        _notify_request_approved(req)

"""Views for the documents app.

Every form view branches on ``request.htmx``: returns a drawer body fragment
on htmx requests, a full-page form template otherwise. POST success returns
an OOB row + ``HX-Trigger: orbis:drawer-close`` header that the page-level
Alpine handler picks up.

Permission gating goes through ``documents.services`` helpers which in turn
call ``accounts.permissions`` — never reimplement access policy here.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from django.contrib import messages
from django.contrib.auth.mixins import LoginRequiredMixin
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from django.db.models import Q
from django.http import FileResponse, Http404, HttpResponse
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404, redirect, render
from django.urls import reverse
from django.utils import timezone
from django.views import View
from django.views.generic import DetailView, ListView, TemplateView

from accounts.permissions import can_see_all
from documents.forms import (
    ApprovalActionForm,
    DocumentRequestFilterForm,
    DocumentRequestForm,
    MyDocumentsFilterForm,
    ReviewActionForm,
)
from documents.models import (
    DocumentRequest,
    DocumentType,
    RequestApproval,
    RequestReview,
)
from documents.services import (
    can_act_on_document_request,
    can_approve_step,
    can_cancel_request,
    can_review_step,
    visible_document_requests,
)

class DashboardView(LoginRequiredMixin, TemplateView):
    template_name = "documents/dashboard.html"

    def get_context_data(self, **kwargs):
        ctx = super().get_context_data(**kwargs)
        user = self.request.user
        user_groups = list(user.groups.values_list("pk", flat=True))
        ctx["available_doc_types"] = DocumentType.objects.filter(is_active=True)
        ctx["my_recent_requests"] = (
            DocumentRequest.objects.filter(employee=user)
            .select_related("document_type")
            .order_by("-applied_at")[:5]
        )
        ctx["pending_reviews"] = (
            RequestReview.objects.filter(
                status=RequestReview.Status.PENDING,
                reviewer_group__in=user_groups,
            )
            .exclude(request__employee=user)
            .select_related("request", "request__employee", "request__document_type")
            .order_by("request__applied_at")[:10]
        )
        ctx["pending_approvals"] = (
            RequestApproval.objects.filter(
                status=RequestApproval.Status.PENDING,
                approver_group__in=user_groups,
            )
            .exclude(request__employee=user)
            .select_related("request", "request__employee", "request__document_type")
            .order_by("request__applied_at")[:10]
        )
        ctx["page_title"] = "Documents"
        return ctx


class MyDocumentsView(LoginRequiredMixin, ListView):
    template_name = "documents/my_documents.html"
    context_object_name = "requests"
    paginate_by = 20

    def get_queryset(self):
        qs = (
            DocumentRequest.objects.filter(employee=self.request.user)
            .select_related("document_type")
            .order_by("-applied_at")
        )
        self.filter_form = MyDocumentsFilterForm(self.request.GET or None)
        if self.filter_form.is_valid():
            q = self.filter_form.cleaned_data.get("q")
            dt = self.filter_form.cleaned_data.get("document_type")
            if q:
                qs = qs.filter(document_type__display_name__icontains=q)
            if dt:
                qs = qs.filter(document_type=dt)
        return qs

    def get_context_data(self, **kwargs):
        ctx = super().get_context_data(**kwargs)
        ctx["filter_form"] = self.filter_form
        ctx["page_title"] = "My documents"
        return ctx


class RequestStartView(LoginRequiredMixin, TemplateView):
    template_name = "documents/request_start.html"

    def get_context_data(self, **kwargs):
        ctx = super().get_context_data(**kwargs)
        ctx["doc_types"] = DocumentType.objects.filter(is_active=True).order_by("display_name")
        ctx["page_title"] = "Request a document"
        return ctx


class RequestFormView(LoginRequiredMixin, View):
    http_method_names = ["get", "post"]

    def dispatch(self, request, doc_type_id, *args, **kwargs):
        self.doc_type = get_object_or_404(DocumentType, pk=doc_type_id, is_active=True)
        return super().dispatch(request, *args, **kwargs)

    def get(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        form = DocumentRequestForm(document_type=self.doc_type, user=request.user)
        return self._render(request, form)

    def post(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        form = DocumentRequestForm(
            request.POST, document_type=self.doc_type, user=request.user,
        )
        if form.is_valid():
            doc_request = form.save(employee=request.user)
            if request.htmx:
                response = HttpResponse(status=204)
                response["HX-Trigger"] = "orbis:drawer-close"
                response["HX-Redirect"] = reverse("documents:request_detail",
                                                  args=[doc_request.id])
                return response
            messages.success(request, "Request submitted.")
            return redirect("documents:request_detail", request_id=doc_request.id)
        return self._render(request, form)

    def _render(self, request, form):
        ctx = {
            "form": form,
            "doc_type": self.doc_type,
            "action_url": reverse("documents:request_form", args=[self.doc_type.pk]),
            "drawer_title": f"Request: {self.doc_type.display_name}",
            "page_title": self.drawer_title if False else self.doc_type.display_name,
        }
        template = (
            "documents/_drawer_request.html" if request.htmx
            else "documents/request_form.html"
        )
        return render(request, template, ctx)


class RequestDetailView(LoginRequiredMixin, DetailView):
    model = DocumentRequest
    pk_url_kwarg = "request_id"
    template_name = "documents/request_detail.html"
    context_object_name = "doc_request"

    def get_queryset(self):
        return DocumentRequest.objects.select_related(
            "employee", "document_type", "applied_by", "processed_by",
        ).prefetch_related("reviews", "approvals", "extra_field_values__field_type")

    def get_object(self, queryset=None):
        obj = super().get_object(queryset)
        user = self.request.user
        if obj.employee_id == user.pk:
            return obj
        if can_see_all(user, request=self.request):
            return obj
        # Reviewer / approver also gets to see the detail.
        user_groups = set(user.groups.values_list("pk", flat=True))
        review_groups = set(obj.reviews.values_list("reviewer_group_id", flat=True))
        approval_groups = set(obj.approvals.values_list("approver_group_id", flat=True))
        if user_groups & (review_groups | approval_groups):
            return obj
        raise PermissionDenied("You can't view this request.")

    def get_context_data(self, **kwargs):
        ctx = super().get_context_data(**kwargs)
        ctx["can_cancel"] = can_cancel_request(self.request.user, ctx["doc_request"])
        ctx["page_title"] = ctx["doc_request"].document_type.display_name
        return ctx


class RequestCancelView(LoginRequiredMixin, View):
    http_method_names = ["post"]

    def post(self, request, request_id):
        doc_request = get_object_or_404(DocumentRequest, pk=request_id)
        if not can_cancel_request(request.user, doc_request):
            raise PermissionDenied("You can't cancel this request.")
        DocumentRequest.objects.filter(pk=doc_request.pk).update(
            status=DocumentRequest.Status.CANCELLED,
            processed_by=request.user,
            processed_at=timezone.now(),
            process_note="Cancelled by " + request.user.display_name,
        )
        messages.success(request, "Request cancelled.")
        return redirect("documents:request_detail", request_id=doc_request.id)


class DownloadPdfView(LoginRequiredMixin, View):
    http_method_names = ["get"]

    def get(self, request, request_id):
        doc_request = get_object_or_404(
            DocumentRequest.objects.select_related("document_type", "employee"),
            pk=request_id,
        )
        if not doc_request.generated_file:
            raise Http404("PDF not generated yet.")
        if doc_request.status != DocumentRequest.Status.APPROVED:
            raise Http404("Document not approved.")
        user = request.user
        is_owner = doc_request.employee_id == user.pk
        is_signer = doc_request.approvals.filter(signatory=user).exists()
        is_reviewer = doc_request.reviews.filter(reviewer=user).exists()
        if not (is_owner or is_signer or is_reviewer or can_see_all(user)):
            raise PermissionDenied("You can't download this document.")
        return FileResponse(
            doc_request.generated_file.open("rb"),
            as_attachment=True,
            filename=f"{doc_request.document_type.code}_{doc_request.id}.pdf",
            content_type="application/pdf",
        )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reviewer / approver action views (shared shape)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class _StepActionViewBase(LoginRequiredMixin, View):
    """Shared GET/POST drawer flow for review + approval actions."""

    http_method_names = ["get", "post"]
    model = None             # subclass: RequestReview or RequestApproval
    form_class = None        # subclass
    can_act = staticmethod(lambda u, s: False)  # subclass override
    drawer_template = ""     # subclass
    page_template = ""       # subclass
    drawer_title_prefix = ""
    url_name = ""            # used to reverse action_url
    success_message = "Saved."

    def dispatch(self, request, step_id, *args, **kwargs):
        self.step = get_object_or_404(
            self.model.objects.select_related(
                "request", "request__employee", "request__document_type",
            ),
            pk=step_id,
        )
        if not self.can_act(request.user, self.step):
            raise PermissionDenied("You can't act on this step.")
        return super().dispatch(request, *args, **kwargs)

    def get(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        form = self.form_class(instance=self.step)
        return self._render(request, form)

    def post(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        form = self.form_class(request.POST, instance=self.step)
        if form.is_valid():
            self._apply(form, request.user)
            if request.htmx:
                response = HttpResponse(status=204)
                response["HX-Trigger"] = "orbis:drawer-close"
                response["HX-Redirect"] = reverse(
                    "documents:request_detail", args=[self.step.request_id],
                )
                return response
            messages.success(request, self.success_message)
            return redirect("documents:request_detail", request_id=self.step.request_id)
        return self._render(request, form)

    def _apply(self, form, user):  # subclass override
        raise NotImplementedError

    def _render(self, request, form):
        ctx = {
            "form": form,
            "step": self.step,
            "doc_request": self.step.request,
            "action_url": reverse(self.url_name, args=[self.step.pk]),
            "drawer_title": f"{self.drawer_title_prefix}: {self.step.request.document_type.display_name}",
            "page_title": self.drawer_title_prefix,
        }
        template = self.drawer_template if request.htmx else self.page_template
        return render(request, template, ctx)


class ReviewActionView(_StepActionViewBase):
    model = RequestReview
    form_class = ReviewActionForm
    can_act = staticmethod(can_review_step)
    drawer_template = "documents/_drawer_review.html"
    page_template = "documents/review_action.html"
    drawer_title_prefix = "Review"
    url_name = "documents:review_action"
    success_message = "Review recorded."

    def _apply(self, form, user):
        obj = form.save(commit=False)
        obj.reviewer = user
        obj.reviewed_at = timezone.now()
        obj.save()


class ApprovalActionView(_StepActionViewBase):
    model = RequestApproval
    form_class = ApprovalActionForm
    can_act = staticmethod(can_approve_step)
    drawer_template = "documents/_drawer_approval.html"
    page_template = "documents/approval_action.html"
    drawer_title_prefix = "Approve"
    url_name = "documents:approval_action"
    success_message = "Approval recorded."

    def _apply(self, form, user):
        obj = form.save(commit=False)
        obj.signatory = user
        obj.signed_at = timezone.now()
        obj.save()

class PendingQueueView(LoginRequiredMixin, TemplateView):
    """One page combining the user's pending reviews and pending approvals
    in two cards. Works equally well for a reviewer (sees reviews only),
    an approver (sees approvals only), or HR (sees their group's queue —
    they still have to be in the configured reviewer/approver group)."""

    template_name = "documents/pending_queue.html"

        ctx["pending_approvals"] = (

                status=RequestApproval.Status.PENDING,
                approver_group__in=user_groups,
            )
            .exclude(request__employee=user)

            .order_by("request__applied_at")

        ctx["page_title"] = "Pending queue"
        return ctx


class AllDocumentsView(LoginRequiredMixin, ListView):
    """HR-facing list of all requests. Filters by status / type / date /
    employee. Visible to anyone who passes ``can_see_all`` or has at least
    one request in scope."""

    template_name = "documents/all_documents.html"
    context_object_name = "requests"
    paginate_by = 25

    def get_queryset(self):
        self.filter_form = DocumentRequestFilterForm(self.request.GET or None)
        qs = visible_document_requests(self.request.user, request=self.request)

        if self.filter_form.is_valid():
            cd = self.filter_form.cleaned_data
            if cd.get("q"):
                qs = qs.filter(
                    Q(employee__email__icontains=cd["q"])
                    | Q(employee__first_name__icontains=cd["q"])
                    | Q(employee__last_name__icontains=cd["q"])
                    | Q(employee__employee_id__icontains=cd["q"])
                )
            if cd.get("document_type"):
                qs = qs.filter(document_type=cd["document_type"])
            if cd.get("status"):
                qs = qs.filter(status=cd["status"])
            if cd.get("date_from"):
                qs = qs.filter(applied_at__date__gte=cd["date_from"])
            if cd.get("date_to"):
                qs = qs.filter(applied_at__date__lte=cd["date_to"])
            if cd.get("mine_only"):
                user_groups = list(self.request.user.groups.values_list("pk", flat=True))
                qs = qs.filter(
                    Q(reviews__status=RequestReview.Status.PENDING,
                      reviews__reviewer_group__in=user_groups)
                    | Q(approvals__status=RequestApproval.Status.PENDING,
                        approvals__approver_group__in=user_groups)
                ).distinct()

        return qs.order_by("-applied_at")

    def get_context_data(self, **kwargs):
        ctx = super().get_context_data(**kwargs)
        ctx["filter_form"] = self.filter_form
        ctx["page_title"] = "All documents"
        return ctx


# ==========================================
# FILE: ./documents/forms.py
# ==========================================
"""Forms for the documents app.

* ``DocumentRequestForm`` — dynamic, generates fields per
  ``DocumentExtraFieldType`` row attached to the chosen DocumentType.
* ``ReviewActionForm`` / ``ApprovalActionForm`` — status + remarks (remarks
  required when rejecting).
* ``DocumentRequestFilterForm`` — HR queue filtering.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

from django import forms
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.db import transaction

from documents.models import (
    DocumentExtraFieldType,
    DocumentExtraFieldValue,
    DocumentRequest,
    DocumentType,
    RequestApproval,
    RequestReview,
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Employee-facing
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class DocumentRequestForm(forms.ModelForm):
    """The request creation form.

    Built from the dynamic ``DocumentExtraFieldType`` rows for the chosen
    DocumentType. The ``employee`` and ``document_type`` come from the view,
    not the form, so they're never user-editable.
    """

    class Meta:
        model = DocumentRequest
        fields: list[str] = []  # everything is dynamic

    def __init__(self, *args, document_type: DocumentType = None,
                 user=None, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        if document_type is None:
            raise ValueError("DocumentRequestForm requires a document_type kwarg.")
        self._document_type = document_type
        self._user = user

        # Standard 'reason' field (always shown — used in the request detail page)
        self.fields["reason"] = forms.CharField(
            widget=forms.Textarea(attrs={"rows": 3, "class": "form-input"}),
            required=False,
            label="Reason / context",
            help_text="Optional. Helps HR understand the request.",
        )

        # Dynamic per-DocumentType fields
        self._extra_field_types = list(
            DocumentExtraFieldType.objects
            .filter(document_type=document_type, is_active=True)
            .order_by("sort_order")
        )
        for ft in self._extra_field_types:
            field = self._build_field(ft)
            self.fields[ft.field_key] = field

    def _build_field(self, ft: DocumentExtraFieldType) -> forms.Field:
        kind = ft.kind
        common = {
            "required": ft.is_required,
            "label": ft.field_name,
            "help_text": ft.help_text or "",
        }
        if kind == DocumentExtraFieldType.FieldKind.TEXT:
            return forms.CharField(
                widget=forms.TextInput(attrs={"class": "form-input"}),
                max_length=300, **common,
            )
        if kind == DocumentExtraFieldType.FieldKind.TEXTAREA:
            return forms.CharField(
                widget=forms.Textarea(attrs={"rows": 3, "class": "form-input"}),
                **common,
            )
        if kind == DocumentExtraFieldType.FieldKind.NUMBER:
            return forms.DecimalField(
                widget=forms.NumberInput(attrs={"class": "form-input"}),
                max_digits=14, decimal_places=4, **common,
            )
        if kind == DocumentExtraFieldType.FieldKind.DATE:
            return forms.DateField(
                widget=forms.DateInput(attrs={"type": "date", "class": "form-input"}),
                **common,
            )
        if kind == DocumentExtraFieldType.FieldKind.BOOLEAN:
            common["required"] = False  # checkboxes can't be required-True
            return forms.BooleanField(
                widget=forms.CheckboxInput(attrs={"class": "form-checkbox"}),
                **common,
            )
        if kind == DocumentExtraFieldType.FieldKind.CHOICE:
            choices = [("", "—")] + [(c, c) for c in (ft.choices or [])]
            return forms.ChoiceField(
                widget=forms.Select(attrs={"class": "form-input"}),
                choices=choices, **common,
            )
        # Fallback: text.
        return forms.CharField(widget=forms.TextInput(attrs={"class": "form-input"}), **common)

    def clean(self):
        data = super().clean()
        for ft in self._extra_field_types:
            if ft.is_required and ft.kind != DocumentExtraFieldType.FieldKind.BOOLEAN:
                if not data.get(ft.field_key):
                    self.add_error(ft.field_key, "This field is required.")
        return data

    @transaction.atomic
    def save(self, commit: bool = True, employee=None) -> DocumentRequest:
        if employee is None:
            raise ValueError("DocumentRequestForm.save requires an `employee` kwarg.")

        cleaned = {k: v for k, v in self.cleaned_data.items() if k}
        input_data: dict = {}

        if "reason" in cleaned:
            input_data["reason"] = cleaned["reason"] or ""

        # Persist dynamic field values to both input_data and the
        # DocumentExtraFieldValue rows (latter is what reports + the PDF
        # context map iterate; former is convenient for ad-hoc keys).
        extra_values: dict[str, str] = {}
        for ft in self._extra_field_types:
            raw = cleaned.get(ft.field_key)
            if raw is None or raw == "":
                continue
            if ft.kind == DocumentExtraFieldType.FieldKind.BOOLEAN:
                str_val = "true" if raw else "false"
            elif ft.kind == DocumentExtraFieldType.FieldKind.DATE:
                str_val = raw.isoformat() if isinstance(raw, date) else str(raw)
            else:
                str_val = str(raw)
            extra_values[ft.field_key] = str_val
            input_data[ft.field_key] = str_val

        obj = self.instance
        obj.document_type = self._document_type
        obj.employee = employee
        obj.applied_by = self._user or employee
        obj.added_by = self._user
        obj.updated_by = self._user
        obj.input_data = input_data
        if commit:
            obj.save()
            for ft in self._extra_field_types:
                if ft.field_key in extra_values:
                    DocumentExtraFieldValue.objects.update_or_create(
                        request=obj, field_type=ft,
                        defaults={
                            "value": extra_values[ft.field_key],
                            "submitted_by": self._user,
                            "is_active": True,
                        },
                    )
        return obj


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Review + Approval action forms
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class _ActionFormBase(forms.ModelForm):
    """Common pattern: status + remarks, with remarks required when rejecting."""

    _reject_value: str = ""  # subclass sets

    class Meta:
        fields = ["status", "remarks"]
        widgets = {
            "remarks": forms.Textarea(attrs={"rows": 3, "maxlength": 800, "class": "form-input"}),
        }

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.fields["status"].widget = forms.Select(
            attrs={"class": "form-input"}, choices=self._status_choices(),
        )
        self.fields["status"].help_text = "Pick one."

    def _status_choices(self):  # subclass override
        raise NotImplementedError

    def clean(self):
        data = super().clean()
        if data.get("status") == self._reject_value and not (data.get("remarks") or "").strip():
            self.add_error("remarks", "Remarks are required when rejecting.")
        return data


class ReviewActionForm(_ActionFormBase):
    _reject_value = RequestReview.Status.REJECTED

    class Meta(_ActionFormBase.Meta):
        model = RequestReview

    def _status_choices(self):
        return [
            (RequestReview.Status.REVIEWED, "Mark reviewed"),
            (RequestReview.Status.REJECTED, "Reject"),
        ]


class ApprovalActionForm(_ActionFormBase):
    _reject_value = RequestApproval.Status.REJECTED

    class Meta(_ActionFormBase.Meta):
        model = RequestApproval

    def _status_choices(self):
        return [
            (RequestApproval.Status.APPROVED, "Approve"),
            (RequestApproval.Status.REJECTED, "Reject"),
        ]

# ==========================================
# FILE: ./documents/public_views.py
# ==========================================
"""Public (no-auth) views for the documents app.

The QR code on every issued letter points at ``/verify/<uuid>/`` so anyone
can confirm the document is genuine. ``/verify/<uuid>/preview/`` embeds
the PDF for inline viewing.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from django.http import FileResponse, Http404
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404, render
from django.urls import reverse
from django.views import View
from django.views.decorators.clickjacking import xframe_options_sameorigin
from django.views.generic import DetailView, TemplateView

from documents.models import DocumentRequest, RequestApproval


class PublicVerifyView(DetailView):
    """The 'is this real?' page. Shows the employee + doc type + signer list
    when status=APPROVED; otherwise renders a polite failure page."""

    model = DocumentRequest
    pk_url_kwarg = "uid"
    template_name = "documents/public_verify_success.html"
    context_object_name = "doc"

    def get_object(self, queryset=None):
        return get_object_or_404(
            DocumentRequest.objects.select_related("employee", "document_type"),
            pk=self.kwargs[self.pk_url_kwarg],
        )

    def get(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        obj = self.get_object()
        if obj.status != DocumentRequest.Status.APPROVED:
            return render(request, "documents/public_verify_fail.html", {"doc": obj})
        signers = list(
            obj.approvals.filter(status=RequestApproval.Status.APPROVED)
            .select_related("signatory", "approver_group")
            .order_by("order")
        )
        return render(request, self.template_name, {
            "doc": obj,
            "signers": signers,
            "generated_at": obj.updated_at,
            "preview_url": reverse("documents_public:public_preview", args=[obj.id]),
        })


class PublicPreviewView(TemplateView):
    template_name = "documents/public_preview.html"

    def get_context_data(self, **kwargs):
        ctx = super().get_context_data(**kwargs)
        doc = get_object_or_404(
            DocumentRequest.objects.select_related("document_type"),
            pk=kwargs["uid"],
        )
        if doc.status != DocumentRequest.Status.APPROVED or not doc.generated_file:
            self.template_name = "documents/public_preview_unavailable.html"
            ctx["doc"] = doc
            return ctx
        ctx["doc"] = doc
        ctx["pdf_url"] = reverse("documents_public:public_pdf", args=[doc.id])
        ctx["verify_url"] = reverse("documents_public:verify_document", args=[doc.id])
        return ctx


@xframe_options_sameorigin
def public_pdf(request, uid):
    """Stream the PDF inline for embedding inside the preview iframe."""
    doc = get_object_or_404(DocumentRequest, pk=uid)
    if doc.status != DocumentRequest.Status.APPROVED or not doc.generated_file:
        raise Http404("Document not available.")
    response = FileResponse(
        doc.generated_file.open("rb"),
        content_type="application/pdf",
    )
    response["Content-Disposition"] = (
        f'inline; filename="{doc.document_type.code}_{doc.id}.pdf"'
    )
    return response
