class CaseListView(LoginRequiredMixin, ListView):
    """All cases visible to the current user (HR sees all; managers/dept
    heads see their downline; everyone else sees their own case)."""

    template_name = "offboarding/case_list.html"
    context_object_name = "cases"
    paginate_by = 25

    def get_queryset(self):
        user = self.request.user
        qs = (OffboardingCase.objects.select_related(
            "resignation", "resignation__employee", "workflow_template",
        ).order_by("-added_at"))
        if can_see_all(user, request=self.request):
            return qs
        pks = visible_employee_pks(user, request=self.request)
        return qs.filter(
            Q(resignation__employee=user) | Q(resignation__employee_id__in=pks),
        )

    def get_context_data(self, **kwargs):
        ctx = super().get_context_data(**kwargs)
        ctx["page_title"] = "Offboarding cases"
        return ctx


class CaseDetailView(LoginRequiredMixin, DetailView):
    model = OffboardingCase
    template_name = "offboarding/case_detail.html"
    context_object_name = "case"

    def get_queryset(self):
        return OffboardingCase.objects.select_related(
            "resignation", "resignation__employee", "primary_letter",
            "workflow_template",
        ).prefetch_related(
            "steps__assigned_group", "steps__assigned_user", "steps__acted_by",
            "steps__template",
            "asset_returns__receiver", "notes__author", "letters",
        )

    def get_object(self, queryset=None):
        case = super().get_object(queryset)
        if not can_view_case(self.request.user, case, request=self.request):
            raise PermissionDenied("You can't view this case.")
        return case

    def get_context_data(self, **kwargs):
        ctx = super().get_context_data(**kwargs)
        case = ctx["case"]
        user = self.request.user
        ctx["exit_interview"] = getattr(case, "exit_interview", None)
        ctx["can_decide_resignation"] = can_act_on_resignation(
            user, case.resignation, request=self.request,
        )
        ctx["can_issue_letters"] = can_see_all(user, request=self.request)
        ctx["letters"] = list(case.letters.all().select_related("document_type"))
        ctx["page_title"] = f"Offboarding · {case.employee.display_name}"
        return ctx


class ResignationDecideView(LoginRequiredMixin, View):
    """HR accepts / rejects (and can tune notice / LWD before accepting)."""

    http_method_names = ["get", "post"]

    def dispatch(self, request, pk, *args, **kwargs):
        self.resignation = get_object_or_404(
            Resignation.objects.select_related("employee"), pk=pk,
        )
        if not can_act_on_resignation(request.user, self.resignation, request=request):
            raise PermissionDenied("You can't decide on this resignation.")
        return super().dispatch(request, *args, **kwargs)

    def get(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        form = ResignationDecideForm(instance=self.resignation)
        return self._render(request, form)

    def post(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        form = ResignationDecideForm(request.POST, instance=self.resignation)
        if form.is_valid():
            obj = form.save(commit=False)
            decision = form.cleaned_data["decision"]
            obj.status = decision
            obj.processed_by = request.user
            obj.processed_at = timezone.now()
            obj.process_note = form.cleaned_data.get("process_note", "") or ""
            obj.updated_by = request.user
            obj.save()  # triggers post_save signal → on accept: create case + LWD
            if request.htmx:
                response = HttpResponse(status=204)
                response["HX-Trigger"] = "orbis:drawer-close"
                target = (reverse("offboarding:case_detail", args=[obj.case.pk])
                          if obj.status == Resignation.Status.ACCEPTED
                             and getattr(obj, "case", None)
                          else reverse("offboarding:case_list"))
                response["HX-Redirect"] = target
                return response
            messages.success(request, f"Resignation {obj.get_status_display().lower()}.")
            return redirect("offboarding:case_list")
        return self._render(request, form)

    def _render(self, request, form):
        ctx = {
            "form": form,
            "resignation": self.resignation,
            "action_url": reverse("offboarding:resignation_decide",
                                   args=[self.resignation.pk]),
            "drawer_title": f"Decide · {self.resignation.employee.display_name}",
            "page_title": "Decide resignation",
        }
        template = ("offboarding/resignation_decide_drawer.html"
                    if request.htmx else "offboarding/resignation_decide.html")
        return render(request, template, ctx)


class ResignationHREditView(LoginRequiredMixin, View):
    """HR fix-typos before deciding."""

    http_method_names = ["get", "post"]

    def dispatch(self, request, pk, *args, **kwargs):
        self.resignation = get_object_or_404(Resignation, pk=pk)
        if not can_act_on_resignation(request.user, self.resignation, request=request):
            raise PermissionDenied("HR only.")
        return super().dispatch(request, *args, **kwargs)

    def get(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        form = ResignationHREditForm(instance=self.resignation)
        return self._render(request, form)

    def post(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        form = ResignationHREditForm(request.POST, instance=self.resignation)
        if form.is_valid():
            obj = form.save(commit=False)
            obj.updated_by = request.user
            obj.save()
            if request.htmx:
                response = HttpResponse(status=204)
                response["HX-Trigger"] = "orbis:drawer-close"
                return response
            messages.success(request, "Resignation updated.")
            return redirect("offboarding:case_list")
        return self._render(request, form)

    def _render(self, request, form):
        ctx = {
            "form": form,
            "resignation": self.resignation,
            "action_url": reverse("offboarding:resignation_hr_edit",
                                   args=[self.resignation.pk]),
            "drawer_title": "Edit resignation",
            "page_title": "Edit resignation",
        }
        template = ("offboarding/resignation_hr_edit_drawer.html"
                    if request.htmx else "offboarding/resignation_hr_edit.html")
        return render(request, template, ctx)


class CaseCancelView(LoginRequiredMixin, View):
    http_method_names = ["post"]

    def post(self, request, pk):
        case = get_object_or_404(OffboardingCase, pk=pk)
        if not can_see_all(request.user, request=request):
            raise PermissionDenied("HR only.")
        OffboardingCase.objects.filter(pk=case.pk).update(
            status=OffboardingCase.Status.CANCELLED,
            updated_by=request.user,
            updated_at=timezone.now(),
        )
        messages.success(request, "Case cancelled.")
        return redirect("offboarding:case_detail", pk=case.pk)


class IssueLettersView(LoginRequiredMixin, View):
    """Manual fallback when the final step's auto-issue didn't fire (e.g.
    a templated workflow without ``triggers_letters=True``)."""

    http_method_names = ["post"]

    def post(self, request, pk):
        case = get_object_or_404(OffboardingCase, pk=pk)
        if not can_see_all(request.user, request=request):
            raise PermissionDenied("HR only.")
        created = auto_issue_letters(case)
        if created:
            messages.success(request, f"Issued {len(created)} letter(s).")
        else:
            messages.info(request, "Letters were already issued (or no matching DocumentType).")
        return redirect("offboarding:case_detail", pk=case.pk)

class _AssetReturnEditBase(LoginRequiredMixin, View):
    http_method_names = ["get", "post"]
    is_add: bool = True

    def dispatch(self, request, pk, row_pk=None, *args, **kwargs):
        self.case = get_object_or_404(OffboardingCase, pk=pk)
        if not can_see_all(request.user, request=request):
            raise PermissionDenied("HR / Admin Facilities only.")
        if row_pk is not None:
            self.row = get_object_or_404(AssetReturn, pk=row_pk, case=self.case)
        else:
            self.row = None
        return super().dispatch(request, *args, **kwargs)

    def get(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        form = AssetReturnForm(instance=self.row)
        return self._render(request, form)

    def post(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        form = AssetReturnForm(request.POST, instance=self.row)
        if form.is_valid():
            obj = form.save(commit=False)
            obj.case = self.case
            obj.updated_by = request.user
            if not obj.pk:
                obj.added_by = request.user
            obj.save()
            if request.htmx:
                response = HttpResponse(status=204)
                response["HX-Trigger"] = "orbis:drawer-close"
                response["HX-Redirect"] = reverse(
                    "offboarding:case_detail", args=[self.case.pk],
                )
                return response
            messages.success(request, "Asset record saved.")
            return redirect("offboarding:case_detail", pk=self.case.pk)
        return self._render(request, form)

    def _render(self, request, form):
        ctx = {
            "form": form,
            "case": self.case,
            "row": self.row,
            "action_url": self._action_url(),
            "drawer_title": ("Add asset" if self.is_add else "Edit asset"),
            "page_title": ("Add asset" if self.is_add else "Edit asset"),
        }
        template = ("offboarding/asset_return_drawer.html"
                    if request.htmx else "offboarding/asset_return_form.html")
        return render(request, template, ctx)

    def _action_url(self):
        if self.row:
            return reverse("offboarding:asset_return_edit",
                           args=[self.case.pk, self.row.pk])
        return reverse("offboarding:asset_return_add", args=[self.case.pk])


class AssetReturnAddView(_AssetReturnEditBase):
    is_add = True


class AssetReturnEditView(_AssetReturnEditBase):
    is_add = False


class AssetReturnDeleteView(LoginRequiredMixin, View):
    http_method_names = ["post"]

    def post(self, request, pk, row_pk):

        if not can_see_all(request.user, request=request):

        AssetReturn.objects.filter(pk=row_pk, case=case).delete()
        messages.success(request, "Asset record removed.")

"""Forms for offboarding views.

* ``ResignationSubmitForm`` — employee-facing submission
* ``ResignationDecideForm`` — HR accept / reject
* ``ResignationHREditForm`` — HR fix-typos before deciding
* ``ClearanceStepActionForm`` — dynamic, generates fields from
  ``ClearanceStepFieldDefinition`` rows for the step's template
* ``ExitInterviewForm`` / ``AssetReturnForm`` / ``OffboardingNoteForm``
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date, timedelta

from django import forms
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError

from offboarding.models import (
    AssetReturn,
    ClearanceStep,
    ClearanceStepFieldDefinition,
    ExitInterview,
    OffboardingNote,
    Resignation,
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class ResignationSubmitForm(forms.ModelForm):
    """The form an employee fills out to start their offboarding."""

    class Meta:
        model = Resignation
        fields = [
            "separation_type", "reason", "notice_period_days",
            "notice_start_date", "last_working_date",
        ]
        widgets = {
            "separation_type": forms.Select(attrs={"class": "form-input"}),
            "reason": forms.Textarea(attrs={"rows": 4, "class": "form-input"}),
            "notice_period_days": forms.NumberInput(attrs={"class": "form-input"}),
            "notice_start_date": forms.DateInput(
                attrs={"type": "date", "class": "form-input"},
            ),
            "last_working_date": forms.DateInput(
                attrs={"type": "date", "class": "form-input"},
            ),
        }

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        # Sensible defaults if not pre-filled.
        if not self.is_bound and not self.instance.pk:
            today = date.today()
            self.fields["notice_start_date"].initial = today
            self.fields["last_working_date"].initial = today + timedelta(days=30)


class ResignationDecideForm(forms.ModelForm):
    """HR-only: accept, reject, or override fields before accepting."""

    decision = forms.ChoiceField(
        widget=forms.Select(attrs={"class": "form-input"}),
        choices=[
            (Resignation.Status.ACCEPTED, "Accept"),
            (Resignation.Status.REJECTED, "Reject"),
        ],
    )
    process_note = forms.CharField(
        required=False,
        widget=forms.TextInput(attrs={"class": "form-input"}),
        help_text="Short reason shown to the employee.",
    )

    class Meta:
        model = Resignation
        fields = ["notice_period_days", "last_working_date", "hr_notes"]
        widgets = {
            "notice_period_days": forms.NumberInput(attrs={"class": "form-input"}),
            "last_working_date": forms.DateInput(
                attrs={"type": "date", "class": "form-input"},
            ),
            "hr_notes": forms.Textarea(attrs={"rows": 3, "class": "form-input"}),
        }

    def clean(self):
        cd = super().clean()
        if cd.get("decision") == Resignation.Status.REJECTED:
            if not (cd.get("process_note") or "").strip():
                self.add_error("process_note", "Reason required when rejecting.")
        return cd


class ResignationHREditForm(forms.ModelForm):
    class Meta:
        model = Resignation
        fields = [
            "separation_type", "reason", "notice_period_days",
            "notice_start_date", "last_working_date", "hr_notes",
        ]
        widgets = ResignationSubmitForm.Meta.widgets | {
            "hr_notes": forms.Textarea(attrs={"rows": 3, "class": "form-input"}),
        }


class HRCreateResignationForm(forms.ModelForm):
    """HR-facing form: pick the employee, fill the fields, optionally
    auto-accept on save (skips the separate decide step).

    Sensible separation-type-driven defaults are pre-filled when the form
    isn't bound — INVOLUNTARY / ABSCONDING default to 0-day notice + LWD
    today; the rest default to 30-day notice from today.
    """

    from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
    _User = get_user_model()

    employee = forms.ModelChoiceField(
        queryset=_User.objects.filter(is_active=True).order_by(
            "first_name", "last_name"),
        widget=forms.Select(attrs={"class": "form-input"}),
        help_text="The employee being separated.",
    )
    auto_accept = forms.BooleanField(
        required=False,
        widget=forms.CheckboxInput(attrs={"class": "form-checkbox"}),
        label="Accept immediately",
        help_text="Skip the separate decide step and start clearance now.",
        initial=True,
    )

    class Meta:
        model = Resignation
        fields = [
            "employee", "separation_type", "reason", "notice_period_days",
            "notice_start_date", "last_working_date", "hr_notes",
        ]
        widgets = {
            "separation_type": forms.Select(attrs={"class": "form-input"}),
            "reason": forms.Textarea(attrs={"rows": 3, "class": "form-input"}),
            "notice_period_days": forms.NumberInput(attrs={"class": "form-input"}),
            "notice_start_date": forms.DateInput(
                attrs={"type": "date", "class": "form-input"},
            ),
            "last_working_date": forms.DateInput(
                attrs={"type": "date", "class": "form-input"},
            ),
            "hr_notes": forms.Textarea(attrs={"rows": 3, "class": "form-input"}),
        }

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        if not self.is_bound and not self.instance.pk:
            today = date.today()
            self.fields["notice_start_date"].initial = today
            self.fields["last_working_date"].initial = today + timedelta(days=30)
            self.fields["notice_period_days"].initial = 30

    def clean(self):
        cd = super().clean()
        emp = cd.get("employee")
        if emp:
            conflict = Resignation.objects.filter(
                employee=emp,
                status__in=[Resignation.Status.PENDING,
                            Resignation.Status.ACCEPTED],
            ).first()
            if conflict:
                self.add_error("employee",
                    f"{emp.display_name} already has an active resignation "
                    f"({conflict.get_status_display()}).")
        return cd


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Clearance step — dynamic
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class ClearanceStepActionForm(forms.ModelForm):
    """Single source of truth for "complete a clearance step".

    Pulls dynamic field definitions from
    ``step.template.field_definitions`` and generates form fields for them.
    Their cleaned values land in ``step.data_json`` so reports can query
    them without schema migrations."""

    class Meta:
        model = ClearanceStep
        fields = ["status", "remarks"]
        widgets = {
            "status": forms.Select(attrs={"class": "form-input"}),
            "remarks": forms.Textarea(attrs={"rows": 3, "maxlength": 1000,
                                              "class": "form-input"}),
        }

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.fields["status"].widget = forms.Select(
            attrs={"class": "form-input"},
            choices=[
                (ClearanceStep.Status.IN_PROGRESS, "Mark in progress"),
                (ClearanceStep.Status.DONE, "Mark done"),
                (ClearanceStep.Status.SKIPPED, "Skip (with reason)"),
                (ClearanceStep.Status.REJECTED, "Block / reject (with reason)"),
            ],
        )

        # Dynamic fields from the step template — empty if template was
        # deleted or doesn't define any.
        self._field_defs: list[ClearanceStepFieldDefinition] = []
        if self.instance and self.instance.template_id:
            self._field_defs = list(
                self.instance.template.field_definitions
                .filter(is_active=True).order_by("sort_order")
            )
        existing_data = self.instance.data_json or {}
        for fd in self._field_defs:
            self.fields[fd.field_key] = self._build_dynamic(fd, existing_data.get(fd.field_key))

    def _build_dynamic(self, fd: ClearanceStepFieldDefinition, initial):
        common = {
            "label": fd.field_label,
            "required": fd.is_required,
            "help_text": fd.help_text or "",
            "initial": initial,
        }
        ft = fd.field_type
        if ft == ClearanceStepFieldDefinition.FieldType.TEXTAREA:
            return forms.CharField(
                widget=forms.Textarea(attrs={"rows": 3, "class": "form-input"}),
                **common,
            )
        if ft == ClearanceStepFieldDefinition.FieldType.BOOLEAN:
            common["required"] = False
            return forms.BooleanField(
                widget=forms.CheckboxInput(attrs={"class": "form-checkbox"}),
                **{**common, "initial": initial in (True, "true", "True", "1")},
            )
        if ft == ClearanceStepFieldDefinition.FieldType.DATE:
            return forms.DateField(
                widget=forms.DateInput(attrs={"type": "date", "class": "form-input"}),
                **common,
            )
        # default: TEXT
        return forms.CharField(
            widget=forms.TextInput(attrs={"class": "form-input"}),
            max_length=300, **common,
        )

    def clean(self):
        cd = super().clean()
        rejecting_or_skipping = cd.get("status") in (
            ClearanceStep.Status.SKIPPED, ClearanceStep.Status.REJECTED,
        )
        if rejecting_or_skipping and not (cd.get("remarks") or "").strip():
            self.add_error("remarks", "Remarks required when skipping or rejecting.")

        # Required-dynamic check (BooleanField is_required is enforced via
        # field-level rules; we re-check the textual ones here for clarity).
        for fd in self._field_defs:
            if fd.is_required and fd.field_type != ClearanceStepFieldDefinition.FieldType.BOOLEAN:
                if not cd.get(fd.field_key):
                    self.add_error(fd.field_key, "This field is required.")
        return cd

    def save(self, commit=True, acted_by=None):
        obj = super().save(commit=False)
        data_json = dict(obj.data_json or {})
        for fd in self._field_defs:
            raw = self.cleaned_data.get(fd.field_key)
            if raw is None or raw == "":
                continue
            if fd.field_type == ClearanceStepFieldDefinition.FieldType.BOOLEAN:
                data_json[fd.field_key] = bool(raw)
            elif fd.field_type == ClearanceStepFieldDefinition.FieldType.DATE:
                data_json[fd.field_key] = raw.isoformat() if hasattr(raw, "isoformat") else str(raw)
            else:
                data_json[fd.field_key] = str(raw)
        obj.data_json = data_json
        if acted_by is not None:
            obj.acted_by = acted_by
            from django.utils import timezone
            obj.acted_at = timezone.now()
        if commit:
            obj.save()
        return obj

# ==========================================
# FILE: ./offboarding/middleware.py
# ==========================================
"""LastWorkingDateMiddleware — runtime guard for past-LWD users.

Sits after AuthenticationMiddleware. If an authenticated user's
``last_working_date`` is strictly before today, the middleware:

1. Flips ``is_active=False`` via a raw ``.update()`` (skips cascading signals
   so we don't trigger ``accounts._recompute_line_managers`` etc. on every
   request).
2. ``logout(request)`` — clears the session.
3. Redirects to ``offboarding:access_ended`` (no auth gate on that page).

An allowlist of URL names + a ``Resolver404`` fallback prevents redirect
loops on the access-ended page itself, the logout view, and on
static/media requests.

The middleware deliberately uses ``< today`` (not ``<= today``) — employees
keep access on their last working day, lose it the morning after.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from datetime import date

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model, logout
from django.shortcuts import redirect
from django.urls import Resolver404, resolve, reverse

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# URL names the middleware lets through even after lockout — otherwise the
# redirect to ``access_ended`` would itself trigger the middleware and loop.
_ALLOWED_PATH_NAMES = {"access_ended", "logout", "login"}


class LastWorkingDateMiddleware:
    def __init__(self, get_response):
        self.get_response = get_response

    def __call__(self, request):
        user = getattr(request, "user", None)
        if (user is None
                or not user.is_authenticated
                or not getattr(user, "last_working_date", None)
                or user.last_working_date >= date.today()):
            return self.get_response(request)

        # User's LWD has passed. Decide whether to let this request through.
        try:
            match = resolve(request.path_info)
            if match.url_name in _ALLOWED_PATH_NAMES:
                return self.get_response(request)
        except Resolver404:
            # Static / media / other untracked path — let it pass.
            return self.get_response(request)

        # Demote + log out.
        get_user_model().objects.filter(pk=user.pk).update(is_active=False)
        logger.info(
            "Deactivating %s on request — LWD %s < today",
            user.email, user.last_working_date,
        )
        logout(request)
        try:
            target = reverse("offboarding:access_ended")
        except Exception:
            # offboarding URLs not yet mounted (e.g. test bootstrap): fall back to /.
            target = "/"
        return redirect(target)


# ==========================================
# FILE: ./offboarding/urls.py
# ==========================================
"""URL conf for the offboarding app (mounted at /offboarding/)."""

from django.urls import path

from offboarding import views

app_name = "offboarding"

urlpatterns = [
    # Public (post-logout landing — no auth gate).
    path("access-ended/", views.AccessEndedView.as_view(), name="access_ended"),

    # Employee
    path("my/", views.MyOffboardingView.as_view(), name="my_offboarding"),
    path("submit/", views.ResignationSubmitView.as_view(), name="resignation_submit"),
    path("resignations/<int:pk>/withdraw/",
         views.ResignationWithdrawView.as_view(), name="resignation_withdraw"),

    # HR-initiated separation (on behalf of an employee)
    path("create/", views.HRCreateResignationView.as_view(),

# FILE: ./offboarding/permissions.py
# ==========================================
"""Access-control helpers for the offboarding app.

Mirror the leave + documents pattern: thin wrappers around
``accounts.permissions`` so the policy lives in one place.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from accounts.permissions import (
    can_edit_all,
    can_see_all,
    visible_employee_pks,
)


def can_view_case(user, case, request=None) -> bool:
    """Employee can see their own case. HR / admins see all. Managers
    see anyone in their downline / headed departments."""
    if not user or not user.is_authenticated:
        return False
    if case.resignation.employee_id == user.pk:
        return True
    if can_see_all(user, request):
        return True
    return case.resignation.employee_id in visible_employee_pks(user, request)


def can_view_resignation(user, resignation, request=None) -> bool:
    if not user or not user.is_authenticated:
        return False
    if resignation.employee_id == user.pk:
        return True
    if can_see_all(user, request):
        return True
    return resignation.employee_id in visible_employee_pks(user, request)


def can_act_on_resignation(user, resignation=None, request=None) -> bool:
    """HR-only — only edit_all roles can ACCEPT / REJECT."""
    return bool(user and user.is_authenticated and can_edit_all(user, request))


def can_withdraw_resignation(user, resignation, request=None) -> bool:
    """Applicant can withdraw while still PENDING; admins always can."""
    from offboarding.models import Resignation
    if not user or not user.is_authenticated:
        return False
    if can_edit_all(user, request):
        return True
    return (
        resignation.employee_id == user.pk
        and resignation.status == Resignation.Status.PENDING
    )


def can_act_on_clearance_step(user, step, request=None) -> bool:
    """HR can act on any step. Otherwise, the step's assigned user OR a
    member of the assigned group can act. The applicant themselves can
    never act on their own step (avoid 'I cleared myself')."""
    if not user or not user.is_authenticated:
        return False
    if step.case.resignation.employee_id == user.pk:
        return False
    if can_edit_all(user, request):
        return True
    if step.assigned_user_id == user.pk:
        return True
    if step.assigned_group_id and user.groups.filter(pk=step.assigned_group_id).exists():
        return True
    return False

# FILE: ./offboarding/management/commands/seed_offboarding_workflow.py

"""Seed the canonical SEBPO offboarding workflow.

Idempotent: re-runs touch nothing once the canonical workflow + steps +
field definitions exist. Creates one ``ClearanceWorkflowTemplate`` with
``code='SEBPO_DEFAULT_2026'``, ``is_default=True``, and 8 steps with
their predefined fields.

Depends on the clearance groups (IT, Finance, Admin Facilities, HR Head)
created by ``seed_orbis``.

from django.contrib.auth.models import Group
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand
from django.db import transaction

from offboarding.models import (
    ClearanceStepFieldDefinition,
    ClearanceStepTemplate,
    ClearanceWorkflowTemplate,
)


WORKFLOW_CODE = "SEBPO_DEFAULT_2026"

        "order": 8,

        "instruction": "Final approval. Marking this step DONE triggers letter issuance.",
        "fields": [
            ("clearance_letter_signed", "Clearance letter signed", ClearanceStepFieldDefinition.FieldType.BOOLEAN, False, 1),
            ("final_remarks", "Final remarks", ClearanceStepFieldDefinition.FieldType.TEXTAREA, False, 2),
        ],
        "triggers_letters": True,
    },
]


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = "Seed the canonical SEBPO offboarding clearance workflow (idempotent)."

    @transaction.atomic
    def handle(self, *args, **opts):
        workflow, made = ClearanceWorkflowTemplate.objects.get_or_create(
            code=WORKFLOW_CODE,
            defaults={
                "name": WORKFLOW_NAME,
                "description": "Default 8-step clearance workflow for SEBPO employee separations.",
                "is_default": True,
                "is_active": True,
            },
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"workflow: {WORKFLOW_CODE} {'created' if made else 'exists'}")

        for spec in STEPS:
            group_name = spec["assigned_group"]
            group = Group.objects.filter(name=group_name).first() if group_name else None
            if group_name and not group:
                self.stdout.write(self.style.WARNING(
                    f"  step {spec['step_code']} skipped: group {group_name!r} missing — "
                    f"run seed_orbis first."
                ))
                continue

            st_defaults = {
                "step_name": spec["step_name"],
                "order": spec["order"],
                "assigned_kind": spec["assigned_kind"],
                "assigned_group": group,
                "instruction": spec.get("instruction", ""),
                "is_required": True,
                "is_active": True,
                "opens_exit_interview": spec.get("opens_exit_interview", False),
                "opens_asset_return": spec.get("opens_asset_return", False),
                "triggers_letters": spec.get("triggers_letters", False),
            }
            step, made_step = ClearanceStepTemplate.objects.update_or_create(
                workflow=workflow, step_code=spec["step_code"],
                defaults=st_defaults,
            )

            for fkey, flabel, ftype, freq, fsort in spec["fields"]:
                ClearanceStepFieldDefinition.objects.update_or_create(
                    step_template=step, field_key=fkey,
                    defaults={
                        "field_label": flabel,
                        "field_type": ftype,
                        "is_required": freq,
                        "sort_order": fsort,
                        "is_active": True,
                    },
                )

            self.stdout.write(
                f"  step {spec['step_code']} ({spec['order']}) "
                f"{'created' if made_step else 'updated'} "
                f"· {len(spec['fields'])} field(s)"
            )

        self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS("✅ seed_offboarding_workflow complete"))


# ==========================================
# FILE: ./offboarding/management/commands/deactivate_past_lwd.py
# ==========================================
"""Nightly cron: deactivate users whose last_working_date has passed.

Backstop for ``offboarding.middleware.LastWorkingDateMiddleware`` — catches
users who don't trigger the middleware (e.g. never log in after LWD). The
middleware handles the fast path; this command handles the slow path.

Recommended cron entry::

    0 1 * * * /home/orbis/venv/bin/python /home/orbis/orbis/manage.py \\
        deactivate_past_lwd >> /home/orbis/orbis/logs/cron-deactivate.log 2>&1
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand

from offboarding.services import deactivate_past_lwd_users


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = "Deactivate users whose CustomUser.last_working_date < today."

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument(
            "--dry-run", action="store_true",
            help="Print what would be deactivated without making changes.",
        )

    def handle(self, *args, **opts):
        dry_run = opts["dry_run"]
        touched = deactivate_past_lwd_users(dry_run=dry_run)
        if not touched:
            self.stdout.write("No users past LWD.")
            return
        for email, lwd in touched:
            self.stdout.write(f"  · {email} (LWD {lwd})")
        verb = "would deactivate" if dry_run else "deactivated"
        self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS(
            f"{verb} {len(touched)} user(s)."
        ))
